About Us:

Fireworks is the platform for specialized intelligence, enabling companies to build, train, and serve AI models tailored to their own data, workflows, and products. Founded by the team behind PyTorch and backed by AMD, Atreides, Benchmark Capital, Index Ventures, Lightspeed, NVIDIA, Sequoia Capital, and TCV, Fireworks powers production AI with hundreds of state-of-the-art open models across text, image, embedding, audio, and multimodal workloads. Today, Fireworks is a Series D company valued at $17.5 billion, bringing together an ambitious, collaborative team that's building the future of enterprise AI.

About the Role

We are looking for a highly motivated and detail-oriented Senior Revenue Accountant to join our Accounting team. This role will be responsible for supporting and scaling our end-to-end revenue accounting processes as the company continues to grow.

The ideal candidate has strong technical accounting knowledge, particularly in ASC 606, and is comfortable working with complex and evolving commercial arrangements, including committed contracts, consumption-based arrangements, usage-based billing, credits, discounts, and other non-standard terms.

This is a hands-on role that will partner closely with Sales, Deal Desk/Revenue Operations, Billing, Finance, Legal, and other cross-functional teams to ensure contracts are appropriately evaluated, revenue is accurately recognized, and our processes and systems can scale with the business.

Responsibilities

  • Support the monthly revenue close process, including preparation of revenue-related journal entries, reconciliations, and supporting schedules.

  • Perform ASC 606 contract reviews for new and existing customer arrangements and document appropriate revenue recognition conclusions.

  • Evaluate complex or non-standard contract terms, including usage-based pricing, committed spend, minimum commitments, credits, discounts, contract modifications, renewals, and other commercial arrangements.

  • Maintain and reconcile revenue schedules across revenue, accounts receivable, deferred revenue, unbilled receivables, and customer credits.

  • Reconcile revenue recognition data to underlying billing, usage, contract, and general ledger data and investigate discrepancies.

  • Develop and maintain revenue accounting workbooks, rollforwards, and supporting documentation that provide clear audit trails from customer contracts and usage data through the general ledger.

  • Partner with Billing and Revenue Operations teams to ensure customer billing and revenue recognition are appropriately aligned while maintaining the distinction between billing and accounting requirements.

  • Partner with Sales, Legal, Deal Desk, and Finance on new products, pricing models, contract structures, and commercial terms to identify potential accounting implications.

  • Support the accounting assessment and operationalization of new products and SKUs, including determining appropriate revenue recognition treatment and ensuring required accounting data is captured.

  • Prepare technical accounting memos and other documentation supporting significant or complex revenue accounting conclusions.

  • Support external audits by preparing revenue schedules, contract samples, reconciliations, and responses to auditor inquiries.

  • Identify opportunities to improve and automate revenue accounting processes, controls, reconciliations, and reporting.

  • Partner with Systems and cross-functional teams to improve the integration and data flow among CRM, billing, usage, and ERP systems.

  • Help design and maintain effective internal controls over revenue recognition and reporting.

  • Support development of scalable revenue accounting policies and procedures as the company and its product offerings evolve.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

  • CPA preferred.

  • 5+ years of relevant accounting experience, including meaningful experience with revenue recognition.

  • Strong working knowledge of ASC 606 and experience evaluating customer contracts and revenue arrangements.

  • Experience with SaaS, cloud infrastructure, AI, technology, or other usage/consumption-based business models strongly preferred.

  • Experience working with large datasets and reconciling information across multiple systems.

  • Experience with NetSuite or another major ERP system preferred.

  • Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills; SQL or experience working directly with data warehouses is a plus.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with exceptional attention to detail.

  • Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced environment where products, systems, and processes continue to evolve.

  • Strong communication skills and ability to translate technical accounting requirements into practical guidance for non-accounting stakeholders.

What Success Looks Like

You will help build a revenue accounting function that is accurate, scalable, auditable, and closely connected to how the business actually operates. You will be able to trace revenue from commercial terms and customer activity through billing and ultimately to the general ledger, while helping the company launch new products and pricing models without creating unnecessary accounting complexity.

Why Fireworks?

  • Solve Hard Problems: Tackle challenges at the forefront of AI infrastructure, from low-latency inference to scalable model serving.

  • Build What’s Next: Work with bleeding-edge technology that impacts how businesses and developers harness AI globally.

  • Ownership & Impact: Join a fast-growing, passionate team where your work directly shapes the future of AI—no bureaucracy, just results.

  • Learn from the Best: Collaborate with world-class engineers and AI researchers who thrive on curiosity and innovation.

Fireworks AI is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all innovators.

raw.title: Head of Tax
raw.description:
About Us:

Fireworks is the platform for specialized intelligence, enabling companies to build, train, and serve AI models tailored to their own data, workflows, and products. Founded by the team behind PyTorch and backed by AMD, Atreides, Benchmark Capital, Index Ventures, Lightspeed, NVIDIA, Sequoia Capital, and TCV, Fireworks powers production AI with hundreds of state-of-the-art open models across text, image, embedding, audio, and multimodal workloads. Today, Fireworks is a Series D company valued at $17.5 billion, bringing together an ambitious, collaborative team that's building the future of enterprise AI.

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Head of Tax to lead and manage the organization’s indirect tax function. This role will be responsible for indirect tax compliance, reporting, planning, audits, and risk management, while serving as a key advisor to Finance, Accounting, Legal, Operations, and other business stakeholders.

The successful candidate will bring strong technical expertise in indirect taxation, excellent judgment, and the ability to translate complex tax requirements into practical business solutions. This role is well suited to a tax professional who can operate strategically while maintaining strong oversight of day-to-day compliance and execution.

Key Responsibilities

Indirect Tax Compliance & Reporting

  • Lead and oversee indirect tax compliance activities, including sales and use tax, VAT/GST, excise taxes, and other transaction-based taxes, as applicable.

  • Ensure accurate and timely preparation, review, and filing of indirect tax returns and related payments.

  • Maintain appropriate controls, documentation, reconciliations, and supporting workpapers for indirect tax accounts.

  • Monitor filing obligations, registrations, nexus requirements, and changes in the organization’s tax footprint.

  • Oversee third-party service providers supporting indirect tax compliance and reporting.

Tax Advisory & Planning

  • Serve as the organization’s subject-matter expert on indirect tax matters.

  • Advise business partners on the indirect tax implications of new products, services, customer arrangements, geographic expansion, supply-chain changes, and other strategic initiatives.

  • Research and interpret complex indirect tax legislation, regulations, and administrative guidance.

  • Identify opportunities to improve tax efficiency, reduce risk, and recover overpaid taxes where appropriate.

  • Partner with Legal and Finance teams on contracts and commercial arrangements to ensure appropriate indirect tax treatment.

Audits & Risk Management

  • Lead indirect tax audits, examinations, inquiries, and correspondence with tax authorities.

  • Develop audit strategies and coordinate responses, documentation, and negotiations with relevant authorities.

  • Proactively identify areas of indirect tax exposure and implement appropriate remediation plans.

  • Maintain and enhance the organization’s indirect tax control framework and ensure appropriate governance over key tax processes.

  • Monitor legislative and regulatory developments and assess their impact on the business.

Systems, Technology & Process Improvement

  • Partner with Finance, Accounting, IT, and Operations to ensure appropriate indirect tax configuration within ERP, billing, procurement, and tax determination systems.

  • Drive automation and process improvements to increase the accuracy, scalability, and efficiency of indirect tax processes.

  • Support system implementations, upgrades, integrations, and business transformation initiatives from an indirect tax perspective.

  • Improve the use of data and analytics for compliance, reconciliations, audit defense, and tax risk management.

Leadership & Stakeholder Management

  • Manage, coach, and develop indirect tax team members, as applicable.

  • Establish priorities and ensure effective execution across compliance, advisory, audit, and project responsibilities.

  • Build strong relationships with Accounting, FP&A, Treasury, Legal, Procurement, Sales, Operations, IT, and other business teams.

  • Communicate complex tax matters clearly to both tax and non-tax stakeholders, including senior leadership.

  • Manage relationships with external tax advisors, consultants, and service providers.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Taxation, Business, or a related field.

  • CPA, CA, JD, LLM, or other relevant professional qualification preferred.

  • 8+ years of progressive tax experience, with significant experience in indirect taxation.

  • Strong technical knowledge of sales and use tax and/or VAT/GST; experience with additional indirect taxes is advantageous.

  • Experience managing indirect tax compliance, audits, research, and advisory matters.

  • Experience in a Big Four/public accounting firm, multinational organization, or complex corporate tax environment preferred.

  • Strong understanding of accounting processes, financial systems, and internal controls.

  • Experience with ERP and indirect tax technology platforms such as NetSuite, Anrok ,Vertex, similar systems is preferred.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and complex projects in a fast-paced environment.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, project-management, and communication skills.

  • Ability to work effectively across functions and influence stakeholders at multiple levels of an organization.

Preferred Attributes

  • Strategic thinker with a strong understanding of how tax considerations affect broader business decisions.

  • Hands-on leader who is comfortable moving between technical analysis and operational execution.

  • Strong attention to detail while maintaining a commercial and risk-based perspective.

  • Ability to simplify complex tax concepts and provide clear, actionable recommendations.

  • Comfortable operating in an evolving environment and building scalable tax processes.

  • Demonstrated commitment to developing people, improving processes, and strengthening controls.

Success in This Role

Success will be measured by the accuracy and timeliness of indirect tax compliance, effective management of tax risks and audits, quality of advice provided to the business, improvements in processes and technology, and the ability to build a scalable indirect tax function that supports the organization’s growth.

Why Fireworks?

  • Solve Hard Problems: Tackle challenges at the forefront of AI infrastructure, from low-latency inference to scalable model serving.

  • Build What’s Next: Work with bleeding-edge technology that impacts how businesses and developers harness AI globally.

  • Ownership & Impact: Join a fast-growing, passionate team where your work directly shapes the future of AI—no bureaucracy, just results.

  • Learn from the Best: Collaborate with world-class engineers and AI researchers who thrive on curiosity and innovation.

Fireworks AI is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all innovators.

Translate our compensation philosophy into clear strategy and practice

raw.title: Member of Technical Staff, Systems Infrastructure (2026 PhD New Grad)
raw.description:
About Us:

Fireworks is the platform for specialized intelligence, enabling companies to build, train, and serve AI models tailored to their own data, workflows, and products. Founded by the team behind PyTorch and backed by AMD, Atreides, Benchmark Capital, Index Ventures, Lightspeed, NVIDIA, Sequoia Capital, and TCV, Fireworks powers production AI with hundreds of state-of-the-art open models across text, image, embedding, audio, and multimodal workloads. Today, Fireworks is a Series D company valued at $17.5 billion, bringing together an ambitious, collaborative team that's building the future of enterprise AI.

THE ROLE:

This role is designed for systems researchers finishing their PhD who want to see their ideas run on real fleets at real scale. As a Member of Technical Staff on the Systems Infrastructure team, you'll design and build the substrate underneath Fireworks — the schedulers, storage systems, and networks that keep tens of thousands of accelerators busy and inference latency low.

The problems here are the ones your dissertation probably touched: how to place compute-intensive jobs across heterogeneous hardware without stranding capacity, how to move model weights and KV cache fast enough that they never become the bottleneck, and how to keep a datacenter network saturated with collective traffic without collapsing tail latency. The difference is that here you get a production fleet as your testbed and your work ships.

You'll be paired with a senior engineer as a mentor and given a real problem from day one. Start dates are flexible around thesis defense timelines.

AREAS OF FOCUS

We're hiring across three areas — depth in any one of them is what we're looking for, not all three:

  • Scheduling & resource management: GPU job scheduling and scheduling of compute-intensive workloads across heterogeneous hardware; multi-tenant isolation, fair sharing and preemption, topology- and locality-aware placement, autoscaling, fleet utilization, and capacity planning across accelerator generations and vendors

  • Distributed storage & caching: High-performance distributed storage and caching for model weights, checkpoints, datasets, and KV cache; tiering across memory, local NVMe and object storage, cache admission and eviction policy, consistency, and fast cold-start and weight-loading paths

  • Datacenter networking: High-performance DC networks for AI workloads; RDMA/RoCE and InfiniBand, collective communication (NCCL/RCCL) performance, congestion control, topology design, load balancing, and tail-latency and reliability engineering at fleet scale

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Design, build, and operate core infrastructure systems for large-scale training and inference

  • Model and measure system behavior — build the benchmarks, traces, and simulators needed to reason about scheduling, caching, and network performance before committing to a design

  • Identify bottlenecks across the stack, from kernel and driver to scheduler policy, and drive them out with data

  • Turn research ideas into production systems that hold up under real workloads, real failures, and real customers

  • Work closely with the research and inference teams so that infrastructure design and model design inform each other

  • Contribute to the team's technical direction by tracking emerging hardware, interconnects, and systems research

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

  • PhD completed within the last 6 months, or expected completion by December 2026, in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a similar field

  • Research background in one or more of: distributed systems, operating systems, scheduling and resource management, storage systems, computer networks, computer architecture, or high-performance computing

  • Depth in at least one of the three focus areas above, demonstrated through your dissertation, publications, or systems you've built

  • Strong systems programming skills in C/C++, Rust, Go, or a similar language, plus working proficiency in Python

  • Experience building and evaluating real systems — not only simulation — and reasoning rigorously about performance with measurements

  • Ability to communicate systems design and results clearly to audiences with different backgrounds

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • First-authored publications at top-tier systems or networking venues (OSDI, SOSP, NSDI, EuroSys, SIGCOMM, ATC, FAST, ASPLOS, MLSys, SC, or similar)

  • Industry internships in infrastructure, cloud, or HPC, or meaningful open-source contributions to systems projects (Kubernetes, Ray, Slurm, vLLM, NCCL, DPDK/SPDK, Ceph, or similar)

  • Hands-on experience with GPU clusters, accelerator programming (CUDA, ROCm, Triton), or heterogeneous compute environments

  • Experience with Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure, or with operating multi-tenant clusters in production

  • Experience with performance profiling and debugging in distributed environments

  • Research or engineering experience demonstrated via grants, fellowships, patents, or systems competitions

Why Fireworks?

  • Solve Hard Problems: Tackle challenges at the forefront of AI infrastructure, from low-latency inference to scalable model serving.

  • Build What’s Next: Work with bleeding-edge technology that impacts how businesses and developers harness AI globally.

  • Ownership & Impact: Join a fast-growing, passionate team where your work directly shapes the future of AI—no bureaucracy, just results.

  • Learn from the Best: Collaborate with world-class engineers and AI researchers who thrive on curiosity and innovation.

Fireworks AI is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all innovators.

raw.title: Member of Technical Staff, New Grad (BS/MS)
raw.description:
About Us:

Fireworks is the platform for specialized intelligence, enabling companies to build, train, and serve AI models tailored to their own data, workflows, and products. Founded by the team behind PyTorch and backed by AMD, Atreides, Benchmark Capital, Index Ventures, Lightspeed, NVIDIA, Sequoia Capital, and TCV, Fireworks powers production AI with hundreds of state-of-the-art open models across text, image, embedding, audio, and multimodal workloads. Today, Fireworks is a Series D company valued at $17.5 billion, bringing together an ambitious, collaborative team that's building the future of enterprise AI.

The Role

This role is built for new graduates who want to work on real AI systems, in production, from the start. As a MTS at Fireworks, you'll write and ship code that runs on one of the busiest inference platforms in the world — serving hundreds of models to developers and enterprises at massive scale.

We hire new grads into teams across Engineering, and we match you to a team based on your strengths and interests after we get to know you. Depending on where you land, your work could span inference and performance, model training and fine-tuning, distributed systems and cloud infrastructure, developer platform and APIs, or product and full-stack application engineering. One application puts you in front of all of them.

You'll join with a senior engineer as your mentor and a structured ramp-up: you'll start on well-scoped, real problems alongside your mentor, then take ownership of features and systems of your own. We move fast, our bar is high, and we'll invest in getting you there.

We welcome candidates who have completed a Bachelor's or Master's degree within the last 6 months, or expect to complete one by Summer 2027. Note that candidates graduating in December 2026 are highly preferred and prioritized.

What You'll Do

  • Ship production code: Design, build, and deploy features and services that customers depend on every day

  • Own problems end to end: Take a problem from ambiguous idea through design, implementation, testing, rollout, and operation

  • Make things faster and more reliable: Improve the performance, efficiency, and scalability of the systems you work on

  • Work with modern AI systems: Build with, on top of, or underneath large models — depending on your team, that could mean serving them, training them, evaluating them, or building products powered by them

  • Debug hard things: Dig into unfamiliar code and unfamiliar failures, and get to the root cause

  • Collaborate broadly: Work closely with engineers, researchers, product, and — on some teams — directly with customers

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, completed within the last 6 months or before the end of 2026

  • Strong programming fundamentals and solid grounding in data structures, algorithms, and systems

  • Practical software engineering experience through internships, research, open-source contributions, or substantial personal projects

  • Proficiency in at least one of Python, C++, Go, Rust, TypeScript, or a comparable language

  • Fluency with AI coding harnesses and a habit of using them well

  • Clear written and verbal communication, and the judgment to ask for help early

  • Comfort with ambiguity, fast iteration, and high ownership

Preferred Qualifications

We don't expect any single candidate to have all of these.

  • Hands-on experience building with LLMs or other ML models — coursework, projects, and internships all count

  • Experience with GPU programming, CUDA, kernel optimization, or performance profiling

  • Experience with distributed systems, Kubernetes, or cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure)

  • Experience with PyTorch, model training, fine-tuning (SFT, RLHF/RFT), or inference serving

  • Experience shipping a full-stack or agentic application end to end, not just a notebook

  • Familiarity with evaluation, RAG systems, or observability for ML systems

  • Open-source contributions, competitive programming, or research publications

Why Fireworks?

  • Solve Hard Problems: Tackle challenges at the forefront of AI infrastructure, from low-latency inference to scalable model serving.

  • Build What’s Next: Work with bleeding-edge technology that impacts how businesses and developers harness AI globally.

  • Ownership & Impact: Join a fast-growing, passionate team where your work directly shapes the future of AI—no bureaucracy, just results.

  • Learn from the Best: Collaborate with world-class engineers and AI researchers who thrive on curiosity and innovation.

Fireworks AI is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all innovators.

raw.title: Sales Enablement Manager
raw.description:
About Us:

Fireworks is the platform for specialized intelligence, enabling companies to build, train, and serve AI models tailored to their own data, workflows, and products. Founded by the team behind PyTorch and backed by AMD, Atreides, Benchmark Capital, Index Ventures, Lightspeed, NVIDIA, Sequoia Capital, and TCV, Fireworks powers production AI with hundreds of state-of-the-art open models across text, image, embedding, audio, and multimodal workloads. Today, Fireworks is a Series D company valued at $17.5 billion, bringing together an ambitious, collaborative team that's building the future of enterprise AI.

The Role

We're looking for a hands-on Sales Enablement Manager to help build GTM Enablement as Fireworks scales its go-to-market motion. The role sits in the Revenue Operations organization and reports to the Head of GTM Enablement.

This is a builder's seat with a real delivery mandate. Upon arrival, you'll take immediate ownership of two flagship initiatives that define how Fireworks captures and serves its GTM knowledge: organizing our knowledge as a data product and industrializing our internal GTM Tutor App. But you won't live only in content and tooling. You're also expected to deliver traditional enablement, facilitating live and virtual sessions, supporting role-based ramp, and running cross-functional GTM programs that keep the field ahead of a fast-moving product.

To do it well, you'll pair the fundamentals of great enablement (facilitation, content development, and program management) with genuine AI fluency, building the tools you teach rather than just briefing them. You'll own processes end to end and drive outcomes across Product, Marketing, and Sales without waiting to be told how.

What You'll Own

  1. Own our knowledge as a data product:
    Take immediate ownership of our "knowledge as a data product" vision by structuring, governing, and maintaining GTM knowledge so it's accessible for both human and agent consumption. Complete a full audit of our existing knowledge and content, then define and roll out the taxonomy, standards, and governance for how we create, maintain, and retire content going forward, turning a scattered corpus into a trusted, queryable source of truth that stays healthy and current as it grows.

  2. Industrialize the GTM Tutor App:
    Harden and scale our "GTM Tutor App," the internal AI application that trains and coaches sellers on GTM topics. Build the framework to add new topics quickly, improve the user experience, and strengthen the backend so the app is reliable, extensible, and ready for broad field adoption.

  3. Build the cross-functional content engine:
    Establish the recurring processes and working relationships with Product, Marketing, Field Engineering, and Sales that ensure the field and our customers always have the sales and marketing assets they need. Create the intake, prioritization, and hand-off model that turns new product primitives, launches, and campaigns into field-ready and customer-facing collateral on a predictable cadence, and hold cross-functional partners accountable to it.

  4. Deliver core enablement programs:
    Design and deliver enablement content and facilitate high-impact live and virtual sessions across product knowledge, sales skills, competitive positioning, and internal process. Support role-based ramp for new Account Executives, AI Field Engineers, and BDRs, and help run critical GTM programs alongside partners in Sales, Field Engineering, Marketing, and Product. As we grow, you'll expand our capacity to meet the field's enablement needs.

  5. Codify field best practices:
    Synthesize what's working from real customer engagements and enablement outcomes, codify it into repeatable plays and content, and deliver it back to the field, feeding insight upstream to help shape the evolving GTM motion.

  6. Help define the future of agentic enablement:
    Shape what agentic enablement looks like at Fireworks, designing and shipping AI agents that lift Account Executive efficiency and surface Revenue Operations insight, building on the foundations laid by our GTM Engineering team.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Several years (5+) of experience in GTM enablement, sales, or a related solutions/RevOps role, with demonstrated ownership of enablement programs end to end

  • Strong at both content development and live facilitation for audiences from new hires to experienced sellers

  • Has personally built AI agents or apps, through prompting, no-code, low-code, or code, to drive seller or operational productivity (engineering degree not required)

  • Excellent program and process management: you can stand up structure, standards, and repeatable workflows from scratch

  • Skilled at eliciting knowledge from busy subject-matter experts and turning it into structured, reusable content

  • Comfortable working with knowledge, content, and data as structured systems (taxonomy, governance, quality standards)

  • Proven ability to enable technical sellers to sell credibly to technical buyers

  • A trusted cross-functional partner who can work independently across Product, Marketing, and Sales

  • Thrives in ambiguity, high ownership, and the pace of a high-growth startup

  • Willing and able to travel ~15–20% for onboarding weeks, offsites, and kickoffs

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience as a quota-carrying field IC (Account Executive, AI Field Engineer, or similar)

  • Background in AI/ML infrastructure, developer tools, or API-first and consumption-based businesses, with literacy in usage-based pricing models

  • Experience with modern enablement tooling and systems (LMS, CMS, CRM, and enablement platforms)

  • Experience designing knowledge bases or content for retrieval by AI/LLM systems (RAG, agents)

Why Fireworks?

  • Solve Hard Problems: Tackle challenges at the forefront of AI infrastructure, from low-latency inference to scalable model serving.

  • Build What’s Next: Work with bleeding-edge technology that impacts how businesses and developers harness AI globally.

  • Ownership & Impact: Join a fast-growing, passionate team where your work directly shapes the future of AI—no bureaucracy, just results.

  • Learn from the Best: Collaborate with world-class engineers and AI researchers who thrive on curiosity and innovation.

Fireworks AI is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all innovators.

raw.title: Strategic Finance Manager, Infrastructure and R&D
raw.description:
About Us:

Fireworks is the platform for specialized intelligence, enabling companies to build, train, and serve AI models tailored to their own data, workflows, and products. Founded by the team behind PyTorch and backed by AMD, Atreides, Benchmark Capital, Index Ventures, Lightspeed, NVIDIA, Sequoia Capital, and TCV, Fireworks powers production AI with hundreds of state-of-the-art open models across text, image, embedding, audio, and multimodal workloads. Today, Fireworks is a Series D company valued at $17.5 billion, bringing together an ambitious, collaborative team that's building the future of enterprise AI.

About the Role

This role owns the financial analysis behind our two largest investments: GPU infrastructure and R&D. On the infrastructure side, you'll model how we contract for capacity, how efficiently we use it, and what it costs to serve inference — the drivers that determine gross margin. On the R&D side, you'll partner with Engineering, Product, Security, and IT on headcount planning, tooling and vendor spend, and the operating budget. You'll work directly with leaders across infrastructure, engineering, product, and finance. It's an early to mid-career role with real scope, built for someone with a sharp analytical foundation who wants to understand how the business actually runs and help build the function and processes that enable Fireworks to scale.

What You'll Do

  • Own the compute model: Build and maintain the financial model for our GPU fleet — capacity commitments, utilization, cost per GPU-hour — and how all of it flows through to unit economics, gross margin, and cash.

  • Support R&D finance: Serve as a finance partner to Engineering, Product, Security, and IT. Support R&D planning end to end: headcount and hiring plans, tooling and vendor spend, and the operating budget.

  • Support capacity planning: Serve as a source of truth for what capacity we hold, what we've committed to, and what we're actually using; partner with infra on the plan of record.

  • Analyze capacity commitments: Evaluate commitment structures and contract terms with cloud and GPU providers, surface optimization opportunities, and track provider performance and credit refunds.

  • Negotiate and manage vendors: Partner on software, tooling, and infrastructure vendor negotiations and renewals, bringing the analysis that gets us better terms.

  • Get operational: Sit in infra and engineering planning, learn how utilization, scheduling, and roadmaps actually behave, and bring that reality back into the financial model.

  • Forecast and explain: Support forecasting and variance analysis for compute, cloud, and R&D spend on a monthly cadence leadership can rely on, and explain the drivers behind the numbers clearly.

  • Split research from production: Track and forecast research and experimentation compute separately from production serving, and build the framework for evaluating return on R&D investment across teams and initiatives.

  • Build the function: Establish the reporting, dashboards, and processes that make compute and R&D economics legible to leadership.

  • Support the company narrative: Contribute the compute and R&D inputs to board materials, investor updates, and fundraising processes as they come up.

What We're Looking For

  • 4-7 years of experience beginning with investment banking, private equity, or equivalent experience — this foundation is required for the modeling and analytical rigor it builds.

  • Ideally, subsequent time in a corporate or startup finance seat (strategic finance, FP&A, or corporate development) at a technology company.

  • Expert financial modeling skills — you can build from scratch, stress-test your own assumptions, and translate outputs into clear recommendations.

  • Genuine interest in operations. You want to understand the physical and technical system underneath the numbers, not just consume its outputs.

  • Comfort with messy and imperfect data.

  • Excellent communication with technical and non-technical audiences alike — you can take a messy question from a founder or an engineer and return a clear one-page answer.

  • Comfortable being both the architect and the operator, with strong instincts for building structure where none exists and building processes to scale.

  • High ownership and a bias toward action in an environment where priorities shift and ambiguity is the default.

  • Bachelor's degree, or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to Have

  • Experience at an AI/ML, developer platform, or cloud infrastructure company, and familiarity with how companies buy and use compute.

  • Exposure to cloud, data center, or semiconductor economics — CSP contract structures, capacity commitments, accelerator utilization.

  • Experience supporting an engineering organization as a finance partner, including headcount planning and vendor costs.

  • Working knowledge of GAAP treatment for infrastructure and capitalized software development costs.

  • Experience with consumption- or usage-based revenue models and how commits and tiers are structured around them.

  • Proficiency with SQL, Python, BI tools, or an ERP such as NetSuite.

  • Enthusiasm for using AI to automate the manual parts of finance work.

Who You'll Work With

Engineering & Engineering Leadership, Infrastructure, Product, Security, IT, Finance & FP&A, Accounting, and Legal.

Why Fireworks?

  • Solve Hard Problems: Tackle challenges at the forefront of AI infrastructure, from low-latency inference to scalable model serving.

  • Build What’s Next: Work with bleeding-edge technology that impacts how businesses and developers harness AI globally.

  • Ownership & Impact: Join a fast-growing, passionate team where your work directly shapes the future of AI—no bureaucracy, just results.

  • Learn from the Best: Collaborate with world-class engineers and AI researchers who thrive on curiosity and innovation.

Fireworks AI is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all innovators.

 - Analyze capacity commitments: Evaluate commitment structures and contract terms with cloud and GPU providers, surface optimization opportunities, and track provider performance and credit refunds.

 - Negotiate and manage vendors: Partner on software, tooling, and infrastructure vendor negotiations and renewals, bringing the analysis that gets us better terms.

 - Get operational: Sit in infra and engineering planning, learn how utilization, scheduling, and roadmaps actually behave, and bring that reality back into the financial model.

 - Forecast and explain: Support forecasting and variance analysis for compute, cloud, and R&D spend on a monthly cadence leadership can rely on, and explain the drivers behind the numbers clearly.

 - Split research from production: Track and forecast research and experimentation compute separately from production serving, and build the framework for evaluating return on R&D investment across teams and initiatives.

 - Build the function: Establish the reporting, dashboards, and processes that make compute and R&D economics legible to leadership.

 - Support the company narrative: Contribute the compute and R&D inputs to board materials, investor updates, and fundraising processes as they come up.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 4-7 years of experience beginning with investment banking, private equity, or equivalent experience — this foundation is required for the modeling and analytical rigor it builds.

 - Ideally, subsequent time in a corporate or startup finance seat (strategic finance, FP&A, or corporate development) at a technology company.

 - Expert financial modeling skills — you can build from scratch, stress-test your own assumptions, and translate outputs into clear recommendations.

 - Genuine interest in operations. You want to understand the physical and technical system underneath the numbers, not just consume its outputs.

 - Comfort with messy and imperfect data.

 - Excellent communication with technical and non-technical audiences alike — you can take a messy question from a founder or an engineer and return a clear one-page answer.

 - Comfortable being both the architect and the operator, with strong instincts for building structure where none exists and building processes to scale.

 - High ownership and a bias toward action in an environment where priorities shift and ambiguity is the default.

 - Bachelor's degree, or equivalent practical experience.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience at an AI/ML, developer platform, or cloud infrastructure company, and familiarity with how companies buy and use compute.

 - Exposure to cloud, data center, or semiconductor economics — CSP contract structures, capacity commitments, accelerator utilization.

 - Experience supporting an engineering organization as a finance partner, including headcount planning and vendor costs.

 - Working knowledge of GAAP treatment for infrastructure and capitalized software development costs.

 - Experience with consumption- or usage-based revenue models and how commits and tiers are structured around them.

 - Proficiency with SQL, Python, BI tools, or an ERP such as NetSuite.

 - Enthusiasm for using AI to automate the manual parts of finance work.


WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH

Engineering & Engineering Leadership, Infrastructure, Product, Security, IT, Finance & FP&A, Accounting, and Legal.


WHY FIREWORKS?

 - Ownership & Impact: Join a fast-growing, passionate team where your work directly shapes the future of AI—no bureaucracy, just results.

raw.title: Billing Operations Analyst - Usage Billing
raw.description:
About Us:

Fireworks is the platform for specialized intelligence, enabling companies to build, train, and serve AI models tailored to their own data, workflows, and products. Founded by the team behind PyTorch and backed by AMD, Atreides, Benchmark Capital, Index Ventures, Lightspeed, NVIDIA, Sequoia Capital, and TCV, Fireworks powers production AI with hundreds of state-of-the-art open models across text, image, embedding, audio, and multimodal workloads. Today, Fireworks is a Series D company valued at $17.5 billion, bringing together an ambitious, collaborative team that's building the future of enterprise AI.

About the Role

Fireworks AI is looking for a Billing Operations Analyst to own billing and receivables operations for usage-based customer business.

AI infrastructure creates a uniquely data-intensive billing environment. This role will sit at the intersection of Finance Operations, Product, Engineering, Data, and Revenue Accounting to help ensure that customer usage flows completely and accurately through billing and ultimately into accounts receivable and cash.

This is an ideal role for someone who combines strong billing fundamentals with systems thinking, data analysis, and a passion for automation.

What You'll Do

  • Own operational billing processes for usage-based customers.

  • Manage customer billing setup and ensure billing configurations, payment requirements, and account information are complete and accurate.

  • Monitor the usage-to-bill lifecycle and help ensure customer usage is captured, rated, and billed completely and accurately.

  • Perform usage-to-billing reconciliations and investigate discrepancies between source usage data and customer invoices.

  • Monitor billing exceptions, failed billing events, unusual transactions, and other anomalies.

  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Data, and Finance Systems teams to investigate and resolve systemic billing issues.

  • Manage receivables, aging, collections, unapplied cash, and customer account exceptions.

  • Investigate customer billing disputes and drive issues through timely resolution.

  • Support month-end close, including billing completeness, AR reconciliations, usage reconciliations, and aging validation.

  • Execute SOX and O2C controls and maintain appropriate documentation, evidence, and segregation of duties.

  • Develop exception-based monitoring and controls that allow billing operations to scale without proportional increases in manual effort.

  • Identify automation opportunities across usage validation, billing, collections, reconciliation, and reporting.

  • Define and monitor operational metrics, including billing completeness, billing accuracy, failed billing, exception rates, aging, DSO, disputes, and unapplied cash.

What We're Looking For

  • 3–6+ years of experience in Billing Operations, Order-to-Cash, Finance Operations, Accounts Receivable, or a related function.

  • Experience with usage-based, consumption-based, SaaS, cloud, infrastructure, API, or other high-volume billing models is strongly preferred.

  • Strong analytical skills and comfort working with large or complex billing datasets.

  • Ability to investigate discrepancies across multiple systems and identify root causes.

  • Strong understanding of billing, AR, reconciliation, and financial control concepts.

  • Experience with SOX controls or operating in a controlled financial environment is preferred.

  • Experience with ERP, billing, payment, CRM, and data/reporting tools.

  • SQL or similar data-analysis experience is a plus.

  • Ability to communicate effectively across both Finance and technical teams.

  • Strong automation and process-improvement mindset.

What Success Looks Like

You help build a highly automated and scalable usage-to-cash engine for Fireworks AI. Usage is translated into accurate customer bills, exceptions are identified before they become material problems, receivables are actively managed, and Finance has confidence in the completeness and accuracy of PAYG billing as transaction volumes grow.

Why Fireworks?

  • Solve Hard Problems: Tackle challenges at the forefront of AI infrastructure, from low-latency inference to scalable model serving.

  • Build What’s Next: Work with bleeding-edge technology that impacts how businesses and developers harness AI globally.

  • Ownership & Impact: Join a fast-growing, passionate team where your work directly shapes the future of AI—no bureaucracy, just results.

  • Learn from the Best: Collaborate with world-class engineers and AI researchers who thrive on curiosity and innovation.

Fireworks AI is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all innovators.

raw.title: Head of AI Enabled Business Systems
raw.description:
About Us:

Fireworks is the platform for specialized intelligence, enabling companies to build, train, and serve AI models tailored to their own data, workflows, and products. Founded by the team behind PyTorch and backed by AMD, Atreides, Benchmark Capital, Index Ventures, Lightspeed, NVIDIA, Sequoia Capital, and TCV, Fireworks powers production AI with hundreds of state-of-the-art open models across text, image, embedding, audio, and multimodal workloads. Today, Fireworks is a Series D company valued at $17.5 billion, bringing together an ambitious, collaborative team that's building the future of enterprise AI.

About the Role

We are looking for a Head of Business Systems to build and lead the systems, processes, and technology foundation that enables our company to scale.


As we grow, the complexity of our business is increasing across GTM, Accounting&Finance, Data team and Operations. This role will own the strategy and execution for the business applications and workflows that connect these teams, ensuring our systems are scalable, integrated, secure, and designed around how the business actually operates.
You will be responsible for defining our business systems roadmap, building a high-performing team, improving core enterprise platforms, driving automation and AI adoption, and partnering closely with business leaders to translate operational needs into durable systems and processes.

A key part of this role will be establishing how AI tools and AI-enabled capabilities integrate into the broader enterprise technology ecosystem. You will evaluate, implement, and govern AI tooling that improves employee productivity, automates business workflows, and extends the capabilities of existing enterprise applications while ensuring appropriate security, data, and governance standards.

This is a highly cross-functional leadership role for someone who can operate at both the strategic and execution level: setting architecture and governance standards while also driving complex transformation programs to completion.

What You’ll Own

Business Systems Strategy & Architecture

  • Define and own the company-wide business systems strategy, architecture, and multi-year roadmap.

  • Establish a scalable application ecosystem across core functions starting with centralized finance and connect upper stream and down stream applications.

  • Evaluate when to buy, build, consolidate, integrate, or retire systems.

  • Develop standards for system architecture, integrations, data ownership, automation, and application lifecycle management.

  • Define an enterprise approach for evaluating and integrating AI tools, AI-enabled applications, and agentic capabilities into the business systems architecture.

  • Ensure the technology stack evolves ahead of the company's growth rather than becoming a constraint on it.

Enterprise Applications

  • Own the portfolio of critical business applications, which may include platforms such as Oracle Netsuite, Ironclad, Ramp, and other related systems.

  • Establish clear platform ownership, governance, administration, development, and support models.

  • Improve reliability, usability, scalability, and adoption of business-critical systems.

  • Partner with Security and IT to ensure appropriate access controls, compliance, resilience, and vendor risk management.

  • Establish standards for the adoption and administration of AI-enabled features and third-party AI tools connected to enterprise applications and company data.

Business Process & Automation

  • Partner with functional leaders to redesign workflows and eliminate unnecessary operational complexity.

  • Identify opportunities to automate high-volume or manual processes using workflow platforms, APIs, AI, and emerging technologies.

  • Evaluate and implement AI tooling, including AI assistants, copilots, intelligent workflow automation, and agentic solutions, where they can materially improve productivity, decision-making, or operational efficiency.

  • Build reusable integration and automation capabilities rather than isolated point solutions.

  • Establish metrics for process efficiency, system adoption, automation coverage, AI tooling adoption and impact, and operational quality.

Data & Integration

  • Create a coherent integration strategy across enterprise applications and data platforms.

  • Improve the consistency and reliability of core business data across systems.

  • Establish clear systems of record, data ownership, and governance for critical business entities such as customers, products, employees, contracts, and financial data.

  • Define how AI tools and agents securely access, use, and interact with enterprise data, APIs, and systems of record.

  • Partner with Data and Analytics teams to ensure operational systems produce trusted, accessible data for reporting and decision-making.

Transformation Programs

  • Lead major cross-functional systems initiatives such as CRM transformation, quote-to-cash, lead-to-revenue, procure-to-pay, hire-to-retire, financial systems modernization, AI-enabled workflow transformation, or global expansion.

  • Develop clear business cases, program plans, governance structures, and success metrics for major investments.

  • Coordinate stakeholders across business functions, Engineering, IT, Security, Finance, and external implementation partners.

  • Ensure programs deliver measurable business outcomes, not simply technology deployments.

Team Leadership

  • Build and lead a high-performing Business Systems organization spanning platform owners, business systems analysts, developers, architects, and program managers.

  • Define the operating model, organizational structure, and capabilities needed as the company scales.

  • Hire, develop, and retain exceptional systems talent.

  • Build AI fluency within the Business Systems organization and establish the technical capabilities required to evaluate, integrate, and operate AI-enabled solutions.

  • Create a culture of strong ownership, customer orientation, technical excellence, and pragmatic execution.

Vendor & Investment Management

  • Own or influence a significant portfolio of enterprise software and services spend.

  • Live with Finance, Procurement, partner with Security, and Legal on vendor selection, negotiation, implementation, and renewal.

  • Evaluate AI technology vendors and platforms based on business value, integration capabilities, data security, governance, scalability, and total cost of ownership.

  • Rationalize overlapping tools and improve return on technology investment.

  • Develop investment frameworks that balance speed, scalability, control, and total cost of ownership.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 12–18 months, you will have:

  • Established a clear business systems architecture and roadmap aligned to company growth.

  • Improved the reliability and scalability of the company's most critical enterprise platforms.

  • Reduced manual work and operational friction through automation and process redesign.

  • Established a clear strategy and governance model for AI tooling and delivered high-value AI-enabled workflows across the business.

  • Created stronger ownership and governance for business applications and core business data.

  • Delivered one or more major cross-functional transformation programs.

  • Improved visibility into systems spend, platform health, adoption, and technology ROI.

  • Built a strong Business Systems team capable of supporting the next stage of company growth.

What We’re Looking For

  • 12+ years of experience across Business Systems, Enterprise Applications, IT, Business Technology, or related functions.

  • 5+ years leading teams in a rapidly growing or complex enterprise environment.

  • Demonstrated ownership of large-scale enterprise application portfolios and transformation initiatives.

  • Deep experience with one or more major enterprise platforms such as Salesforce,, NetSuite, Oracle, Billing platforms, or comparable systems.

  • Strong understanding of enterprise architecture, integrations, APIs, workflow automation, identity, data governance, and SaaS operating models.

  • Experience evaluating, implementing, and integrating AI tools or AI-enabled capabilities into enterprise applications and business workflows.

  • Understanding of the architecture and governance considerations associated with enterprise AI, including data access, APIs, permissions, security, human-in-the-loop controls, and AI agent integration.

  • Experience designing and improving end-to-end business processes across multiple functions.

  • Proven ability to partner with senior leaders and translate business strategy into systems and operational capabilities.

  • Strong program management and change management skills.

  • Experience managing systems integrators, consultants, software vendors, and significant technology budgets.

  • Ability to move fluidly between executive-level strategy, architecture decisions, organizational design, and hands-on problem solving.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience scaling business systems through periods of rapid headcount, geographic, product, or revenue growth.

  • Experience supporting a public company or organizations operating with SOX or similar regulatory requirements.

  • Experience with modern integration and automation platforms and AI tools.

  • Experience with enterprise AI platforms, AI assistants/copilots, agentic workflows, or AI orchestration technologies.

  • Familiarity with modern data platforms and architectures.

  • Experience introducing AI-enabled automation into enterprise workflows.

  • Experience developing governance, security, and operating standards for AI tools connected to enterprise systems and data.

  • Experience supporting international operations, M&A integration, or multi-entity environments.

Leadership Profile

The ideal candidate is:

  • Business-first: Starts with the operating problem rather than the technology.

  • Architecturally minded: Builds systems that work together rather than accumulating disconnected tools.

  • Pragmatic: Knows when to optimize, when to simplify, and when “good enough” is the right answer.

  • Highly accountable: Owns outcomes from strategy through implementation and adoption.

  • Influential: Can align executives and teams with competing priorities.

  • Scalable in thinking: Designs for where the company is going, not only where it is today.

  • Technically credible: Can engage deeply with architects, developers, security teams, vendors, and AI technology partners while communicating clearly with business leaders.

Reporting & Scope

This role will report to the Head of Finance and Operations and will partner closely with leaders across Finance, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, People, Legal, Security, Data, and Engineering.
The role will lead the Business Systems / Enterprise Applications organization and will be responsible for a portfolio of critical enterprise applications, integrations, automation platforms, AI tooling, and transformation programs.

Why Fireworks?

  • Solve Hard Problems: Tackle challenges at the forefront of AI infrastructure, from low-latency inference to scalable model serving.

  • Build What’s Next: Work with bleeding-edge technology that impacts how businesses and developers harness AI globally.

  • Ownership & Impact: Join a fast-growing, passionate team where your work directly shapes the future of AI—no bureaucracy, just results.

  • Learn from the Best: Collaborate with world-class engineers and AI researchers who thrive on curiosity and innovation.

Fireworks AI is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all innovators.

raw.title: IT DevOps Engineer
raw.description:
About Us:

Fireworks is the platform for specialized intelligence, enabling companies to build, train, and serve AI models tailored to their own data, workflows, and products. Founded by the team behind PyTorch and backed by AMD, Atreides, Benchmark Capital, Index Ventures, Lightspeed, NVIDIA, Sequoia Capital, and TCV, Fireworks powers production AI with hundreds of state-of-the-art open models across text, image, embedding, audio, and multimodal workloads. Today, Fireworks is a Series D company valued at $17.5 billion, bringing together an ambitious, collaborative team that's building the future of enterprise AI.

About the Role

Fireworks serves billions of API requests a day, and the work of getting a model from merged to serving still passes through too many hands. Deploys wait on someone to run a step. Alerts land in a channel and wait for a human to route them. Provisioning a customer means clicking through three systems in the right order. Every one of those is a workflow nobody has written down as code yet.

You will own the systems that close those gaps. That means running our CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code stack, and it also means building the automation layer above it — the orchestrated workflows, webhooks, and API integrations that connect model deployment to the internal systems around it. You will be the person the team asks about our API surface: how it authenticates, how it rate-limits, what breaks under load. You will spend as much time in n8n and Python as in Terraform and Kubernetes.

The role sits in IT and operates as a peer to Platform Engineering — you co-own the delivery path rather than filing requests against it, and you carry decisions on their merits rather than through an org chart. High autonomy, few templates, and the freedom to choose tools that earn their place.

 

What You’ll Own

ORCHESTRATE THE AUTOMATION LAYER

  • Workflow architecture. Design, deploy, and maintain mission-critical workflows in n8n or an equivalent orchestrator, with real error-handling paths rather than happy-path scripts.

  • Operational automation. Replace manual runbook steps — engineering alerts, product provisioning, routine ops — with event-driven workflows that route themselves.

  • Custom nodes and logic. Build the custom nodes, webhooks, and functions the off-the-shelf integrations do not cover.

OWN THE API SURFACE

  • Integration design. Design and secure internal and external integrations across REST, GraphQL, and webhooks, including OAuth2, mTLS, and API-key auth.

  • High-throughput data flows. Handle rate limits, retries, backpressure, and payload validation so integrations degrade predictably instead of silently.

  • Contract testing. Mock, test, and version APIs so a downstream change surfaces in CI rather than in production.

CO-OWN DELIVERY INFRASTRUCTURE

  • CI/CD for model deploys. Co-own the deploy pipelines with Platform Engineering as a peer — tuned for fast AI model and infrastructure rollouts with zero downtime.

  • Infrastructure as code. Provision multi-cloud environments in Terraform, OpenTofu, or Pulumi — reviewed, reproducible, no console drift.

  • Containers and Kubernetes. Package and scale GPU and CPU workloads on EKS, GKE, or AKS with attention to utilization, not just uptime.

MAKE FAILURE VISIBLE

  • Observability. Instrument pipelines and workflows with Prometheus, Grafana, or Datadog so a stalled automation pages someone before a customer notices.

  • Self-healing paths. Build retry, fallback, and escalation logic into workflows so the common failures resolve without a human.

  • Documentation as infrastructure. Keep the workflow map and runbooks current enough that someone else can debug your automation at 2am.

 

What We’re Looking For

  • Two languages, deep. 6+ years building production systems, with strong Python plus JavaScript or TypeScript — clean, modular, async code, not glue scripts.

  • Workflow orchestration. Hands-on expertise with n8n, Temporal, Make, or a comparable platform, including custom nodes and error-handling design.

  • API fluency. You reason in payloads and endpoints: REST and GraphQL, webhooks, gateways, proxying, and the auth mechanisms behind them.

  • CI/CD ownership. You have owned pipelines in GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Jenkins through real scale and real incidents.

  • Cloud and containers. Production Kubernetes on AWS or GCP, with Terraform as your default way to change infrastructure.

  • Automation instinct. Your reflex after fixing something twice is to make the third time impossible.

  • Standing across teams. You have held technical ownership that crossed a team boundary, and earned it on judgment rather than reporting line.

  • Comfort with speed. You enjoy that the tooling landscape in generative AI shifts every quarter, and you evaluate new tools without chasing them.

Why Fireworks?

  • Solve Hard Problems: Tackle challenges at the forefront of AI infrastructure, from low-latency inference to scalable model serving.

  • Build What’s Next: Work with bleeding-edge technology that impacts how businesses and developers harness AI globally.

  • Ownership & Impact: Join a fast-growing, passionate team where your work directly shapes the future of AI—no bureaucracy, just results.

  • Learn from the Best: Collaborate with world-class engineers and AI researchers who thrive on curiosity and innovation.

Fireworks AI is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all innovators.

Today, Fireworks is a Series D company valued at $17.5 billion, bringing together an ambitious, collaborative team that's building the future of enterprise AI.

About the Role

Fireworks serves billions of API requests a day, and the work of getting a model from merged to serving still passes through too many hands. Deploys wait on someone to run a step. Alerts land in a channel and wait for a human to route them. Provisioning a customer means clicking through three systems in the right order. Every one of those is a workflow nobody has written down as code yet.

You will own the systems that close those gaps. That means running our CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code stack, and it also means building the automation layer above it — the orchestrated workflows, webhooks, and API integrations that connect model deployment to the internal systems around it. You will be the person the team asks about our API surface: how it authenticates, how it rate-limits, what breaks under load. You will spend as much time in n8n and Python as in Terraform and Kubernetes.

The role sits in IT and operates as a peer to Platform Engineering — you co-own the delivery path rather than filing requests against it, and you carry decisions on their merits rather than through an org chart. High autonomy, few templates, and the freedom to choose tools that earn their place.

ORCHESTRATE THE AUTOMATION LAYER

 - Workflow architecture.  Design, deploy, and maintain mission-critical workflows in n8n or an equivalent orchestrator, with real error-handling paths rather than happy-path scripts.

 - Operational automation.  Replace manual runbook steps — engineering alerts, product provisioning, routine ops — with event-driven workflows that route themselves.

 - Custom nodes and logic.  Build the custom nodes, webhooks, and functions the off-the-shelf integrations do not cover.

 - Integration design.  Design and secure internal and external integrations across REST, GraphQL, and webhooks, including OAuth2, mTLS, and API-key auth.

 - High-throughput data flows.  Handle rate limits, retries, backpressure, and payload validation so integrations degrade predictably instead of silently.

 - Contract testing.  Mock, test, and version APIs so a downstream change surfaces in CI rather than in production.

 - CI/CD for model deploys.  Co-own the deploy pipelines with Platform Engineering as a peer — tuned for fast AI model and infrastructure rollouts with zero downtime.

 - Containers and Kubernetes.  Package and scale GPU and CPU workloads on EKS, GKE, or AKS with attention to utilization, not just uptime.

raw.description:

THE ROLE

We are seeking the first Data Analytics Engineer at Fireworks who will support our product management team.

You will define canonical metrics that measure user behavior, product performance, system performance, and financial measures. You’ll ensure the metrics accurately measure what the business needs to know and that they are socialized and understood across teams and senior leaders. You will extend and improve our data model, write pipelines to compute metrics, and partner with the data platform team to put them into production following rigorous engineering standards.

You’re a good fit for this role if you enjoy operating highly autonomously, if your working style stresses both efficiency and correctness, and if you love bringing structure to complex and messy questions.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Required

  • 5+ years in data science, product analytics, analytics engineering, or a combination.

  • Experience defining, analyzing, and aligning business users on shared metrics.

  • Experience building or working on production data pipelines, hands-on.

  • Proficiency in SQL, Python, or similar languages.

  • Excellent communication with senior level stakeholders, technical and non-technical.

  • Demonstrated autonomy in an environment with open ended problems.

  • Availability to work in office in San Mateo 3x days per week.

Preferred

  • Experience analyzing performance of self-service developer-facing products.

  • dbt, Coalesce, or a similar transformation framework in production — models, tests, docs, shared repo

  • Background in AI infrastructure including inference, GPU-hour metering, attributing revenue to mixed model use, etc.

raw.title: Product Manager - Growth
raw.description:
About Us:

Today, Fireworks is a Series D company valued at $17.5 billion, bringing together an ambitious, collaborative team that's building the future of enterprise AI.

The Role

As a Product Manager, Growth, you're going to play a critical role driving growth and adoption for our product portfolio. You will improve how developers discover our platform, reach a successful model call, come back, and expand. The surface areas include inference, training, nexus, and the product around them: signup, docs, API and playground flows, model choice, errors, pricing, and the path from first request to a workflow someone relies on.

Responsibilities

  • Build and run a roadmap across acquisition, activation, retention, and monetization. Choose the few bets that change adoption, and leave the rest.

  • Take features from ideas through launch across the product suite. Own the developer moments that decide whether someone succeeds: time to first working request, a useful error, docs that match the product, a default model that is the right one, and a reason to come back.

  • Analyze product metrics and use behavior to identify gaps and validate fixes

  • Work across engineers, marketing, design, and product to drive broad cross functional execution

  • Spend time with developers. Learn how they actually build, including auth, model choice, latency, cost, evals, and the first time a call fails. Bring that context back in a form the team can build from.

  • Drive execution across engineering, design, marketing, and product so growth shows up in the product, not in a side project.

Experience

  • Strong analytical skills, with hands-on experience in A/B testing and funnel optimization

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, and a track record of aligning engineers, designers, and go-to-market partners around a shared plan

  • Thrives in ambiguous, extremely fast-paced environments, and can turn incomplete information into a clear next step

  • Technical background, including Bachelor/Masters degree in CS

Preferred Qualifications

  • 6+ years of product management experience, with the majority in developer experience or growth PM roles

  • Experience shipping on widely used products, with a bonus for consumption-based products

  • Experience building PLG and self-serve inside a business that also runs a sales-led motion

raw.title: People Operations Specialist
raw.description:
About Us:

Fireworks is the platform for specialized intelligence, enabling companies to build, train, and serve AI models tailored to their own data, workflows, and products. Founded by the team behind PyTorch and backed by AMD, Atreides, Benchmark Capital, Index Ventures, Lightspeed, NVIDIA, Sequoia Capital, and TCV, Fireworks powers production AI with hundreds of state-of-the-art open models across text, image, embedding, audio, and multimodal workloads. Today, Fireworks is a Series D company valued at $17.5 billion, bringing together an ambitious, collaborative team that's building the future of enterprise AI.

About the Role

We're looking for a hands-on People Operations Specialist to join our People team and keep our day-to-day people operations running smoothly. You'll work side by side with the broader HR team — HRBP, People Ops, Recruiting, and Immigration — to make sure the many moving pieces of a fast-growing company land cleanly: new hires onboard without a hitch, our systems and data stay accurate, and employees get quick, clear answers when they have questions.

This role is ideal for someone early in their HR career who wants breadth. You'll touch HRIS, onboarding, contractor operations, immigration support, internal documentation, and employee recognition — and you'll get real ownership in each area. We're looking for someone who's highly organized, comfortable shifting priorities, and able to unblock themselves and keep things moving without waiting to be told how.

What You'll Do

HRIS & Data Integrity

  • Own day-to-day updates in our HRIS — start date changes, title and job detail adjustments, reporting line changes, and other employee record maintenance.

  • Run regular internal data audits to catch and correct discrepancies before they become downstream problems for payroll, benefits, or reporting.

  • Partner with People Ops, Finance, and IT to keep employee data consistent across systems.

Onboarding Logistics

  • Coordinate end-to-end onboarding logistics for new hires so their first day is seamless, including:

    • Monitoring background check status and following up on anything pending or flagged.

    • Completing I-9 verifications and driving follow-ups to ensure timely, compliant completion.

    • Coordinating with IT on laptop provisioning, email and account setup, and name or address changes.

    • Managing seat assignments and workspace readiness in partnership with Workplace.

    • Ordering and preparing new hire swag and welcome materials.

  • Help facilitate our weekly new hire onboarding sessions — prepping materials, managing logistics and the calendar, presenting portions of the agenda, and gathering feedback to improve the experience over time.

  • Serve as a friendly first point of contact for new hires, answering pre-start and first-week questions.

Contractor Lifecycle Management

  • Own the contractor lifecycle end to end: onboarding (agreements, signatures, background check bypass proof), contract timeline tracking (start and end dates, early expiration flags, extensions and conversions with managers and Finance), and offboarding (access and equipment return with IT, final documentation).

  • Keep contractor records, status, and dates accurate at every stage.

Immigration Support

  • Support immigration case processing in partnership with our People team and outside counsel — gathering documents, tracking case status, and keeping timelines on track.

  • Handle basic immigration questions from employees, candidates, and the recruiting team, escalating complex matters appropriately.

  • Maintain accurate immigration records and calendar key deadlines and expirations.

Internal Documentation

  • Own our internal HR wiki — keeping pages current, accurate, and easy to navigate as policies and processes evolve.

  • Document new and changed processes so the team has a reliable single source of truth.

Employee Recognition

  • Support administration of our recognition program, including managing award winner prizes, swag, and fulfillment logistics.

  • Help keep the program visible and running on a consistent cadence.

What We're Looking For

  • Degree in Human Resources or a related field, plus 2-3 years of experience in an HR Generalist or HR Specialist role.

  • Highly organized, with a track record of juggling a wide span of workstreams and keeping details from slipping through the cracks.

  • Resourceful and self-directed — comfortable figuring out a solution when there's no playbook, and able to unblock yourself to get things done.

  • Comfortable pivoting as priorities shift, and able to re-prioritize quickly without losing track of what's still open.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with sound judgment about what to handle directly and when to escalate.

  • Discretion and good judgment in handling confidential employee information.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting immigration cases (H-1B, TN, O-1, green card processing, or similar).

  • Experience in a startup or other high-growth, fast-paced environment.

  • Hands-on experience with an HRIS such as Rippling

  • Enthusiastic, positive, and brings great energy — someone people are genuinely glad to work with.

Why Fireworks?

  • Solve Hard Problems: Tackle challenges at the forefront of AI infrastructure, from low-latency inference to scalable model serving.

  • Build What’s Next: Work with bleeding-edge technology that impacts how businesses and developers harness AI globally.

  • Ownership & Impact: Join a fast-growing, passionate team where your work directly shapes the future of AI—no bureaucracy, just results.

  • Learn from the Best: Collaborate with world-class engineers and AI researchers who thrive on curiosity and innovation.

Fireworks AI is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all innovators.
