Fireworks is the platform for specialized intelligence, enabling companies to build, train, and serve AI models tailored to their own data, workflows, and products. Founded by the team behind PyTorch and backed by AMD, Atreides, Benchmark Capital, Index Ventures, Lightspeed, NVIDIA, Sequoia Capital, and TCV, Fireworks powers production AI with hundreds of state-of-the-art open models across text, image, embedding, audio, and multimodal workloads. Today, Fireworks is a Series D company valued at $17.5 billion, bringing together an ambitious, collaborative team that's building the future of enterprise AI.

About Fireworks

Fireworks is the AI inference infrastructure platform built for teams who need speed, control, and the ability to fine-tune at scale. We're a Series C company valued at $4B, backed by Benchmark, Sequoia, Lightspeed, and Index. Our customers include Cursor, Cognition, GitHub, Meta, and a growing base of enterprise AI teams who've outgrown generic API providers.

The Role

Reporting to the Head of Sales Strategy & Analytics, the GTM Planning Lead is responsible for translating GTM strategy into capacity plans, territories, quotas, and incentive design that drives the right outcomes across direct and partner motions. You will operate as a strategic advisor to GTM and Finance leadership, balancing competitiveness, simplicity, scalability, and financial discipline.

You will lead capacity planning (HC and GPU), overall target design (booking, consumption, pipegen), that enables Fireworks’ rapid expansion across the globe. Your work will directly influence revenue predictability, seller behavior, retention, and long-term growth.

Consumption, commit and usage economics are core to how we sell and how our business grows. The right candidate has intimate knowledge of business models that rely on a usage-based or hybrid commercial model — not only license ARR — and can design capacity plans that meet our strategic objectives.

raw.title: Senior Software Engineer (Pittsburgh)
raw.description:
About Gray Swan

Gray Swan is on a mission to empower the world to use AI safely and securely. We evaluate AI models for the leading frontier labs along with building real-time threat detection and adaptive adversarial red teaming agents for teams deploying AI.

We're a team of approximately 50 people, well-funded, growing quickly. Our work directly influences how the world deploys AI agents and systems at scale..

Learn more about how we work.

The Role

We’re looking for a software engineer who wants to build things end to end and doesn’t mind getting their hands dirty. You’ll work across the stack—frontend, backend APIs, and databases—helping us turn ideas into real product and improve what’s already in production.

You don’t need to have used every tool we use. What matters is that you have solid full-stack experience, pick up new technologies quickly, and are comfortable owning work without a lot of process or hand-holding. We are still in the early stages of our growth, so if you like autonomy, responsibility, and moving fast, then please apply for this opportunity!

What You’ll Do:

  • Design and develop web applications using modern frontend frameworks like Svelte

  • Build intuitive and user-friendly interfaces that delight users

  • Develop and maintain backend APIs using tools like FastAPI

  • Manage and optimize database systems like MongoDB

  • Collaborate with our ML research team to integrate AI experiences into our products

Who You Are:

  • Proficiency in TypeScript or JavaScript

  • Experience with frontend frameworks such as React, Vue, or Svelte

  • Solid understanding of HTML and CSS

  • Hands-on experience building backend APIs

  • Knowledge of database systems (SQL or NoSQL; MongoDB is a plus)

Bonus Points If You Have:

  • SvelteKit experience

  • Python proficiency and AI/ML framework exposure

  • Experience in creating AI-driven applications

  • Experience deploying and scaling applications on cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Google Cloud, Azure)

  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices to streamline development workflows

  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and mitigating vulnerabilities in web applications

  • Contributions to open-source projects or an active GitHub/portfolio showcasing relevant work

  • Experience with testing frameworks (e.g., Jest, Playwright) to ensure code quality

  • Understanding of AI safety principles or ethical considerations in AI systems

If you don’t have 100% of these, you should still seriously consider applying. We care more about what you can do than your credentials.

You’ll Thrive Here If You:

  • You've learned things about your code only production traffic can teach

  • You're comfortable debugging across the stack – from browser devtools to database query plans.

  • You've worked in environments where moving fast matters and you know how to balance speed with sustainability.

  • You're interested in applying your security mindset to AI, where the threat model is still being written

What We Offer:

We offer a competitive compensation package designed to reward impact and incentivize growth. Our compensation philosophy is informed by our current valuation and recent industry data.

Compensation: $180k-$220k plus performance based bonus and meaningful equity package

Benefits:

  • 401k with up to 4% matching

  • 28 days annual leave (vacation + holidays)

  • Health, dental, and vision coverage

  • Catered lunches (Pittsburgh office)

  • Flexible work arrangements

  • Visa sponsorship available for exceptional candidates

Typical Interview Process

🔎 Application review. We read everything; we’ll respond within 10 days.

🗣 Recruiter Screen. We learn about you; you learn about us.

🧑‍💻 Technical interview or Hiring Manager Interview.

💻 Role related assesment

🗣 Experience & culture interview

😇 Reference checks. We’ll reach out to 3-5 references that you provide.

📃 Offer. If it’s mutual, we move fast.

How to Apply

Submit your resume, link to your portfolio, and answer the questions on the application.

You’ll work hands-on with customer teams to integrate Gray Swan’s AI security platform into complex production systems, translating ambiguous, high-stakes requirements into reliable, scalable deployments.

This role is ideal for engineers who don’t want to work on the same narrow surface area every day. You’ll operate at the intersection of software engineering, systems integration, and customer delivery, partnering closely with customers, sales, product, and core engineering teams. You’ll own outcomes end-to-end and operate effectively in fast-moving, customer-facing environments where reliability, security, and trust matter.

  • Work directly with engineering, security, and platform teams to understand system architectures, constraints, and operational realities.

  • Design and implement integrations between Gray Swan’s platform and customer systems, APIs, data pipelines, and runtime environments.

  • Translate real-world enterprise requirements into well-scoped proofs of concept, deployment plans, and production architectures.

  • Act as the primary technical owner for customer deployments, rapidly identifying, scoping, and resolving issues across environments.

  • Build and extend backend services, integrations, and tooling to support secure deployment in diverse customer environments.

  • Ensure deployments meet enterprise expectations for reliability, security, observability, and maintainability.

  • Develop proofs of concept quickly to validate technical feasibility and customer value.

  • Iterate based on user feedback, operational learnings, and evolving requirements.

  • Balance speed with long-term maintainability and platform consistency.

  • Partner closely with sales, product, and core engineering teams to deliver successful customer outcomes.

  • Communicate technical findings, tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly to both internal teams and customers.

What You Bring:

  • Hands-on experience building and deploying production-grade software systems.

  • Strong background in backend or full-stack software engineering, with experience designing APIs, services, and integrations.

  • Familiarity with cloud-native architectures and distributed systems, including AWS, GCP, or Azure.

  • Experience working in ambiguous, fast-moving environments and taking full ownership of outcomes.

  • Comfort working directly with customers and external stakeholders on technical delivery.

  • Strong programming experience in Python and at least one systems or backend-oriented language (e.g., Go, Java, C++, Rust).

  • Experience working with data pipelines, event-driven systems, or service-oriented architectures.

  • Understanding of security fundamentals, such as authentication, authorization, monitoring, and secure system design.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field is required.

Bonus Points If You Have:

  • Experience deploying or integrating enterprise software into customer environments.

  • Background in security, infrastructure, or platform engineering.

  • Familiarity with AI systems, ML-enabled products, or AI security concepts (not required to build models).

  • Experience in forward-deployed engineering, technical consulting, technical pre-sales, or customer-facing engineering roles.

Gray Swan is on a mission to empower the world to use AI safely and securely. We evaluate AI models for the leading frontier labs along with building real-time threat detection and adaptive adversarial red teaming agents for teams deploying AI.

Learn more about how we work.

The Role

As an Account Executive at Gray Swan AI, you’ll own enterprise sales cycles end-to-end for a highly technical AI safety and security platform. This is not a replacement-level software sales role. We’re looking for someone who can operate credibly with technical buyers, learn complex products quickly, and thrive in a fast-moving startup environment where ownership and initiative matter.

You’ll work closely with founders, engineering, and product to turn inbound interest into paid pilots and long-term production deployments. This role blends enterprise selling, technical curiosity, and startup hustle, with significant autonomy and upside.

If you’re energized by building something early, working hard, and closing meaningful six-figure deals in a new and rapidly evolving market, this role is likely a great fit.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own the full sales cycle from first conversation through close, often starting with paid pilots and expanding to production deployments.

  • Sell a complete AI safety and security platform, including automated adversarial testing/ red teaming and runtime defensive solutions for AI systems.

  • Build credibility with technical and executive stakeholders across AI, security, and engineering teams.

  • Learn and communicate technical concepts clearly, working closely with internal technical teams to scope solutions and answer customer questions.

  • Engage buyers in regulated and high-stakes industries such as financial services, healthcare, and insurance.

  • Generate pipeline through a mix of inbound leads, conference networking, referrals, and outbound efforts.

  • Maintain strong momentum through long, multi-stakeholder sales processes.

  • Work directly with founders, product, and engineering to shape customer pilots and deployments. Provide feedback from the field to influence product direction, positioning, and go-to-market strategy.

What You Bring:

  • Proven experience selling enterprise software or platforms, ideally in AI, security, or adjacent technical domains.

  • Comfort learning technical material and engaging with technical buyers, even if you are not an engineer by training.

  • Experience selling into or having strong relationships within AI, security, financial services, healthcare, or insurance organizations.

  • Ability to operate independently, generate pipeline, and own outcomes end-to-end.

  • Ability to thrive in early-stage startup environments, comfortable wearing multiple hats, and contributing beyond a narrowly defined sales role.

  • Highly motivated, disciplined, and willing to work hard to build something meaningful.

  • Presence, credibility, and sound judgment to customer interactions.

Bonus Points If You Have:

  • Prior experience selling highly technical or emerging technology products.

  • Existing relationships with AI labs, security teams, or enterprise engineering organizations.

  • Experience closing six-figure enterprise deals with long, consultative sales cycles.

  • Familiarity with AI safety, security, testing, or infrastructure-level software.

If you don’t have 100% of these, you should still seriously consider applying. We care more about what you can do than your credentials.

You’ll Thrive Here If You:

  • Want to help define how enterprise AI safety and security software is sold.

  • Enjoy learning complex products and explaining them clearly to customers.

  • Are motivated by ownership, accountability, and upside rather than rigid structure.

  • Are excited by Gray Swan’s mission to help organizations deploy AI safely and securely.

What We Offer:

A competitive compensation package designed to reward impact and incentivize growth. Our compensation philosophy is informed by our current valuation and recent industry data.

  • Base salary is targeted to $157k-$192k + commission ($314-$384k OTE)

  • Meaningful equity participation

  • Work from our office in Pittsburgh, or remotely

  • Opportunity for outsized earnings driven by high inbound interest and large deal sizes

Benefits:

  • 401k with up to 4% matching

  • 28 days annual leave (vacation + holidays)

  • Health, dental, and vision coverage

 - Ability to thrive in early-stage startup environments, comfortable wearing multiple hats, and contributing beyond a narrowly defined sales role.

 - Prior experience selling highly technical or emerging technology products.

 - Existing relationships with AI labs, security teams, or enterprise engineering organizations.

About Gray Swan

Gray Swan is on a mission to empower the world to use AI safely and securely. We evaluate AI models for the leading frontier labs along with building real-time threat detection and adaptive adversarial red teaming agents for teams deploying AI.

We're a team of approximately 50 people, well-funded, growing quickly. Our work directly influences how the world deploys AI agents and systems at scale.

Learn more about how we work.

The Role

As a Machine Learning Engineer at Gray Swan AI, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the future of AI safety solutions.

Research at Gray Swan AI is tightly tied to real-world impact. AI security is not a solved problem, and this role is a mix of applied research and system building: developing new approaches to adversarial testing, model evaluation, and robust inference that directly inform how secure AI systems are deployed in practice. You will work at the boundary between research and production, translating novel ideas into scalable AI systems that withstand adversarial pressure.

Your expertise in state-of-the-art deep learning architectures, distributed systems, and parallel computing will enable you to tackle complex challenges associated with resource-intensive models. You will be responsible for advancing our methodologies for controlling, monitoring, and analyzing these models, ensuring they meet the rigorous demands of production environments.

Join Gray Swan AI to work alongside leading minds in AI safety and apply your technical depth to problems that genuinely matter!

What You’ll Do

  • Lead the design, development, and deployment of advanced machine learning models to enhance system performance and scalability.

  • Tackle complex challenges associated with resource-intensive models using distributed systems and parallel computing.

  • Advance methodologies for controlling, monitoring, and analyzing machine learning models in production environments.

  • Develop new approaches to adversarial testing, model evaluation, and robust inference.

  • Translate research ideas into scalable AI systems deployed in real-world, adversarial settings.

  • Work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure research outcomes inform production systems.

Who You Are

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Engineering, or a related technical field is required.

Experience

  • Experience in building and deploying machine learning models and systems.

  • Demonstrated expertise in designing, training, and deploying deep learning models with frameworks like PyTorch.

  • Strong programming experience in Python and C++ (preferred)

  • Practical experience developing scalable machine learning pipelines and integrating them with cloud infrastructure (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure).

  • Experience conducting ML research, including building research prototype systems, experiment design, empirical analysis of results, and communicating results via publications.

  • Good to have: experience with modern ML methods such as LLMs (training, finetuning, and/or analyzing), synthetic data generation pipelines, and AI safety or security work.

Core Technical Skills

  • In-depth knowledge of neural network architectures, including sequence models, transformers, and other state-of-the-art approaches.

  • Strong algorithmic problem-solving skills and comprehensive knowledge of ML theory and optimization techniques.

  • Proficiency in data preprocessing, transformation, and handling large-scale, multi-modal datasets.

Bonus Points If You Have

  • Experience with AI safety practices such as model validation, robustness testing, and continuous monitoring for safety and security incidents throughout deployment.

  • Experience with AI safety and security assessments and adversarial testing.

You’ll Thrive Here If

  • You are genuinely excited by the intersection of research and engineering, and want to both develop new AI safety ideas and see them running in real systems.

  • You are motivated by real-world impact and want your work to directly influence how major AI companies deploy models right now (we work with many of the leading AI labs).

  • You are eager to deepen your AI safety expertise by working alongside a team that includes some of the most respected and influential thinkers in the field.

  • You thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic startup environment where ambiguity is expected.

  • You bring strong collaboration and problem-solving skills, with a focus on driving meaningful, lasting impact.

Compensation & Benefits

We offer a competitive compensation package designed to reward impact and incentivize growth. Our compensation philosophy is informed by our current valuation and recent industry data.

Salary: $160-257k, depending on level, plus performance-based bonus and a competitive equity package

Benefits:

  • 401k with up to 4% matching

  • 28 days annual leave (vacation + holidays)

  • Health, dental, and vision coverage

  • Catered lunches (Pittsburgh office)

  • Flexible work arrangements

  • Visa sponsorship available for exceptional candidates

🔎 Application review. We read everything; we’ll respond within 10 days.

🗣 Recruiter Screen. We learn about you; you learn about us.

🧑‍💻 Technical interview or Hiring Manager Interview.

💻 Role related assesment

🗣 Experience & culture interview

😇 Reference checks. We’ll reach out to 3-5 references that you provide.

📃 Offer. If it’s mutual, we move fast.

raw.title: Arena Growth Marketing Manager (Pittsburgh or Remote U.S.)
raw.description:
About Gray Swan

Gray Swan is on a mission to empower the world to use AI safely and securely. We evaluate AI models for the leading frontier labs along with building real-time threat detection and adaptive adversarial red teaming agents for teams deploying AI.

We're a team of approximately 50 people, well-funded, growing quickly. Our work directly influences how the world deploys AI agents and systems at scale..

Learn more about how we work.

About Arena

The Gray Swan Arena is where the world's top frontier labs send their AI models to be stress-tested by our community of over 15,000 red teamers..

AI Researchers, security specialists, prompt engineers, and AI enthusiasts participate in challenges that uncover vulnerabilities, reveal model weaknesses, and generate valuable safety insights. Participants are not only incentivized by recognition and prizes, but for the opportunity to directly influence the future of AI safety and security.

We're building the premier destination for AI security talent. We're looking for someone who can help us scale it.

The Role

We're looking for an Arena Marketing Manager to own user acquisition, engagement, and community growth for Arena.

This is not a traditional marketing role.

You'll be responsible for growing a highly technical audience of AI red-teamers, security researchers, hackers, builders, and AI safety enthusiasts. You'll design experiments, launch campaigns, build partnerships, manage creators and influencers, activate communities, and develop repeatable growth engines that increase participation across Arena challenges.

Success in this role means attracting more qualified participants, increasing challenge engagement, and helping Arena become the default place where top AI security talent gathers.

You'll work closely with product, research, partnerships, and leadership teams while having significant autonomy to shape strategy and execution.

What You’ll Do:

Drive User Growth

  • Own participant acquisition strategy across multiple channels

  • Design and execute growth experiments across social, influencer, community, partnership, event, and paid channels

  • Identify high-performing acquisition channels and scale what works

  • Build repeatable growth systems that increase registrations, challenge participation, and retention

Own Challenge Launch Marketing

  • Develop and execute go-to-market plans for Arena challenges

  • Lead challenge announcements, launch campaigns, and ongoing promotional efforts

  • Coordinate with AI lab partners and internal teams to maximize visibility and participation

  • Create launch playbooks that improve performance over time

Build and Grow the Arena Community

  • Own Arena's community presence, particularly within Discord

  • Develop engagement programs, events, activations, and community initiatives that increase participation and retention

  • Foster a culture that attracts elite AI red-teamers and technical contributors

  • Surface community insights that improve both marketing and product decisions

Expand Partnerships & Influencer Programs

  • Grow relationships with creators, researchers, security experts, and technical influencers

  • Manage and expand strategic marketing partnerships

  • Develop systems to measure partnership and influencer ROI

  • Identify new opportunities to reach high-quality participants

Create Compelling Content

  • Help define Arena's consumer-facing brand voice

  • Translate community activity, challenge outcomes, and research insights into engaging content

  • Showcase how participant contributions influence AI safety and security research

  • Develop content that drives awareness, credibility, and participation

Measure and Optimize

  • Own acquisition, activation, engagement, and retention metrics

  • Build reporting frameworks and dashboards

  • Analyze campaign performance and make data-driven recommendations

  • Manage challenge marketing budgets for maximum impact

Support Community-Led Events

  • Research, plan, and execute hackathons, conferences, meetups, and other community events

  • Build relationships with organizations and communities aligned with Arena's mission

  • Use events as a channel for participant acquisition and brand building

Success in Your First 90 Days

  • Develop a deep understanding of Arena users and growth opportunities

  • Audit existing acquisition channels and marketing performance

  • Launch several growth experiments across multiple channels

  • Build a repeatable challenge launch process

  • Establish reporting around registrations, participation, retention, and channel ROI

  • Deliver measurable growth in qualified challenge participation


Who You Are:

  • Proven track record of driving user growth through marketing initiatives

  • Experience owning and executing multi-channel campaigns

  • Strong analytical mindset with a focus on measurable outcomes

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills

  • Comfortable moving quickly, operating independently, and experimenting frequently

  • Highly organized and capable of managing multiple projects simultaneously

  • Curious about emerging technologies and online communities

Bonus Points If You Have:

  • Experience marketing to developers, researchers, security professionals, or technical audiences

  • Experience growing online communities, especially Discord

  • Experience managing influencer or creator programs

  • Familiarity with AI, AI safety, cybersecurity, or adjacent technical ecosystems

  • Experience running hackathons, competitions, or community-driven programs

  • Conversion rate optimization and growth experimentation experience

If you don't meet every qualification, we still encourage you to apply. We care more about your ability to learn, execute, and create impact than checking every box.

What We Offer:

We offer a competitive compensation package designed to reward impact and incentivize growth. Our compensation philosophy is informed by our current valuation and recent industry data.

Compensation: $90,000-160,000 for Tier 1 locations (San Francisco, Seattle, Boston, NYC) and $80,000-$145,000 for Tier 2 (all other U.S. locations)

 

Benefits:

  • 401k with up to 4% matching

  • 28 days annual leave (vacation + holidays)

  • Health, dental, and vision coverage

  • Catered lunches (Pittsburgh office)

  • Flexible work arrangements

  • Visa sponsorship available for exceptional candidates

Typical Interview Process

🔎 Application review. We read everything; we’ll respond within 10 days.

🗣 Recruiter Screen. We learn about you; you learn about us.

🧑‍💻 Technical interview or Hiring Manager Interview.

💻 Role related assesment

🗣 Experience & culture interview

😇 Reference checks. We’ll reach out to 3-5 references that you provide.

📃 Offer. If it’s mutual, we move fast.

How to Apply

Submit your resume, link to your portfolio, and answer the questions on the application.

raw.description:
About Gray Swan

Gray Swan is on a mission to empower the world to use AI safely and securely. We evaluate AI models for the leading frontier labs along with building real-time threat detection and adaptive adversarial red teaming agents for teams deploying AI.

We're a team of approximately 50 people, well-funded, growing quickly. Our work directly influences how the world deploys AI agents and systems at scale..

Learn more about how we work.

The Role

Come build and lead Gray Swan's cyber safety capability from the ground up, serving as the technical authority on AI-enabled cyber risk across red-teaming, evaluation, benchmarking, defenses, and safety infrastructure development. You'll help define how frontier AI systems are evaluated for offensive cyber capabilities while partnering with leading AI labs to reduce real-world security risks.

This role sits at the intersection of offensive security, AI safety, and machine learning. You'll transform deep cybersecurity expertise into scalable evaluation methodologies, safety infrastructure, and automated defenses that help establish industry standards for frontier model security.

If you have deep expertise in offensive cybersecurity, vulnerability research, or adversarial AI security, experience evaluating frontier models, and are driven to reduce catastrophic cyber risks from increasingly capable AI systems, we'd love to hear from you.

What You’ll Do:

  • Design and lead adversarial evaluations of frontier LLMs for offensive cyber capabilities, including vulnerability discovery, exploit development, malware generation, privilege escalation, social engineering, persistence, and autonomous cyber operations across text, agentic, and multimodal systems.

  • Partner closely with machine learning engineers to translate cybersecurity expertise into scalable benchmarks, classifiers, guardrails, automated detection systems, and evaluation infrastructure for both internal products and frontier AI lab deployments.

  • Develop and maintain Gray Swan’s catastrophic cyber harm taxonomy, continuously evolving cyber evaluation frameworks as frontier model capabilities rapidly advance.

  • Produce technical risk assessments and actionable recommendations for frontier AI labs, enterprise customers, and internal stakeholders, helping guide responsible model deployment and security mitigations.

  • Build, mentor, and lead a world-class team of cybersecurity subject matter experts while establishing scalable evaluation processes, quality standards, and technical infrastructure.

  • Represent Gray Swan as the company's cybersecurity authority, collaborating with frontier AI labs, security researchers, government partners, and the broader AI safety and cybersecurity communities.

Who You Are:

  • Deep technical expertise in offensive cybersecurity, vulnerability research, exploit development, penetration testing, malware analysis, reverse engineering, or a closely related field through industry, research, or equivalent experience.

  • Significant experience assessing advanced cyber threats, offensive tooling, or AI-enabled cyber capabilities, especially in critical infrastructure domains.

  • Hands-on experience conducting adversarial evaluations, AI red-teaming, LLM security research, or building evaluation datasets for frontier AI systems.

  • Comfortable operating at the intersection of cybersecurity research, AI safety, and machine learning engineering.

  • Thrive in highly ambiguous, fast-moving environments where you'll define strategy while building entirely new capabilities.

  • A builder who enjoys creating teams, infrastructure, and evaluation systems from scratch.

Bonus Points If You Have:

  • Experience developing machine learning models, AI security classifiers, or automated cyber detection systems.

  • Hands-on experience red-teaming frontier language models, jailbreaking, prompt injection research, or agentic AI evaluations.

  • Experience working with frontier AI labs, national security organizations, or leading cybersecurity research teams.

  • Background in threat intelligence, autonomous cyber operations, AI agent security, or AI governance.

  • Strong software engineering experience in Python, Go, Rust, or other systems programming languages.

If you don’t have 100% of these, you should still seriously consider applying. We care more about what you can do than your credentials.

You’ll Thrive Here If You:

  • Want visibility across the frontier of AI security by evaluating multiple frontier models and working directly with the world's leading AI labs.

  • Are excited to build the infrastructure that makes AI cyber safety scalable.

  • Feel motivated to reduce catastrophic cyber risks posed by increasingly capable AI systems.

  • Enjoy turning offensive security research into practical defenses that improve the safety of frontier AI.

  • Have a vision for what world-class AI cyber safety should look like—and are excited to build it.

What We Offer:

We offer a competitive compensation package designed to reward impact and incentivize growth. Our compensation philosophy is informed by our current valuation and recent industry data.

Compensation: $230,000 - $280,000 plus performance based bonus and meaningful equity package

Benefits:

  • 401k with up to 4% matching

  • 28 days annual leave (vacation + holidays)

  • Health, dental, and vision coverage

  • Catered lunches (Pittsburgh office)

  • Flexible work arrangements

  • Visa sponsorship available for exceptional candidates

Interview Process

🔎 Application review. We read everything; we’ll respond within 10 days.

🗣 Recruiter Screen. We learn about you; you learn about us.

🧑‍💻 Technical interview or Hiring Manager Interview.

💻 Role related assesment

🗣 Experience & culture interview

😇 Reference checks. We’ll reach out to 3-5 references that you provide.

📃 Offer. If it’s mutual, we move fast.

How to Apply

Submit your resume, link to your portfolio, and answer the questions on the application.

Gray Swan is looking for an Infrastructure Engineer to build and scale the systems that power our AI security platform. You'll design the backend services, distributed infrastructure, and cloud architecture that enable Gray Swan to build AI systems and for customers to safely deploy frontier AI models at scale.

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys solving infrastructure challenges across reliability, scalability, observability, and performance. You'll work closely with machine learning engineers, product engineers, and security researchers to ensure our platform remains fast, resilient, and secure as we grow.

You'll have significant ownership over foundational systems and the opportunity to influence technical direction in a rapidly evolving AI startup.

What You’ll Do:

  • Design, build, and maintain highly available backend services and distributed systems that power Gray Swan's AI security platform.

  • Own cloud infrastructure across Kubernetes, AWS, networking, storage, and compute to ensure reliable production environments.

  • Build scalable APIs, internal platform services, and infrastructure tooling that improve developer productivity and system reliability.

  • Improve system observability through logging, metrics, tracing, dashboards, and automated alerting.

  • Optimize performance, latency, and infrastructure costs while maintaining reliability and security.

  • Partner closely with machine learning, security, and product engineering teams to deliver production-ready infrastructure for AI workloads.

Who You Are:

  • 5+ years of experience building backend infrastructure or distributed systems in production environments.

  • Strong programming skills in C/C++, Go, Python, Rust, or Java.

raw.title: Strategic Account Executive – Frontier Labs
raw.description:
About Gray Swan

Gray Swan is on a mission to empower the world to use AI safely and securely. We evaluate AI models for the leading frontier labs along with building real-time threat detection and adaptive adversarial red teaming agents for teams deploying AI.

We're a team of approximately 50 people, well-funded, growing quickly. Our work directly influences how the world deploys AI agents and systems at scale..

Learn more about how we work.

The Role

Our frontier lab business is Gray Swan's most strategic. We evaluate models for the leading AI labs before those models ship. This role owns the commercial side of those relationships end to end.

You will report to our SVP of Frontier Lab Safety and work alongside a Strategic Partnership Manager who owns technical scoping and delivery. You own the number: landing new lab accounts, converting first engagements into ongoing programs, and expanding accounts as their evaluation needs grow.

This is a small, high-trust market. A few dozen people worldwide decide how frontier AI gets evaluated, and they talk to each other. Credibility here is earned through technical fluency, discretion, and consistency, not volume outreach.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own the full commercial cycle for a portfolio of frontier lab accounts: first conversation, scoping, pricing, contract, close.

  • Carry a quota spanning both new logos and expansion within existing accounts. Most of our growth comes from deepening engagements that already exist, so renewal and upsell are as central to the role as new business.

  • Set the commercial frame on engagements while our Strategic Partnership Manager and research team set the technical one, so that scopes are both sellable and deliverable.

  • Move deals through procurement, legal, and security review at organizations that take contracting extremely seriously, maintaining momentum across multi-month cycles.

  • Build relationships across research, safety, policy, and procurement functions. The champion and the signer are rarely the same person here.

  • Bring the field back inside: what labs and agencies are being asked to prove, what they are being asked to prove it against, and where our evaluation offering needs to go next.

  • Represent Gray Swan at the conferences, workshops, and standards conversations where this market is being defined.

Who You Are:

  • 5+ years closing complex six-figure-plus enterprise or professional services deals with long, consultative, multi-stakeholder cycles.

  • Enough fluency in AI safety and evaluation to hold a real conversation about model testing, red teaming, and agentic risk. You do not need to be a researcher, but you do need to be genuinely conversant with technical buyers.

  • Experience selling into or working alongside AI labs, research organizations, or government and regulatory bodies.

  • A record of growing accounts rather than only landing them: renewals, expansions, and multi-year programs you can speak to specifically.

  • Experience operating under NDA with pre-release or otherwise sensitive customer information.

This is not …

  • Not a delivery role. Our Strategic Partnership Manager owns scope-to-milestone execution; you own the commercial relationship.

  • Not a broad enterprise territory. Our Account Executives cover financial services, healthcare, and insurance. Your accounts are frontier labs and some government evaluation bodies.

  • Not a management role. This is a senior individual contributor seat on a team we expect to grow.

If you don’t have 100% of these, you should still seriously consider applying. We care more about what you can do than your credentials.

You’ll Thrive Here If You:

  • Are energized by a market that did not exist three years ago and is being written as you sell into it.

  • Are discreet. You will be privy to sensitive commercial and research information.

  • Are motivated by ownership, accountability, and upside rather than rigid structure.

  • Would rather be the person a head of safety calls first than the person with the highest activity metrics.

What We Offer:

We offer a competitive compensation package designed to reward impact and incentivize growth. Our compensation philosophy is informed by our current valuation and recent industry data.

Compensation: $157k-$192k + commission ($314-$384k OTE) and meaningful equity package

Benefits:

  • 401k with up to 4% matching

  • 28 days annual leave (vacation + holidays)

  • Health, dental, and vision coverage

  • Catered lunches (Pittsburgh office)

🧑‍💻 Technical interview or Hiring Manager Interview.

💻 Role related assesment

🗣 Experience & culture interview

raw.description:
About Gray Swan

Gray Swan is on a mission to empower the world to use AI safely and securely. We evaluate AI models for the leading frontier labs along with building real-time threat detection and adaptive adversarial red teaming agents for teams deploying AI.

We're a team of approximately 50 people, well-funded, growing quickly. Our work directly influences how the world deploys AI agents and systems at scale..

Learn more about how we work.

The Role

Come build and lead Gray Swan's biology safety capability from the ground up, serving as the technical authority on biological misuse risk across red-teaming, evaluation, benchmarking, defenses, and safety infrastructure development. You'll play a critical role in reducing biological risks from frontier AI systems through partnerships with leading AI labs, translating deep biological expertise into scalable AI safety systems that help define the industry's standards for evaluating dangerous capabilities.

This is a rare opportunity to shape an entirely new technical function at one of the world's leading AI security companies, working at the intersection of synthetic biology, biosecurity, AI safety, and machine learning.

If you have PhD-level expertise in biosecurity, molecular biology, synthetic biology, microbiology, immunology, or a related field, significant experience with AI safety, biological risk assessment, or dual-use research, and a drive to reduce catastrophic AI risks, we'd love to hear from you.

What You’ll Do:

  • Design and lead adversarial evaluations of frontier LLMs for biological misuse risks, including agent acquisition, pathogen characterisation and enhancement, biosecurity screening bypass, and emerging biotechnology capabilities across text, agentic, and multimodal systems.

  • Partner closely with machine learning engineers and AI researchers to translate biological expertise into technical requirements for scalable evaluation datasets, classifiers, guardrails, benchmarks, fine-tuned models, and automated red-teaming for both internal products and frontier AI lab partners.

  • Develop and maintain the B in Gray Swan's CBRN harm taxonomy, ensuring biological risk frameworks evolve alongside rapidly advancing model capabilities.

  • Produce clear technical risk assessments and actionable recommendations for frontier AI labs, enterprise customers, policymakers, and internal stakeholders.

  • Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing team of biology subject matter experts while establishing rigorous evaluation standards, quality processes, and scalable safety infrastructure.

  • Represent Gray Swan as the company's biology safety expert through collaborations with AI labs, biosecurity organizations, government partners, and the broader AI safety research community.

Who You Are:

  • PhD in biology, particularly in microbiology, virology, synthetic biology, protein engineering, or a closely related discipline, with postdoctoral or equivalent research experience.

  • Deep understanding of biological misuse risks, dual-use research, pathogen biology, synthetic biology, or biosecurity.

  • Experience conducting adversarial evaluations, biological risk assessments, AI safety research, or developing safety datasets for frontier AI systems.

  • Familiarity with international biosecurity frameworks, dual-use governance, responsible biotechnology practices, and emerging AI safety standards.

  • Comfortable operating at the intersection of cutting-edge biology, machine learning, and AI security.

  • Thrive in ambiguous, fast-moving environments where you'll define strategy while building new systems from the ground up.

  • A builder who enjoys creating teams, processes, and technical infrastructure, not simply maintaining existing programs

Bonus Points If You Have:

  • Experience developing machine learning systems, biological safety classifiers, or evaluation pipelines for high-risk biological capabilities.

  • Hands-on experience with frontier AI model evaluations, red-teaming, prompt engineering, or AI capability benchmarking.

  • Experience working with government biosecurity organizations, frontier AI labs, or organizations focused on catastrophic biological risk.

  • Publications or significant contributions in AI safety, biosecurity, synthetic biology, or dual-use governance.

  • Strong programming or data science experience (Python, ML tooling, biological data analysis).

If you don't meet every qualification, we still encourage you to apply. We care more about your ability to solve important problems than checking every box.

  • Want visibility across the frontier of AI safety, helping evaluate multiple frontier models and working directly with leading AI labs.

  • Are excited to build the infrastructure that makes biological AI safety scalable.

  • Are motivated by reducing catastrophic risks from increasingly capable AI systems.

  • Enjoy turning cutting-edge scientific expertise into practical systems that improve AI safety.

  • Have a vision for what world-class biology safety should look like and are excited to build it.

raw.description:
About Gray Swan

Gray Swan is on a mission to empower the world to use AI safely and securely. We evaluate AI models for the leading frontier labs along with building real-time threat detection and adaptive adversarial red teaming agents for teams deploying AI.

Learn more about how we work.

The Role

We’re looking for a Staff Product Designer to join our small but mighty design team. You’ll work closely with the Arena Product team to build and grow the Gray Swan AI Arena. From collaborating with developers and marketing teams to translating complex technical workflows into clear, trustworthy, and refined product experiences, you’ll help shape how AI systems are tested, monitored, and secured.

This is a high ownership role. We care deeply about craft, but just as much about initiative. We’re looking for someone who can take a problem, run with it, collaborate cross functionally, and push the work to a high standard without waiting to be told what to do.

What You’ll Do:

  • Design and improve Gray Swan’s Arena UI across web and mobile platforms

  • Own your work from end-to-end, from early concept sketches to production-ready specs

  • Translate complex technical workflows into clear, and intuitive user experiences.

  • Incorporate visual design and persuasive design principles to create joyful and engaging flows.

  • Build and maintain UI components, patterns, and visual standards in our design system

  • Collaborate with product, engineering, ML research, and GTM teams on cross-functional work

  • Contribute to ad hoc design needs as they arise: we all wear a few extra hats here!

Who You Are:

  • 6+ years’ professional experience in product UI/UX design, ideally in gamified consumer apps, bonus points for experience building tooling and/or chat interfaces

  • Able to balance the need of technical users with creating playful design

  • Proficient in modern design and prototyping tools

  • Solid grasp on user-centered design principles and usability testing methodologies

  • Detail-oriented with a knack for managing style guides and component libraries

Bonus Points If You Have:

  • Experience working at an early-stage startup

  • Understanding of AI safety principles or ethical considerations in AI systems

  • Some familiarity with front-end development or coding skills

If you don’t have 100% of these, you should still seriously consider applying. We care more about what you can do than your credentials.

  • Enjoy high-impact work. Your role will directly shape the experience of our early customers and set the tone for future growth

  • Embrace a collaborative, mission-focused team. You’ll work alongside passionate engineers, product leaders, and a supportive UX Lead

  • 28 days annual leave (vacation + holidays)

  • Health, dental, and vision coverage

🔎 Application review. We read everything; we’ll respond within 10 days.

🗣 Recruiter Screen. We learn about you; you learn about us.

🧑‍💻 Technical interview or Hiring Manager Interview.

💻 Role related assesment

🗣 Experience & culture interview

😇 Reference checks. We’ll reach out to 3-5 references that you provide.

📃 Offer. If it’s mutual, we move fast.

Submit your resume, link to your portfolio, and answer the questions on the application.

raw.title: Sales Operations Lead
raw.description:
About Gray Swan

Gray Swan is on a mission to empower the world to use AI safely and securely. We evaluate AI models for the leading frontier labs along with building real-time threat detection and adaptive adversarial red teaming agents for enterprise teams deploying AI.

We're a team of approximately 50 people, well-funded and growing quickly. Our work directly influences how the world deploys AI agents and systems at scale.

Learn more about how we work.

The Role

We’re looking for a Sales Operations Lead to build the systems, processes, and operational infrastructure that enable our sales organization to scale. This is a highly cross-functional, back-office role for someone who loves creating structure, solving operational problems, and making teams more efficient. You’ll work closely with Sales, Legal, Compliance, Finance, and Accounting to improve processes across the full sales lifecycle—from pre-sales and contracting through delivery, invoicing, and commissions. This role also has the opportunity to evolve as the company grows, with the possibility to take on additional Sales and Revenue Operations initiatives.

What You’ll Do:

  • Build and improve scalable systems and processes across the sales lifecycle, including pre-sales, contracting, post-sales, project/deliverable tracking, and internal handoffs.

  • Own the operational side of our deal desk, coordinating contracts, SOWs, security questionnaires, vendor onboarding, RFPs, and other deal-related requirements with the appropriate internal teams.

  • Partner with Sales, Legal, Compliance, Finance, and Accounting to ensure the right stakeholders are engaged at the right time and that processes move efficiently.

  • Manage the sales-side invoice process and execute commission plans for quota-carrying team members.

  • Manage and optimize our CRM (HubSpot), reporting, workflows, and automations while continuously looking for opportunities to eliminate manual work.

  • Lead cross-functional projects and create playbooks, documentation, and processes that bring greater structure and scalability to the organization.

Who You Are:

  • You’re a strong project manager who can take an ambiguous problem, create structure, coordinate stakeholders, and drive it through to completion.

  • You think in terms of workflows and flow charts, and have used tools like Zapier, n8n, etc. to build automations based on these.

  • You’re highly organized and detail-oriented, with strong judgment around what you can solve independently and when to pull in Legal, Finance, Compliance, or other teams.

  • You have hands-on experience working with sales teams and deal cycles.

  • You’re a process-minded problem solver who naturally asks, “How can we make this easier, more efficient, and more scalable?”

  • You’re comfortable working across multiple functions and managing several priorities at once in a fast-moving environment.

  • You have experience with CRM systems and reporting, and you’re comfortable learning and improving systems rather than simply maintaining them.

  • You’re a hands-on generalist who isn’t afraid to jump into the details, execute manually when necessary, and then find a way to automate it.

Bonus Points If You Have:

  • Experience with HubSpot or another CRM, including workflows, reporting, data management, and automation.

  • Experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Deal Desk, Business Operations, Sales, or a similar cross-functional role.

  • Experience working with Sales, Legal, Compliance, Finance, or Accounting on contracts, security requirements, vendor onboarding, or related processes.

  • Experience building contracting processes, deal desk workflows, playbooks, or other operational frameworks from the ground up.

  • Experience supporting commission administration, RFPs, security questionnaires, or sales-side invoicing processes.

  • Experience identifying opportunities for automation and using technology to streamline repetitive operational work.

If you don’t have 100% of these, you should still seriously consider applying. We care more about what you can do than your credentials.

You’ll Thrive Here If You:

  • You genuinely enjoy problem solving and get satisfaction from making the organization run better behind the scenes.

  • You’re energized by creating structure where there isn’t much structure yet, and you’re comfortable figuring things out as you go.

  • You’re naturally curious and enjoy learning how different parts of a business work together.

  • You have a strong sense of ownership and don’t wait to be told exactly what to do when you see something that needs fixing.

  • You’re a generalist at heart—you like having your hands in a variety of projects rather than being narrowly focused on one system or function.

  • You want a role that can grow with the company and are excited by the opportunity to shape what Sales Operations looks like as we scale.

What We Offer:

We offer a competitive compensation package designed to reward impact and incentivize growth. Our compensation philosophy is informed by our current valuation and recent industry data.

Compensation: $136,500 - $163,000 plus performance based bonus and meaningful equity package

Benefits:

  • 401k with up to 4% matching

  • 28 days annual leave (vacation + holidays)

  • Health, dental, and vision coverage

  • Catered lunches (Pittsburgh office)

  • Flexible work arrangements

  • Visa sponsorship available for exceptional candidates

Typical Interview Process

🔎 Application review. We read everything; we’ll respond within 10 days.

🗣 Recruiter Screen. We learn about you; you learn about us.

🧑‍💻 Technical interview or Hiring Manager Interview.

💻 Role related assessment

🗣 Experience & culture interview

😇 Reference checks. We’ll reach out to 3 references that you provide.

📃 Offer. If it’s mutual, we move fast.

 - Build and improve scalable systems and processes across the sales lifecycle, including pre-sales, contracting, post-sales, project/deliverable tracking, and internal handoffs.

 - Own the operational side of our deal desk, coordinating contracts, SOWs, security questionnaires, vendor onboarding, RFPs, and other deal-related requirements with the appropriate internal teams.

 - Partner with Sales, Legal, Compliance, Finance, and Accounting to ensure the right stakeholders are engaged at the right time and that processes move efficiently.

 - Manage the sales-side invoice process and execute commission plans for quota-carrying team members.

 - Manage and optimize our CRM (HubSpot), reporting, workflows, and automations while continuously looking for opportunities to eliminate manual work.

 - Lead cross-functional projects and create playbooks, documentation, and processes that bring greater structure and scalability to the organization.




WHO YOU ARE:

 - You’re a strong project manager who can take an ambiguous problem, create structure, coordinate stakeholders, and drive it through to completion.

 - You think in terms of workflows and flow charts, and have used tools like Zapier, n8n, etc. to build automations based on these.

 - You’re highly organized and detail-oriented, with strong judgment around what you can solve independently and when to pull in Legal, Finance, Compliance, or other teams.

 - You have hands-on experience working with sales teams and deal cycles.

 - You’re a process-minded problem solver who naturally asks, “How can we make this easier, more efficient, and more scalable?”

 - You’re comfortable working across multiple functions and managing several priorities at once in a fast-moving environment.

 - You have experience with CRM systems and reporting, and you’re comfortable learning and improving systems rather than simply maintaining them.

 - You’re a hands-on generalist who isn’t afraid to jump into the details, execute manually when necessary, and then find a way to automate it.





BONUS POINTS IF YOU HAVE:

 - Experience with HubSpot or another CRM, including workflows, reporting, data management, and automation.

 - Experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Deal Desk, Business Operations, Sales, or a similar cross-functional role.

 - Experience working with Sales, Legal, Compliance, Finance, or Accounting on contracts, security requirements, vendor onboarding, or related processes.

 - Experience building contracting processes, deal desk workflows, playbooks, or other operational frameworks from the ground up.

 - Experience supporting commission administration, RFPs, security questionnaires, or sales-side invoicing processes.

 - Experience identifying opportunities for automation and using technology to streamline repetitive operational work.

YOU’LL THRIVE HERE IF YOU:

Gray Swan is looking for an Engineering Manager, Enterprise to lead the team responsible for building and scaling the systems that power our AI security platform. You'll combine strong technical judgment with people leadership to help design the enterprise experience, including infrastructure, backend services, and cloud architecture that enable Gray Swan to build AI systems and for customers to safely deploy frontier AI models at scale.

This role is ideal for an engineering leader who enjoys solving complex infrastructure challenges while building and developing a high-performing team. You'll work closely with machine learning engineers, product engineers, and security researchers to ensure our platform remains fast, resilient, secure, and scalable as we grow.

You'll have significant ownership over foundational systems, technical strategy, and team development. As one of the leaders shaping Gray Swan's infrastructure organization, you'll have the opportunity to influence architecture, engineering practices, and how we build and operate systems in a rapidly evolving AI startup.

What You’ll Do:

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of infrastructure engineers, creating a culture of ownership, technical excellence, and continuous improvement.

  • Set technical direction and priorities for enterprise solutions in partnership with engineering leadership and other technical teams.

  • Oversee the design, development, and operation of highly available backend services and distributed systems that power Gray Swan's AI security platform.

  • Guide the team in owning and scaling cloud infrastructure across Kubernetes, AWS, GCP, Azure, networking, storage, and compute.

  • Drive the development of internal platform services, infrastructure tooling, and systems that improve developer productivity and reliability.

  • Establish and improve engineering practices around observability, monitoring, incident response, deployment, and operational excellence.

  • Partner closely with machine learning, security, and product engineering teams to build infrastructure capable of supporting increasingly complex AI workloads.

  • Identify and address opportunities to improve system performance, reliability, scalability, and infrastructure efficiency.

  • Help define long-term architecture and technical strategy while balancing immediate product and engineering priorities.

  • Participate in hiring and help build a world-class infrastructure engineering organization.

  • Provide technical guidance during complex production incidents and ensure the team learns from failures through effective post-incident reviews.

  • Communicate infrastructure strategy, tradeoffs, risks, and priorities clearly across engineering and company leadership.

Who You Are:

  • 7+ years of experience building enterprise solutions with experience implementing backend infrastructure or distributed systems in production environments.

  • 2+ years of experience managing, mentoring, or leading software engineering teams.

  • Strong technical background in infrastructure, distributed systems, backend engineering, or platform engineering.

  • Strong programming experience in C/C++, Go, Python, Rust, Java, or a similar language.

  • Experience operating production services on Kubernetes and modern cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, and Azure.

  • Deep understanding of networking, distributed systems, containers, service orchestration, and scalable architectures.

  • Experience designing and operating APIs, microservices, asynchronous systems, and event-driven architectures.

  • Strong understanding of reliability, observability, security, and performance at scale.

  • Comfortable diving into complex technical problems and debugging production systems alongside your team.

  • A strong people leader who enjoys coaching engineers, providing feedback, and helping individuals grow.

  • Able to balance technical depth with effective delegation and team leadership.

  • Excited to work in a fast-moving startup where you will have significant ownership and ambiguity.

Bonus Points If You Have:

  • Experience managing infrastructure or platform teams supporting machine learning or LLM workloads.

  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform.

  • Experience with Kafka, Redis, PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, or similar distributed data systems.

  • Experience building internal developer platforms or platform engineering organizations.

  • Knowledge of cloud security, infrastructure hardening, or zero-trust architectures.

  • Experience scaling infrastructure through a period of rapid company or product growth.

  • Previous experience at a high-growth startup or building products from zero to one.

  • Interest in AI safety, cybersecurity, or adversarial machine learning.

If you don’t have 100% of these, you should still seriously consider applying. We care more about what you can do than your credentials.

You’ll Thrive Here If You:

  • You lead from the front. You're technically curious, comfortable getting into the details when needed, and know how to empower engineers without becoming a bottleneck.

  • You build great teams. You care deeply about developing engineers, creating a strong team culture, and giving people the ownership and autonomy they need to do their best work.

  • You think at scale. You enjoy designing resilient infrastructure, making thoughtful architectural decisions, and building systems that are secure, observable, and built to grow.

  • You balance strategy with execution. You can zoom out to define long-term technical direction while staying close enough to the work to help the team navigate difficult technical problems.

  • You collaborate across disciplines. You work effectively with machine learning engineers, security researchers, and product teams, understanding that great infrastructure enables everyone else to move faster.

  • You're excited by our mission and startup environment. You enjoy moving quickly, adapting to change, and helping build the infrastructure foundation for the future of secure AI.

What We Offer:

We offer a competitive compensation package designed to reward impact and incentivize growth. Our compensation philosophy is informed by our current valuation and recent industry data.

Compensation: $255,000 - $315,000 plus performance based bonus and meaningful equity package

Benefits:

  • 401k with up to 4% matching

  • 28 days annual leave (vacation + holidays)

  • Health, dental, and vision coverage

  • Catered lunches (Pittsburgh office)

  • Flexible work arrangements

  • Visa sponsorship available for exceptional candidates

Interview Process

🔎 Application review. We read everything; we’ll respond within 10 days.

🗣 Recruiter Screen. We learn about you; you learn about us.

🧑‍💻 Technical interview or Hiring Manager Interview.

💻 Role related assesment

🗣 Experience & culture interview

😇 Reference checks. We’ll reach out to 3-5 references that you provide.

📃 Offer. If it’s mutual, we move fast.

How to Apply

Submit your resume, link to your portfolio, and answer the questions on the application.

raw.title: Technical Recruiter
raw.description:
About Gray Swan

Gray Swan is on a mission to empower the world to use AI safely and securely. We evaluate AI models for the leading frontier labs while building real-time threat detection and adaptive adversarial red teaming agents for teams deploying AI.

We’re a team of approximately 50 people, well-funded, and growing quickly. Our work directly influences how the world deploys AI agents and systems at scale.

Learn more about how we work

The Role

We’re looking for a Senior Technical Recruiter to own recruiting across Gray Swan’s technical organization, spanning Software Engineering, Infrastructure, AI/ML, Security, Research, and other emerging technical functions.

This is a high-ownership role for someone who can operate as both a strategic talent partner and hands-on technical recruiter. You’ll work closely with engineering and technical leadership to define what great looks like, develop hiring strategies, map highly competitive talent markets, and personally execute searches from first outreach through close.

We’re looking for someone who is a doer. You’ll source, screen, build pipelines, close candidates, analyze recruiting data, and solve problems when searches aren’t working. You should be equally comfortable partnering with an engineering leader on a difficult hiring decision and spending the afternoon personally sourcing exceptional engineers.

What You’ll Do

  • Own full-cycle technical recruiting from role definition and talent mapping through sourcing, assessment, offer strategy, and close.

  • Partner with engineering and technical leadership as a trusted talent advisor, helping define profiles, understand the market, calibrate on talent, and make better hiring decisions.

  • Recruit across highly technical functions including Software Engineering, Infrastructure, AI/ML, Security, Research, and technical customer-facing roles.

  • Build exceptional passive talent pipelines through creative sourcing, market research, networking, targeted outreach, and referrals.

  • Develop a deep understanding of technical talent markets and proactively identify candidates who may not be actively looking.

  • Recruit and close highly sought-after technical candidates, developing compelling pitches, understanding candidate motivations, navigating objections, and competing effectively for top talent.

  • Coach and challenge hiring teams on technical profiles, interview processes, candidate calibration, and hiring decisions.

  • Partner with engineering leaders to improve technical interview design, scorecards, calibration, and debrief processes.

  • Use recruiting data and market intelligence to understand pipeline health, conversion rates, sourcing effectiveness, time-to-fill, and offer acceptance, and adjust strategy accordingly.

  • Manage multiple high-priority technical searches simultaneously while maintaining a high bar for candidate quality and experience.

  • Deliver an exceptional candidate experience that is thoughtful, responsive, rigorous, and highly personal.

  • Help build recruiting infrastructure and processes that can scale as Gray Swan grows.

Who You Are

  • 5+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, with significant experience recruiting technical talent.

  • A strong track record recruiting software engineers and other highly technical candidates in competitive markets.

  • Experience recruiting for a high-growth startup, ideally at an early-stage or pre-IPO company.

  • Experience partnering directly with engineering leaders, technical executives, and hiring managers.

  • Strong technical sourcing instincts—you enjoy the hunt and know how to identify exceptional engineers beyond the obvious candidate pools.

  • The ability to understand technical roles well enough to effectively source, assess, calibrate, and sell candidates, without needing to be an engineer yourself.

  • A track record of identifying, engaging, and closing passive technical candidates.

  • The confidence and judgment to coach hiring teams and push back when a profile, process, or hiring decision needs to change.

  • High ownership and the ability to make decisions and move work forward without waiting for direction.

  • Strong operational discipline and comfort managing multiple high-priority searches simultaneously.

  • A data-driven approach to recruiting and the ability to diagnose why a search isn’t working and adjust quickly.

  • A builder mentality. You’re energized by creating and improving recruiting processes rather than simply operating within established ones.

  • Curiosity about AI and AI security. You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you should be excited to learn about our technology, understand our technical teams, and become fluent in the markets we recruit from.

Bonus Points If You Have

  • Experience recruiting technical talent at an early-stage or rapidly scaling startup, where you helped build the recruiting function while actively hiring.

  • Experience recruiting within AI, cybersecurity, developer tools, enterprise software, infrastructure, or another highly technical market.

  • Experience hiring across a range of technical profiles, from software engineers and infrastructure engineers to security engineers, ML/AI engineers, and research-oriented technical talent.

  • Experience recruiting for highly competitive or niche technical talent markets.

  • Experience using AI and recruiting technology to improve sourcing, market mapping, candidate engagement, or recruiting operations.

  • Experience building technical recruiting strategies from scratch, including talent mapping, sourcing strategy, interview processes, and recruiting metrics.

If you don’t have 100% of these, you should still seriously consider applying. We care more about what you can do than your credentials.

You’ll Thrive Here If You

  • You’re an owner and a doer. You can advise an engineering leader on talent strategy in the morning and spend the afternoon personally sourcing the engineers you believe they should meet.

  • You have a point of view and aren’t afraid to use it. You’ll challenge an unrealistic technical profile, push for a faster decision, or recommend changing course when the market tells us something isn’t working.

  • You move with urgency, hold a high bar, and care more about building an exceptional technical team than simply filling roles.

  • You’re excited by difficult searches. When the obvious candidates have already been contacted, you want to figure out where the next great candidate is hiding.

  • If you want meaningful ownership over how Gray Swan builds its technical organization, we’d love to meet you.

What We Offer

We offer a competitive compensation package designed to reward impact and incentivize growth. Our compensation philosophy is informed by our current valuation and recent industry data. Compensation: $122,500 - $185,000 plus performance-based bonus and meaningful equity package

Benefits:

  • 401k with up to 4% matching

  • 28 days annual leave (vacation + holidays)

  • Health, dental, and vision coverage

  • Catered lunches (Pittsburgh office)

  • Flexible work arrangements

  • Visa sponsorship available for exceptional candidates\

Interview Process

🔎 Application Review — We read everything and will respond within 10 days.

🗣 Recruiter Screen — We learn about you; you learn about us.

🧑‍💻 Hiring Manager Screen — Meet with the hiring manager and dive deeper into your technical recruiting experience.

🗣 Virtual Onsite Interview — Meet members of the team and learn more about how we work.

😇 Reference Checks — We’ll reach out to 3–5 references that you provide.

📃 Offer — If it’s mutual, we move fast.
