raw.title: Senior Director, Product & Customer Marketing
raw.description:
Senior Director, Product & Customer Marketing

Level: M5
Location: CAD or US | Eastern or Pacific Timezone
Reports To: Michael Scott | Chief Marketing Officer
Department: Marketing
Type: Permanent | Full-Time
Vacancy Status: This is an active, approved role and we are currently hiring for this position.

About Solink

At Solink, our mission is to safeguard what matters most. We provide businesses with the tools to know sooner and act faster by transforming video security into real-time operational insights.

Our cloud-based platform integrates seamlessly with your existing cameras and systems, turning them into intelligent sensors that detect and interpret key moments. This empowers teams to make data-driven decisions, enhance security, and improve operational efficiency.

Trusted by over 35,000 locations across 60+ countries - including brands like McDonald’s and JYSK - Solink delivers clarity when it counts. Our solutions help businesses reduce shrink, optimize performance, and respond proactively to potential threats.

We're growing rapidly, earning industry recognition, and scaling with purpose. We’ve been recognized by Deloitte’s Fast 50™ and Fast 500™, Business Intelligence Group, and as one of Ottawa’s Best Places to Work. And we’re just getting started!

About The Role

Solink is looking for a (head of) Senior Director, Product Marketing and Customer Marketing to create category leadership and sharpen our positioning - accelerating adoption, differentiation, and revenue across our key products. This is a newly unified leadership role, bringing Product Marketing and Customer Marketing together so the story we tell to prospects and the story we tell to existing customers reinforce each other.

You'll own positioning and messaging, lead go-to-market strategy for major launches, run competitive intelligence and win/loss, scale sales enablement, and stand up an Analyst Relations (AR) program - while also owning how we market to and grow our existing customer base through advocacy, references, and expansion programs.

This is a senior, executive-facing role for someone who can define a category, arm a sales team to win, and build a team and function from a strong existing base of product marketers.

What You’ll Be Doing

Positioning & Messaging

  • Own product positioning, messaging, and narrative across Solink’s platform and key products and industries we serve.

  • Develop and defend a category point of view that differentiates Solink from adjacent and competing solutions.

  • Test and refine messaging with customers, prospects, and sales to ensure it resonates and converts.

GTM Strategy

  • Lead go-to-market strategy and execution for major feature and product launches, partnering with Product, Demand Gen, Sales, and Customer Success.

  • Build launch playbooks and processes that scale across a growing product portfolio.

  • Identify opportunities to grow adoption and ARPU through positioning, packaging, and GTM for new features and add-ons.

Competitive Intelligence

  • Own Solink’s competitive intelligence program, keeping a current, accurate view of the competitive landscape.

  • Run a win/loss program that turns deal outcomes into sharper positioning and enablement.

  • Educate internal teams - Sales, Marketing, Product - on competitive threats and how to respond to them.

Sales Enablement

  • Build and scale sales enablement content — battlecards, pitch decks, objection handling, and training — that drives rep proficiency and win rate.

  • Partner with Sales, Customer Success, and RevOps to ensure enablement keeps pace with the roadmap and competitive landscape.

  • Measure and improve enablement adoption and its impact on ramp time and win rate.

Analyst Relations (AR)

  • Build Solink’s Analyst Relations program from the ground up, establishing relationships with relevant industry analysts.

  • Prepare briefings, RFI/RFP responses, and positioning materials for analyst evaluations and reports.

  • Translate analyst feedback into product, positioning, and GTM recommendations for leadership.

Customer Marketing & Advocacy

  • Own customer marketing strategy - references, case studies, testimonials, and advocacy programs that support both sales, demand gen, channel and brand.

  • Partner with Demand Gen and Customer Success on programs that drive adoption, expansion, and retention among existing customers.

  • Build a scalable customer reference and advisory program to support field marketing pg growth, competitive deals and category-building efforts.

A Little Bit About You

  • 10+ years of experience in product marketing, with meaningful experience in customer marketing, competitive intelligence, or analyst relations.

  • A proven track record building category positioning that differentiates a product in a competitive market.

  • Experience leading go-to-market strategy and execution for major product launches end-to-end.

  • Experience building or scaling a sales enablement function, with measurable impact on win rate or ramp time.

  • Comfort building new functions from scratch, including Analyst Relations or customer advocacy programs.

  • Strong executive communication skills, with experience presenting positioning and strategy to CMO, executive, and board-level audiences.

  • Experience building and coaching a team of product and/or customer marketers.

What Success Looks Like

  • Solink has a clear, differentiated category position that Sales, Marketing, Channel, and Product all use consistently.

  • Major launches land on time with strong adoption and a measurable revenue contribution.

  • Sales wins more competitive deals, supported by sharp, current competitive intelligence and enablement.

  • Solink has an active, credible presence with relevant industry analysts.

  • Existing customers become a growing source of references, advocacy, and expansion revenue.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience in physical security, video surveillance, IoT, or a related B2B technology industry.

  • Experience building an Analyst Relations function in a company that didn’t previously have one.

  • Experience scaling a product or customer marketing function as a company grows past $100M+ ARR.

  • Familiarity with sales enablement and customer marketing platforms (e.g., HubSpot, SalesForce, Highspot, Seismic, Gainsight).

Role Expectations

This is an M5 level role. At Solink, individuals at this level set the strategic direction for a major function, translating executive priorities into scalable execution, building organizational capability through the leaders and teams they develop, and are accountable for delivering sustained business outcomes.

In This Role, You'll Be Expected To:

  • Own the long-term strategy, operating model, and performance of Product & Customer Marketing, translating CMO and executive priorities into clear roadmaps and measurable outcomes.

  • Build and grow a high-performing team, developing future leaders and building strong marketing capability across the function.

  • Partner with the CMO and cross-functional executives (Sales, Product, Customer Success) to influence company-wide GTM priorities and strategic initiatives.

  • Establish scalable systems, playbooks, and operating rhythms — launch process, sales enablement, win/loss, AR, customer advocacy — that improve effectiveness beyond any single program.

  • Represent Product & Customer Marketing internally as the senior authority on positioning and category strategy, building trusted relationships across the organization.

What Success Looks Like:

  • Product & Customer Marketing is recognized as a strategic, executive-level function with a clear seat at the GTM table, not a service arm to Sales or Demand Gen.

  • The team and leaders you build operate with growing autonomy and are developing toward their own next level.

  • The systems and playbooks you establish scale beyond you and are adopted company-wide, outlasting any single launch or campaign.

Security Requirements

  • Candidates must undergo a criminal records check upon hire;

  • Be a Canadian Citizen (dual citizens included), or eligible to work in Canada;

  • Be willing to comply with Solink’s own security policies and standards.

Our Values

We do things the Solink way:

  • Act with URGENCY – Our customers move fast, so we do too.

  • Deliver with QUALITY – We sweat the details and hold a high bar.

  • Win with TEAM – No egos. Just outcomes, built together.

  • Lead with TRUST – We earn it through clarity, consistency, and care.

These aren’t just words—they shape how we hire, lead, and grow.

Why Solink?

We’re not just building tech - we’re building a place where great people do great work.

  • Clarity and trust: Where the role allows, we support flexibility in how and where work gets done - and we’re upfront about what’s required.

  • Meaningful equity: Every full-time, permanent employee has a stake in our growth.

  • Comprehensive benefits: Fully paid health & dental (no waiting period) + $500 health spending account.

  • Wellness support: Monthly reimbursement for fitness, wellness, or mental health programs.

  • Growth through merit: Advancement is based on contribution, initiative, and the ability to raise the bar - together.

  • Candid culture: Clear expectations, honest feedback, and no politics.

  • Social connection: From So-learns to Solink-o and So-lunches, we stay connected in ways that actually feel fun.

What to Expect from the Hiring Process

We respect your time and value transparency. Here’s a general idea of what to expect:

  1. Intro call with our Talent Team

  2. Interview with the Hiring Manager

  3. Role-relevant task or case (if applicable)

  4. Final interviews with cross-functional team members

  5. Reference Checks

  6. Offer & onboarding 🎉

Please note: this is subject to change at any point in the recruitment process based on the needs of the business.

How to Apply

Submit your resume and a short cover letter via our [Careers Page]. Let us know what excites you about this role, and how you’d help move Solink forward.

NOTICE: Solink uses artificial intelligence (AI) to screen, assess, and/or select candidates for this position.

Solink is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. If you require accommodation during the selection process, please let us know.

  • Run a win/loss program that turns deal outcomes into sharper positioning and enablement.

  • Educate internal teams - Sales, Marketing, Product - on competitive threats and how to respond to them.

  • Build and scale sales enablement content — battlecards, pitch decks, objection handling, and training — that drives rep proficiency and win rate.

  • Partner with Sales, Customer Success, and RevOps to ensure enablement keeps pace with the roadmap and competitive landscape.

  • Measure and improve enablement adoption and its impact on ramp time and win rate.

  • Build Solink’s Analyst Relations program from the ground up, establishing relationships with relevant industry analysts.

  • Prepare briefings, RFI/RFP responses, and positioning materials for analyst evaluations and reports.

  • Translate analyst feedback into product, positioning, and GTM recommendations for leadership.

  • Own customer marketing strategy - references, case studies, testimonials, and advocacy programs that support both sales, demand gen, channel and brand.

  • Partner with Demand Gen and Customer Success on programs that drive adoption, expansion, and retention among existing customers.

  • Experience building and coaching a team of product and/or customer marketers.

  • Solink has a clear, differentiated category position that Sales, Marketing, Channel, and Product all use consistently.

  • Experience in physical security, video surveillance, IoT, or a related B2B technology industry.

  • Experience building an Analyst Relations function in a company that didn’t previously have one.

  5. Reference Checks

  6. Offer & onboarding 🎉

Submit your resume and a short cover letter via our [Careers Page]. Let us know what excites you about this role, and how you’d help move Solink forward.

You’ll evaluate ROI across the full portfolio of events and reallocate budget and effort toward what performs, manage a portfolio of vendor and partner relationships (including performance discussions), and act as the escalation point when vendor, partner, or stakeholder issues can’t be resolved at the individual-contributor level. You’ll also improve the systems, tools, and templates the broader field marketing team plans against.

  • Build and execute focused GTM event programs around Solink’s strategic verticals and accounts to grow enterprise pipeline and penetration.

  • Evaluate which event formats and investments perform best within each vertical, and reallocate budget accordingly.

  • Design the playbook for how events, dinners, and tradeshows are planned, executed, and measured.

  • Ensure pre-show, on-site, and follow-up processes are consistent across multiple simultaneous events.

  • Evaluate ROI across the portfolio of events and reallocate budget/effort toward what performs.

  • Improve systems and tools (tech stack, automation, templates) to increase team efficiency.

Vendor & Partner Portfolio Management

  • Manage a portfolio of vendor and partner relationships across events and channels, including performance discussions.

  • Align AEs, CAMs, and partners across multiple events on shared priorities and expectations.

  • Build standardized stakeholder processes (partner briefing templates, AE requirement docs) to reduce friction.

  • 6–8 years of B2B field marketing or event marketing experience, including experience owning a portfolio of events or a regional/channel program, ideally in SaaS or technology.

  • A track record of evaluating ROI across multiple events and reallocating budget or effort toward what performs.

  • Experience managing a portfolio of vendor and partner relationships, including performance conversations and escalations.

  • Experience building GTM programs targeted at specific verticals or strategic accounts, ideally including Restaurant or Financial Institution segments.

  • Demonstrated ability to build systems, playbooks, or templates that other team members plan against.

  • Experience coaching or mentoring more junior marketers on stakeholder management and event execution.

  • Comfort acting as the escalation point for vendor, partner, or internal stakeholder issues.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience marketing into Restaurant, Financial Institution, or other physical-security-relevant verticals.

  • Familiarity with event management platforms (e.g., Cvent, Splash) and marketing automation tooling (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot).

  • Experience supporting enterprise or strategic account segments alongside a direct sales team.

  • Exposure to account-based marketing (ABM) concepts and vertical-specific campaign design.

  • Experience in a high-growth B2B SaaS environment.

  • Coach and mentor other employees through complex problems, goals, tasks and initiatives, giving constructive feedback.

  • Consistently deliver on their priorities and commitments

  • Drive process improvements and influence adoption.

  • Builds frameworks, templates, or standards that scale team effectiveness

  • Enterprise pipeline and account penetration that visibly grow within Restaurant, Financial Institution, and Strategic segments because of the GTM programs you built

  • A portfolio ROI framework the team trusts, with budget and effort clearly shifted toward the event formats and vendors that actually perform

  • A playbook, templates, and processes that the broader field marketing team plans against by default, not just when you're in the room

  • Vendor, partner, and stakeholder issues that get resolved at your level, with AEs, CAMs, and partners aligned before problems reach leadership

Security Requirements

  • Candidates must undergo a criminal records check upon hire;

  • Be a Canadian or American Citizen, or eligible to work in Canada or the United States.

  • Be willing to comply with Solink’s own security policies and standards.

  • Deliver with QUALITY – We sweat the details and hold a high bar.

  • Comprehensive benefits: A stellar benefits package, ensuring you're fully supported with anything you need.

  • Wellness support: Monthly reimbursement for fitness, wellness, or mental health programs.

  • Growth through merit: Advancement is based on contribution, initiative, and the ability to raise the bar - together.

  • Candid culture: Clear expectations, honest feedback, and no politics.

  • Social connection: From So-learns to Solink-o and So-lunches, we stay connected in ways that actually feel fun.

What to Expect from the Hiring Process

We respect your time and value transparency. Here’s a general idea of what to expect:

  1. Intro call with our Talent Team

  2. Interview with the Hiring Manager

  3. Role-relevant task or case (if applicable)

  4. Final interviews with cross-functional team members

  5. Reference Checks

  6. Offer & Onboarding 🎉

Please note: this is subject to change at any point in the recruitment process based on the needs of the business.

How to Apply

Submit your resume and a short cover letter via our [Careers Page]. Let us know what excites you about this role, and how you’d help move Solink forward.

Solink is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. If you require accommodation during the selection process, please let us know.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Solink is looking for a Field & Channel Marketing Manager to own the event calendar and field marketing strategy across a specific region or channel. Rather than running one event at a time, you’ll design the playbook for how events, dinners, and tradeshows are planned, executed, and measured, and you’ll build focused go-to-market programs around Solink’s strategic verticals and accounts, including Restaurant, Financial Institution, and Strategic segments, to grow enterprise pipeline and deepen account penetration.

You’ll evaluate ROI across the full portfolio of events and reallocate budget and effort toward what performs, manage a portfolio of vendor and partner relationships (including performance discussions), and act as the escalation point when vendor, partner, or stakeholder issues can’t be resolved at the individual-contributor level. You’ll also improve the systems, tools, and templates the broader field marketing team plans against.

This role suits a senior marketer who thinks in terms of portfolios and systems rather than single events, coaches others on collaborating effectively with sales and partner teams, and instills urgency and accountability across multiple concurrent events and stakeholders.

 - Partner with Sales and Account Executives to align the event portfolio and invite strategy to target accounts and verticals.

 - Evaluate which event formats and investments perform best within each vertical, and reallocate budget accordingly.

 - Own the end-to-end event calendar and strategy across a region or channel, not just individual events.

 - Design the playbook for how events, dinners, and tradeshows are planned, executed, and measured.

 - Ensure pre-show, on-site, and follow-up processes are consistent across multiple simultaneous events.

 - Evaluate ROI across the portfolio of events and reallocate budget/effort toward what performs.

 - Improve systems and tools (tech stack, automation, templates) to increase team efficiency.

Vendor & Partner Portfolio Management

 - Manage a portfolio of vendor and partner relationships across events and channels, including performance discussions.

 - Align AEs, CAMs, and partners across multiple events on shared priorities and expectations.

 - Build standardized stakeholder processes (partner briefing templates, AE requirement docs) to reduce friction.

 - Experience managing a portfolio of vendor and partner relationships, including performance conversations and escalations.

 - Experience building GTM programs targeted at specific verticals or strategic accounts, ideally including Restaurant or Financial Institution segments.

 - Comfort acting as the escalation point for vendor, partner, or internal stakeholder issues.

  • Deep understanding of HubSpot and Salesforce— including architecture, CRM setup, workflows, data mapping, and integrations.

  • Strong people and communication skills — capable of managing a team, coordinating across stakeholders, and translating technical/operational issues into clear actions.

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate data into actionable business insights.

  • High proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets (ex: pivot tables, INDEX/MATCH, VLOOKUP, IF statements, filters)

  • A deep understanding of B2B sales, marketing and customer success including process, content and technology; e.g. Marketo, Gong, Hubspot/Salesforce, Outreach/Salesloft, Sales Navigator, Gainsight, etc.

  • Excellent attention to detail, coupled with the ability to see the bigger picture — identify root causes, articulate challenges clearly, and solve problems strategically.

  • Familiarity with CRM systems beyond HubSpot — especially Salesforce — and experience with HubSpot-Salesforce sync is a strong asset.

  • A mindset of continuous improvement: able to proactively seek process improvements, enforce data integrity, and support scalable growth.

  • Experience working in fast-paced startup or scale-up environments.

  • Familiarity with marketing automation platforms, ad tech, and analytics tools.

  • Comfort working cross-functionally across marketing, sales, operations, product, and customer success.

  • Previous experience in RevOps or revenue support roles.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Data/Analytics,. Business Administration or equivalent

  • 5+ years in Marketing Operations, RevOps, Demand Gen, or Marketing Analytics.

  • Candidates must undergo a criminal records check upon hire;

  • Be a Canadian Citizen, or eligible to work in Canada;

  • Be willing to comply with Solink’s own security policies and standards.

  • Lead with TRUST – We earn it through clarity, consistency, and care.

  • Clarity and trust: Where the role allows, we support flexibility in how and where work gets done - and we’re upfront about what’s required.

  • Meaningful equity: Every full-time, permanent employee has a stake in our growth.

  • Comprehensive benefits: A stellar benefits package, ensuring you're fully supported with anything you need.

  • Wellness support: Monthly reimbursement for fitness, wellness, or mental health programs.

  • Growth through merit: Advancement is based on contribution, initiative, and the ability to raise the bar - together.

  • Candid culture: Clear expectations, honest feedback, and no politics.

  • Social connection: From So-learns to Solink-o and So-lunches, we stay connected in ways that actually feel fun.

What to Expect from the Hiring Process

We respect your time and value transparency. Here’s a general idea of what to expect:

  1. Intro call with our Talent Partner: 45 Minutes

  2. Interview with our CMO & VP of Revenue Operations: 60 Minutes

  3. Practical Assessment Interview with our CMO & VP of Revenue Operations: 60 Minutes

  4. References, Offer & Onboarding 🎉

     

Please note: this is subject to change at any point in the recruitment process based on the needs of the business.

Compensation

The salary range for this role is CAD $152,000 - $180,000 and includes a base salary plus a performance-based variable component. At Solink, we’re committed to a simple and transparent approach to compensation. Pay is determined based on several factors, including your location, experience, job-related skills, and how you demonstrate them throughout the interview process. We make compensation decisions thoughtfully, with a focus on fairness, internal equity, and the impact you’ll have in this role.

How to Apply

Submit your resume via our Careers Page. Let us know what excites you about this role, and how you’d help move Solink forward.

Solink is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. If you require accommodation during the selection process, please let us know.

  • Bring best practices from more mature engineering environments to help the team scale effectively.

Location: Canada | Remote
Preferred: Ottawa, ON or Toronto, ON
Department: Direct Sales | Enterprise
Reports To: Lianne Bradley | Director Restaurant Sales
Type: Permanent | Full-Time
Vacancy Status: This is an active, approved role and we are currently hiring for this position.

About Solink

At Solink, our mission is to safeguard what matters most. We provide businesses with the tools to know sooner and act faster by transforming video security into real-time operational insights.

Our cloud-based platform integrates seamlessly with your existing cameras and systems, turning them into intelligent sensors that detect and interpret key moments. This empowers teams to make data-driven decisions, enhance security, and improve operational efficiency.

Trusted by over 30,000 locations across 32+ countries - including brands like McDonald’s and JYSK - Solink delivers clarity when it counts. Our solutions help businesses reduce shrink, optimize performance, and respond proactively to potential threats.

We're growing rapidly, earning industry recognition, and scaling with purpose. We’ve been recognized by Deloitte’s Fast 50™ and Fast 500™, Business Intelligence Group, and as one of Ottawa’s Best Places to Work. And we’re just getting started!

The Role

We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Enterprise Account Executive to join our Restaurant team. The ideal candidate has a proven track record of acquiring and growing complex enterprise accounts, navigating multi-stakeholder buying processes, and consistently delivering results in competitive markets.

This person should bring demonstrated success selling complex enterprise solutions and ideally possess experience within the restaurant industry, including relationships with restaurant operators, franchise groups, or brand leaders. They excel at building executive-level relationships, developing strategic account plans, aligning cross-functional stakeholders, and navigating complex sales cycles involving operations, IT, finance, legal, and executive leadership teams.

As an Enterprise Account Executive at Solink, you will play a key role in growing our restaurant vertical by acquiring and expanding strategic accounts, acting as a trusted advisor to customers, and helping restaurant organizations improve visibility, reduce risk, and operate more effectively at scale. You will also serve as a strategic voice for the market, bringing customer insights, industry trends, and enterprise best practices back to Solink to help shape our go-to-market strategy and long-term growth.

What You’ll Do

Business Development

  • Identify and prioritize high-value enterprise opportunities within the restaurant industry, including QSR, fast casual, casual dining, franchisors, large franchisees, and multi-unit operators.

  • Develop strategic account plans for target restaurant brands, ownership groups, and franchise portfolios.

  • Identify repeatable patterns across enterprise accounts and contribute best practices that improve Solink's sales motions, account planning processes, and go-to-market effectiveness.

  • Build pipeline through outbound prospecting, referrals, industry events, franchise networks, and internal tools like ZoomInfo, HubSpot, Gong, and LinkedIn Sales Navigator.

  • Represent Solink at restaurant industry events, trade shows, conferences, and franchise meetings.

Sales Execution

  • Own the full enterprise sales cycle from discovery and demo through pilot, procurement, negotiation, and close.

  • Navigate complex restaurant buying committees, including owners, operators, executives, loss prevention, IT, finance, legal, and operations leaders.
    Develop and execute mutual success plans, stakeholder alignment strategies, and close plans to drive complex enterprise opportunities to successful outcomes.

  • Understand restaurant-specific challenges such as shrink, theft, employee safety, drive-thru operations, food safety, guest experience, margin pressure, and multi-location visibility.

  • Build compelling business cases that clearly show Solink’s ROI for restaurant operators and enterprise brands.

  • Tailor Solink’s value proposition to different restaurant stakeholders, from C-level executives to field operators.

Account Management

  • Build trusted executive relationships with restaurant operators, franchise owners, brand leaders, and multi-unit executives.

  • Act as a trusted advisor and strategic partner to customers by understanding their business, pain points, executive priorities, and long-term growth plans.

  • Identify opportunities for expansion across additional locations, brands, regions, and ownership groups.

  • Partner closely with Customer Success, Product, Marketing, and Implementation to ensure a strong customer experience.

  • Drive upsell, cross-sell, and multi-location rollout opportunities within existing restaurant accounts.

Market Insights

  • Stay informed on trends impacting restaurants, including labor challenges, margin pressure, loss prevention, technology adoption, off-premise ordering, and operational efficiency.

  • Serve as a strategic voice for the restaurant vertical by identifying emerging trends, influencing cross-functional priorities, and helping shape Solink’s long-term growth strategy within the industry.

  • Maintain a strong understanding of restaurant technology ecosystems, including POS, video security, payments, workforce tools, and operational platforms.


What You Bring

Restaurant Industry Expertise

  • Experience selling into restaurants, ideally across QSR, fast casual, casual dining, or multi-unit franchise environments.

  • Strong understanding of franchise models, multi-unit operations, and how restaurant buying decisions are made.

Enterprise Sales Experience

  • 5+ years of success in B2B enterprise sales, preferably in SaaS, restaurant technology, security, POS, payments, loss prevention, or operations technology.

  • Proven track record of exceeding quota and closing complex, multi-stakeholder deals.

  • Experience managing long sales cycles, pilots, procurement, legal review, and executive negotiations.

  • Ability to build strategic account plans and move large opportunities from prospecting to close.

Relationship Builder

  • Strong existing network within the restaurant industry.

  • Confident building trust with C-level executives, owners, operators, and functional leaders.

  • Skilled at turning relationships into qualified opportunities and long-term account growth.

  • Comfortable using industry events, referrals, and partner relationships to create momentum.

Strategic & Commercially Minded

  • Strong ability to identify high-potential accounts and understand where buying power sits.

  • Comfortable navigating franchisor, franchisee, corporate, and private-equity-backed restaurant structures.

  • Skilled at building ROI-driven business cases and aligning Solink to customer priorities.

  • Disciplined in qualification, forecasting, follow-up, and deal management.

Driven & Accountable

  • Competitive, self-motivated, and energized by building new business.

  • Consistent high performer with a desire to be at the top of the leaderboard.

  • Comfortable with travel for customer meetings, industry events, and strategic deal support.

  • Coachable, collaborative, and committed to continuous improvement.

  • Share industry expertise, enterprise selling strategies, and market insights with peers to strengthen team performance and contribute to the success of the broader sales organization.

Tool-Enabled & Process-Savvy

  • Uses data, call review, account research, AI-powered tools, and sales process to continuously improve performance and effectiveness.

  • Experience using tools like SalesForce, Gong, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and sales enablement platforms.

  • Strong pipeline hygiene, accurate forecasting, and clear next-step discipline.

  • Uses data, call review, account research, and sales process to improve performance.


Nice to Have

  • Experience selling to large franchisee groups or multi-brand restaurant operators.

  • Existing relationships with QSR, fast casual, or casual dining brands.

  • Experience selling security, video, POS, payments, loss prevention, workforce management, or operations technology.

  • Familiarity with restaurant conferences, associations, franchise groups, or industry events.

  • Experience selling into organizations with hundreds or thousands of locations.


Target Crusher

  • You don’t just meet goals — you aim for President’s Club every year.

  • You are motivated by winning, energized by strategic enterprise sales, and excited by the opportunity to help Solink become the leading video intelligence platform for the restaurant industry.

Security Requirements

  • Candidates must undergo a criminal records check upon hire;

  • Be a Canadian Citizen (dual citizens included), or eligible to work in Canada;

  • Be willing to comply with Solink’s own security policies and standards.

Our Values

We do things the Solink way:

  • Act with URGENCY – Our customers move fast, so we do too.

  • Deliver with QUALITY – We sweat the details and hold a high bar.

  • Win with TEAM – No egos. Just outcomes, built together.

  • Lead with TRUST – We earn it through clarity, consistency, and care.

These aren’t just words—they shape how we hire, lead, and grow.

Why Solink?

We’re not just building tech - we’re building a place where great people do great work.

  • Clarity and trust: Where the role allows, we support flexibility in how and where work gets done - and we’re upfront about what’s required.

  • Meaningful equity: Every full-time, permanent employee has a stake in our growth.

  • Comprehensive benefits: Fully paid health & dental (no waiting period) + $500 health spending account.

  • Wellness support: Monthly reimbursement for fitness, wellness, or mental health programs.

  • Growth through merit: Advancement is based on contribution, initiative, and the ability to raise the bar - together.

  • Candid culture: Clear expectations, honest feedback, and no politics.

  • Social connection: From So-learns to Solink-o and So-lunches, we stay connected in ways that actually feel fun.

What to Expect from the Hiring Process

We respect your time and value transparency. Here’s a general idea of what to expect:

  1. Intro call with our Talent Team

  2. Interview with the Hiring Manager

  3. Role-relevant task or case (if applicable)

  4. Final interviews with cross-functional team members

  5. Reference Checks

  6. Offer & onboarding 🎉

Please note: this is subject to change at any point in the recruitment process based on the needs of the business.

How to Apply

Submit your resume and a short cover letter via our [Careers Page]. Let us know what excites you about this role, and how you’d help move Solink forward.

You'll write real code, against our Rust/Node.js APIs, our React front end, and our AWS serverless infrastructure, to make the system testable, simulate device behavior at scale, and catch problems before they reach customers. You'll work as a peer to developers, contributing to architecture discussions, code reviews, and design decisions, with quality and testability as your lens.

You'll have significant latitude to shape how the team approaches testing, from framework design to CI/CD integration to how we simulate thousands of IoT devices and video streams in a repeatable, automated way.

What You’ll Do

Automation Framework & Tooling Development

  • Design, build, and maintain automated test frameworks and libraries spanning REST APIs, UI (React), security, and end-to-end/integration layers.

  • Write production-quality code for test harnesses, device simulators, performance tools and mocks that emulate IoT device behavior and video streams at scale.

  • Build and maintain tooling that improves testability across the stack — including for distributed, event-driven components (Lambda, DynamoDB, SQS, Kinesis).

  • Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines, optimizing for fast, reliable feedback on every build and deployment.

  • Evaluate and introduce new tools, frameworks, and approaches to keep test infrastructure scalable as the platform and team grow.

Engineering Collaboration & Architecture

  • Participate as a technical peer in design sessions, RFCs, and architecture discussions — advocating for testability, observability, and reliability from the start.

  • Review code and pull requests with an eye toward correctness, edge cases, performance, and long-term maintainability.

  • Work closely with backend and frontend engineers to understand system design and build automation that reflects real production behavior.

  • Contribute to system reliability by supporting monitoring, alerting, and troubleshooting efforts, including issues involving device connectivity.

Test Strategy & Coverage

  • Design test plans and strategies for new and existing features, deciding where automation adds the most value versus targeted manual/exploratory testing.

  • Drive test coverage for IoT device configuration, monitoring, deployment, and connectivity workflows, as well as video playback, recording, and streaming features.

  • Validate distributed cloud systems for correctness, performance, and resilience under realistic and edge-case load.

  • Own test estimation and planning as part of sprint and release cycles, working directly with engineering leads.

Quality Leadership

  • Act as a proactive voice for quality across the engineering org — identifying systemic risks early and proposing engineering solutions (not just flagging bugs).

  • Mentor other engineers and QA team members on automation practices, framework usage, and testable design.

  • Provide direct, technically grounded feedback to developers and stakeholders when quality or architecture decisions are at risk.

What You Bring

Must-Have:

  • 5+ years of experience in software testing with strong hands-on coding ability — this is a build-things role, not primarily a manual-execution role.

  • Strong programming skills in Python, plus working proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript and/or Rust, sufficient to build and maintain real test infrastructure and tooling.

  • Demonstrated experience designing and building test automation frameworks from the ground up (API, UI, or integration layers), not just using existing ones.

  • Comfortable working in Linux environments.

  • Solid understanding of AWS services (Lambda, DynamoDB, SQS, Kinesis, or similar) and how they underpin distributed, serverless SaaS applications.

  • Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and treating test infrastructure as a first-class engineering deliverable.

  • Ability to read and reason about production code, participate meaningfully in code reviews, and collaborate with developers as a technical peer.

  • Strong systems thinking — able to reason about distributed, event-driven, and resilience-focused architectures.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the confidence to give direct, technically substantiated feedback to developers and stakeholders.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical/engineering experience.

Nice-to-Have:

  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools (CDK, Terraform, Serverless Framework) for provisioning test environments.

  • Experience with IoT device communication protocols and building device simulators for test purposes.

  • Experience with video development, video streaming technologies, or testing video pipelines.

  • Familiarity with production monitoring and observability tooling (e.g., Datadog, Grafana, CloudWatch).

  • Experience with Snowflake, Elasticsearch, or other cloud-native data platforms.

  • Contributions to open-source testing/automation tools, or strong personal projects demonstrating framework design skills.

  • Prior experience in a fast-growing SaaS environment.

  • Interest in eventually contributing to product code, or a background that blends SDET and full-stack development work.

Security Requirements

  • Candidates must undergo a criminal records check upon hire.

  • Candidates will be required to attend at least one (1) in-person interview at the Ottawa office.

  • Must be a Canadian citizen (dual citizens included) or eligible to work in Canada.

  • Must be willing to comply with Solink's security policies and standards.

  • Mandatory onboarding in Ottawa during the first week of employment.

  • Periodic in-person visits required (quarterly basis) for non-Ottawa based employees

  • Deliver with QUALITY – We sweat the details and hold a high bar.

  • Win with TEAM – No egos. Just outcomes, built together.

  • Lead with TRUST – We earn it through clarity, consistency, and care.

These aren’t just words—they shape how we hire, lead, and grow.

Why Solink?

  • Clarity and trust: Where the role allows, we support flexibility in how and where work gets done - and we’re upfront about what’s required.

  • Meaningful equity: Every full-time, permanent employee has a stake in our growth.

  • Comprehensive benefits: Fully paid health & dental (no waiting period) + $500 health spending account.

  • Wellness support: Monthly reimbursement for fitness, wellness, or mental health programs.

  • Growth through merit: Advancement is based on contribution, initiative, and the ability to raise the bar - together.

  • Candid culture: Clear expectations, honest feedback, and no politics.

  • Social connection: From So-learns to Solink-o and So-lunches, we stay connected in ways that actually feel fun.

What to Expect from the Hiring Process

raw.title: Senior Salesforce Developer
raw.description:
Senior Salesforce Developer

Level: P4 | Proficient
Location: Canada | Remote
Department Leader: Victoria Wnek, VP of Operations
Type: Permanent | Full Time
Vacancy Status: This is an active, approved role and we are currently hiring for this position.

About Solink

At Solink, our mission is to safeguard what matters most. We provide businesses with the tools to know sooner and act faster by transforming video security into real-time operational insights.

Our cloud-based platform integrates seamlessly with your existing cameras and systems, turning them into intelligent sensors that detect and interpret key moments. This empowers teams to make data-driven decisions, enhance security, and improve operational efficiency.

Trusted by over 35,000 locations across 60+ countries - including brands like McDonald’s and JYSK - Solink delivers clarity when it counts. Our solutions help businesses reduce shrink, optimize performance, and respond proactively to potential threats.

We're growing rapidly, earning industry recognition, and scaling with purpose. We’ve been recognized by Deloitte’s Fast 50™ and Fast 500™, Business Intelligence Group, and as one of Ottawa’s Best Places to Work. And we’re just getting started!

The Role

Salesforce is the core of our technology stack, and this role owns it. You will be the primary Salesforce administrator at Solink, accountable for the reliability, accuracy, and day-to-day health of the platform across Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Operations, and Finance.

Beyond Salesforce, you will have the opportunity to get your hands into the broader tech stack. That means supporting automation workflows in n8n, helping maintain integrations and pitching in where the team needs technical depth. This is not a 50/50 split. Salesforce comes first, and the tech exposure is an opportunity to grow your range over time.

You will work closely with the Director, Operational Excellence and Innovation, giving you clear direction, strong cross-functional support, and a team that is invested in your success.

You'll have modern tooling behind you, Sweep for metadata visibility, documentation, and impact analysis, plus AI development tools like Claude Code, and access to Sweep's professional services team for execution capacity. Direction, judgment, and accountability for the org sit with you: external partners execute what you scope and approve, not the other way around.

This is a hands-on execution role. You take pride in doing the work well, you think in systems, and you want to build something that the business actually trusts.

Where We're At

We migrated our CRM from HubSpot to Salesforce recently. The org is live and adoption is ramping, which means we're in the stabilization phase that follows any cutover: closing out migration debt, hardening what was built quickly to hit the go-live date, and finishing data-model decisions that were deferred. HubSpot remains in production for marketing, with an active bidirectional sync to Salesforce.

Your first 6–12 months will focus on:

  • Stabilizing the post-migration org; cleaning up legacy fields and data-model items carried over from HubSpot, finalizing deduplication and lead-vs-contact routing rules, and triaging user-reported issues as adoption grows

  • Owning the health of the HubSpot–Salesforce sync from the Salesforce side: field mappings, association logic, and sync error resolution, marketing attribution depends on it

  • Bringing Salesforce fully in-house, taking over direction and execution of changes currently handled by external partners

  • Establishing durable release, sandbox, and QA practices so the org scales cleanly from here

If you've been through a HubSpot-to-Salesforce migration before, you'll recognize this phase. That experience is a significant asset in this role.

What You’ll Do

  • Salesforce Administration & Platform Ownership

    • Own the full Salesforce org end-to-end: configuration, automation, security model, data integrity, and performance

    • Manage user roles, profiles, permission sets, flows, validation rules, page layouts, and declarative tooling

    • Translate business requirements from Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Operations and Finance into scalable, well-documented Salesforce solutions

    • Own the data model, object relationships, and automation architecture

    • Work closely with Revenue Operations analysts who build reports and dashboards, ensuring the underlying data model, fields, and configurations in Salesforce support their work accurately and seamlessly

    • Design and build custom apps, objects, and tooling within Salesforce using App Builder and declarative tools

    • Drive data hygiene, duplicate management, and reporting accuracy across the platform

    • Run the intake process for Salesforce change requests, triaging by effort and impact, and communicating timelines clearly

    • Stay current on Salesforce releases, new features, and best practices, and bring relevant improvements to the team

    • Serve as the single internal owner of the Salesforce org. Every configuration and metadata change, whether made by you, by Sweep's platform, or by Sweep's professional services team, is reviewed and approved by you before it reaches production.

    • Direct the work of external partners: define scope, set priorities, review proposed solutions before deployment, and validate delivered work against requirements. You decide what Sweep and their PS team build; they do not set direction.

    • Use Sweep's metadata mapping and impact analysis to inform changes, and independently verify its recommendations before acting on them.

    • Audit and right-size the permissions held by third-party platforms and integration users — including Sweep's connected user — as internal ownership matures.

    • Administer Salesforce Sales Engagement for the BDR team: cadence infrastructure, work queue configuration, permissions, and the connected dialer integration

    Quality Assurance & Release Management

    • Lead QA for all Salesforce changes: new features, integrations, enhancements, and bug fixes

    • Design and execute test plans, regression testing, and UAT coordination

    • Own sandbox strategy (dev, QA, UAT) and manage deployments using change sets or SFDX

    • Serve as the final quality gate before every production deployment

    • Maintain release notes and a change log for every deployment

    Platform Reliability & Technical Debt

    • Monitor org health, governor limits, and system performance proactively

    • Troubleshoot and resolve Salesforce issues quickly, and perform root cause analysis on production incidents

    • Actively identify and reduce technical debt: retire unused fields, flows, objects, and automations

    • Keep the org clean, well-structured, and easier to maintain over time

    Documentation & User Enablement

    • Document every meaningful system change: what was built, how it works, and what it impacts

    • Maintain current architecture documentation for the data model, key automations, and integrations

    • Build and maintain training materials and enablement resources for Salesforce users across the business

    • Write runbooks for common issues and recurring operational tasks

    Revenue Technology & Automation Support

    • Own the Salesforce side of integrations and reduce the number of tech tools we use.

    • Develop a strong working knowledge of NetSuite and the quote-to-cash process so you can collaborate effectively with the systems team and ensure Salesforce and NetSuite stay in sync

    • Understand the full Order to Cashflow and how data moves between systems, and flag or resolve issues where the handoff breaks down

    • Get hands-on with n8n or other tools to automate to help build and maintain automated workflows as needed

    • Identify automation opportunities across the rev tech stack that reduce manual effort and improve data flow

    • Pitch in on broader rev tech tooling where your technical skills add value, with room to grow this part of the role over time

Role Expectations

This is a P4 level role. At Solink, individuals at this level are experienced contributors who operate with a high degree of autonomy within their area of expertise. They lead complex initiatives, influence cross-functional outcomes, and use their expertise to raise the effectiveness of those around them.

In this role, you’ll be expected to:

  • Own the day-to-day health and direction of the Salesforce org, making the configuration, automation, and data-model calls needed to stabilize the post-migration platform while keeping an eye on long-term scalability and technical debt.

  • Lead the transition of Salesforce from externally-managed to fully in-house, directing Sweep's platform and professional services team, scoping and prioritizing their work, and reviewing every change before it reaches production.

  • Act as a trusted technical partner to Revenue Operations, Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Operations, Customer Support and Finance, translating their requirements into practical Salesforce solutions and pushing back when a request would create downstream data, sync, or maintenance problems.

  • Establish and run the release, sandbox, QA, and documentation practices — including ownership of the HubSpot–Salesforce sync — that keep the org reliable and marketing attribution and reporting trustworthy as adoption grows.

  • Raise the team's overall Salesforce effectiveness by reviewing work from partners and teammates, coaching others through tricky configuration or data problems, and bringing best practices back from the wider Salesforce ecosystem.

What success looks like:

  • The post-migration org is stabilized: legacy data-model debt is resolved, and the HubSpot–Salesforce sync runs reliably enough that Marketing, Sales, Operations, Support, Finance and RevOps trust the data without manual reconciliation.

  • Salesforce direction and execution have moved fully in-house, with external partners like Sweep operating within scope, priorities, and reviews that you define.

  • Release, sandbox, and QA practices are established and followed, so changes ship predictably without breaking production or eroding user trust.

What You Bring

Must-Have:

  • 5+ years administering, building and developing on Salesforce Sales Cloud, including time as the primary or sole Salesforce owner at a B2B SaaS company, or equivalent experience owning an org without an architect above you

  • Hands-on Apex: you can write, debug, and maintain classes, triggers, and test coverage, and you know when code is the wrong answer

  • Advanced declarative automation: Flows, validation rules, approval processes, and the judgment to choose declarative vs. programmatic deliberately

  • Lightning Web Components: able to build and maintain custom components where standard UI falls short

  • Background supporting Revenue Operations, Sales, or Customer Success teams in a SaaS environment

  • Experience reducing technical debt or rationalizing an over-customized Salesforce org

Compensation

The salary range for this role is $111,252 - $150,000

We determine compensation based on the experience, skills, and impact you bring to the role.

This means they already have the knowledge, skills, and competencies needed to perform successfully in the role, can ramp up quickly, and are expected to become fully proficient in the position within a short period of time.

Security Requirements

  • Candidates must undergo a criminal records check upon hire;

  • Be a Canadian Citizen (dual citizens included), or eligible to work in Canada;

  • Be willing to comply with Solink’s own security policies and standards.

Our Values

  • Act with URGENCY – Our customers move fast, so we do too.

  • Deliver with QUALITY – We sweat the details and hold a high bar.

  • Win with TEAM – No egos. Just outcomes, built together.

  • Lead with TRUST – We earn it through clarity, consistency, and care.

These aren’t just words—they shape how we hire, lead, and grow.

Why Solink?

We’re not just building tech - we’re building a place where great people do great work.

  • Clarity and trust: Where the role allows, we support flexibility in how and where work gets done - and we’re upfront about what’s required.

  • Meaningful equity: Every full-time, permanent employee has a stake in our growth.

  • Comprehensive benefits: Fully paid health & dental (no waiting period) + $500 health spending account.

  • Wellness support: Monthly reimbursement for fitness, wellness, or mental health programs.

  • Candid culture: Clear expectations, honest feedback, and no politics.

  • Social connection: From So-learns to Solink-o and So-lunches, we stay connected in ways that actually feel fun.

What to Expect from the Hiring Process

We respect your time and value transparency. Here’s a general idea of what to expect:

  1. Intro call with our Talent Team

  2. Interview with the Hiring Manager

  3. Final interviews with cross-functional team members

  4. Reference Checks

  5. Offer & onboarding 🎉

Please note: this is subject to change at any point in the recruitment process based on the needs of the business.

How to Apply

Submit your resume and a short cover letter via our [Careers Page]. Let us know what excites you about this role, and how you’d help move Solink forward.

NOTICE: Solink uses artificial intelligence (AI) to screen, assess, and/or select candidates for this position.

Solink is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. If you require accommodation during the selection process, please let us know.

About Solink

At Solink, our mission is to safeguard what matters most. We provide businesses with the tools to know sooner and act faster by transforming video security into real-time operational insights.

Trusted by over 36,000 locations across 60+ countries - including brands like McDonald’s and JYSK - Solink delivers clarity when it counts. Our solutions help businesses reduce shrink, optimize performance, and respond proactively to potential threats.

We're growing rapidly, earning industry recognition, and scaling with purpose. We’ve been recognized by Deloitte’s Fast 50™ and Fast 500™, Business Intelligence Group, and as one of Ottawa’s Best Places to Work. And we’re just getting started!

The Role

As a Senior Full-Stack Engineer on the Media Team, you will be responsible for the cloud services that power Solink's media pipeline: ingesting, processing, storing, and serving media data at scale for over 36,000 customer locations. You'll work deep in AWS-native infrastructure, building services that are cost-efficient, observable, and resilient under real-world load.

This role is ideal for a senior backend or full-stack engineer who thinks in terms of throughput, latency, and cost per gigabyte as much as they think in code; someone who is comfortable owning a service from design through production operation, and who treats reliability and resource efficiency as first-class design constraints rather than afterthoughts.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, and operate backend services that handle media ingestion, processing, storage, and retrieval at scale.

  • Work extensively with core AWS services (SQS, S3, Lambda, and related managed services) to build event-driven, loosely coupled pipelines.

  • Leverage AI tools effectively throughout the development lifecycle, from planning, design, implementation to operation, debugging and observability.

  • Design and evolve media platform APIs and contracts for multiple internal, as well as external consumers with contract and end-to-end tests.

  • Instrument services with meaningful observability: structured logging, metrics, and traces built on OpenTelemetry concepts, so behaviour in production is understandable regardless of the underlying vendor (Datadog, Grafana, Honeycomb, or otherwise).

  • Own the full deployment lifecycle for your services: staging and production environments, gradual roll-outs, canary releases, and A/B testing of infrastructure and feature changes.

  • Continuously monitor and tune and optimize cloud resource usage (networking, storage tiering, and compute/processing), balancing cost, performance, and reliability trade-offs.

  • Diagnose and resolve complex, cross-service production issues, including intermittent and load-dependent failures in media pipelines.

  • Partner closely with Product, QA, and cross-functional engineering teams to translate media and storage requirements into pragmatic, production-ready services.

  • Contribute to architectural decisions for the media platform, including service boundaries, data models, and integration contracts with other teams.

  • Mentor other engineers through code reviews, design discussions, and informal knowledge sharing.

  • Continuously improve team tooling, run books, and processes, including thoughtful adoption of AI-assisted workflows where appropriate.

What We're Looking For

Must-Have Qualifications

  • Strong experience as a senior-level backend or backend-leaning full-stack engineer, with a track record of owning production services end-to-end for low-latency massive volume data.

  • Hands-on cloud and AWS experience, with proficiency in core services such as SQS, EKS, Redis, and CloudFront alongside S3/Lambda and a solid grasp of designing around their operational characteristics and limits.

  • Strong AI tool usage to increase quality and velocity, and a learning mindset that helps evolve development workflow as AI tooling and capabilities change.

  • Observability experience, not tied to any specific vendor, but a strong conceptual understanding of OpenTelemetry (traces, metrics, logs) and how to use it to make distributed systems debuggable.

  • Practical experience with cloud deployment practices: managing staging and production environments, running gradual/canary roll-outs, and conducting A/B tests on infrastructure or service changes.

  • A resource-aware, optimization-oriented mindset: comfortable fine-tuning cloud networking, storage configuration, and processing pipelines to balance cost, performance, and reliability.

  • Strong distributed systems fundamentals: asynchronous processing, eventual consistency, idempotency, and failure handling in multi-service pipelines.

  • Experience with modern backend development, including API design and production reliability practices.

  • Comfortable diagnosing complex, cross-service, and intermittent production issues independently and under pressure.

  • Strong problem-solving skills, an ownership mindset, and the ability to influence technical decisions beyond your own code.

  • Comfortable improving and extending legacy, brownfield services.

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience with media, video, or other high-throughput binary data pipelines and technologies (e.g. WebRTC, HLS, RTSP, ffmpeg).

  • Experience with Kubernetes and cloud-native operations (observability, metrics/tracing, incident response, SLOs).

  • Experience with GCP and Azure

  • Experience with TypeScript and Rust

  • Experience scaling systems in high-growth or "next-stage" environments.

  • Interest in applying AI/ML to improve product capabilities and team productivity.

Security Requirements

  • Candidates must undergo a criminal records check upon hire;

  • Be a Canadian Citizen (dual citizens included), or eligible to work in Canada;

  • Be willing to comply with Solink’s own security policies and standards.

Our Values

We do things the Solink way:

  • Act with URGENCY – Our customers move fast, so we do too.

  • Deliver with QUALITY – We sweat the details and hold a high bar.

  • Win with TEAM – No egos. Just outcomes, built together.

  • Lead with TRUST – We earn it through clarity, consistency, and care.

These aren’t just words—they shape how we hire, lead, and grow.

Why Solink?

We’re not just building tech - we’re building a place where great people do great work.

  • Clarity and trust: Where the role allows, we support flexibility in how and where work gets done - and we’re upfront about what’s required.

  • Meaningful equity: Every full-time, permanent employee has a stake in our growth.

  • Comprehensive benefits: Fully paid health & dental (no waiting period) + $500 health spending account.

  • Wellness support: Monthly reimbursement for fitness, wellness, or mental health programs.

  • Growth through merit: Advancement is based on contribution, initiative, and the ability to raise the bar - together.

  • Candid culture: Clear expectations, honest feedback, and no politics.

  • Social connection: From So-learns to Solink-o and So-lunches, we stay connected in ways that actually feel fun.

What to Expect from the Hiring Process

We respect your time and value transparency. Here’s a general idea of what to expect:

  1. Intro call with our Talent Team

  2. Interview with the Hiring Manager

  3. Role-relevant task or case (if applicable)

  4. Final interviews with cross-functional team members

  5. Reference Checks

  6. Offer & onboarding 🎉

Submit your resume and a short cover letter via our Careers Page. Let us know what excites you about this role, and how you’d help move Solink forward.

raw.title: Account Executive, Enterprise
raw.description:
Account Executive, Enterprise

Location: Canada | Remote
Department: Direct Sales | Enterprise
Reports To: Vladlena Milicenco | VP, Enterprise Sales
 Type: Permanent | Full-Time

About Solink

At Solink, our mission is to safeguard what matters most. We provide businesses with the tools to know sooner and act faster by transforming video security into real-time operational insights.

Our cloud-based platform integrates seamlessly with your existing cameras and systems, turning them into intelligent sensors that detect and interpret key moments. This empowers teams to make data-driven decisions, enhance security, and improve operational efficiency.

Trusted by over 30,000 locations across 32+ countries - including brands like McDonald’s and JYSK - Solink delivers clarity when it counts. Our solutions help businesses reduce shrink, optimize performance, and respond proactively to potential threats.

We're growing rapidly, earning industry recognition, and scaling with purpose. We’ve been recognized by Deloitte’s Fast 50™ and Fast 500™, Business Intelligence Group, and as one of Ottawa’s Best Places to Work. And we’re just getting started!

The Role

We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Enterprise SaaS Account Executive to join our team. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record in large enterprise SaaS sales models and cycles. As an Enterprise Account Executive at Solink, you will play a crucial role in driving our growth by acquiring and managing key enterprise accounts, delivering exceptional value to our customers, and contributing to the overall success of the company.

What You’ll Do

  • Business Development

    • Target Enterprise Accounts: Identify and prioritize high-value enterprise opportunities within the physical security, retail, and loss prevention sectors.

    • Build Pipeline: Source leads through outbound prospecting, industry events, networking, and leveraging internal tools like ZoomInfo, HubSpot, and Gong.

  • Sales Execution

    • Own the Full Sales Cycle: Lead end-to-end sales activities—from discovery and presentations to negotiation, and close.

    • Tailor Solutions: Collaborate with Marketing, Product, and Customer Success to design solutions that align with each customer’s unique goals and infrastructure.

    • Demonstrate Product Expertise: Deliver compelling demos and business cases that showcase the ROI of Solink’s platform and its impact on physical security and operational efficiency.

  • Account Management

    • Build Executive Relationships: Establish and maintain trust with key decision-makers, from security leads to C-level executives in Fortune 1000 companies.

    • Drive Customer Success: Act as a strategic partner—ensuring satisfaction, identifying pain points, and consulting on long-term platform growth.

    • Upsell & Expand: Identify and pursue upsell and cross-sell opportunities within your existing customer base to maximize account value.

  • Market Insights

    • Track Industry Trends: Stay informed on developments in physical security, loss prevention, and emerging technologies impacting the space.

    • Inform Strategy: Gather and relay customer feedback and competitive insights to inform sales tactics and product development priorities.

Role Expectations

This is a P4 level role. At Solink, individuals at this level are experienced contributors who operate with a high degree of autonomy within their area of expertise. They lead complex initiatives, influence cross-functional outcomes, and use their expertise to raise the effectiveness of those around them.

In this role, you’ll be expected to:

  • Strategically own and develop high-value enterprise accounts, building account plans that create pipeline, expand relationships, and consistently deliver against revenue commitments.

  • Lead complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles end-to-end, anticipating risks, navigating enterprise buying processes, and aligning internal and customer stakeholders to drive opportunities to close.

  • Effectively navigate both direct and channel-led sales motions, partnering with Solink’s Channel team and ecosystem partners to develop opportunities, coordinate deal strategy, and drive opportunities to close.

  • Build trusted relationships with senior and executive decision-makers, acting as a strategic advisor who connects customer priorities to measurable business value with Solink.

  • Partner strategically across Product, Marketing, Customer Success, and other teams, representing customer and market perspectives and influencing strong cross-functional outcomes.

  • Raise team effectiveness by sharing enterprise selling expertise, mentoring peers through complex opportunities, and contributing insights and best practices that improve how the broader team sells.

What Success Looks Like:

  • You consistently build and convert a healthy enterprise pipeline, delivering against revenue targets and landing high-impact accounts.

  • Complex opportunities progress with clear strategy, strong stakeholder alignment, compelling business cases, and disciplined execution.

  • Executive stakeholders view you as a trusted advisor who understands their priorities and can connect Solink’s platform to meaningful business outcomes.

  • Enterprise relationships grow beyond the initial sale through strategic expansion, upsell, and cross-sell opportunities that increase long-term account value.

  • Cross-functional teams trust your customer and market perspective and use your insights to strengthen sales tactics, customer solutions, and product priorities.

  • Your expertise, coaching, and best practices help other sellers navigate complex opportunities and contribute to stronger performance across the team.

 

What You Bring

  • Experienced Enterprise Seller: You have 5+ years of success managing full-cycle enterprise accounts using a consultative, solution-oriented sales approach in complex SaaS environments.

  • Strategic Sales Expert: You understand large account strategies, have experience navigating enterprise buying committees, and are skilled in long-cycle, multi-stakeholder deals.

  • Understand the Customer’s Business: Develop a strong understanding of each prospect’s operational environment and connect Solink’s capabilities to business priorities such as reducing loss, improving security, increasing operational visibility, and driving consistency across locations.

  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Partner closely with Sales Engineering, Product, Marketing, Customer Success and other internal teams to align customer needs with tailored solutions and deliver a compelling buyer experience.

  • Articulate Value Clearly: Translate Solink’s technical capabilities into measurable business outcomes for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Engage In-Person: Travel occasionally to meet with prospects and customers across the UK and Northern Europe for meetings, industry events, and field sales opportunities.

They lead complex initiatives, influence outcomes across teams, and use their expertise to raise the effectiveness of those around them.

In this role, you’ll be expected to:

  • Strategically own and develop your territory, leading complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles and consistently delivering against pipeline, forecast, and revenue commitments.

  • Anticipate risks and blockers, proactively developing solutions and aligning the right internal and customer stakeholders to keep opportunities moving forward.

  • Build trusted relationships with senior and executive stakeholders, translating complex operational challenges into compelling solutions and measurable business outcomes.

  • Partner strategically across Sales Engineering, Product, Marketing, Customer Success, and other teams, representing customer and market perspectives and influencing strong cross-functional outcomes.

  • Raise team effectiveness by sharing expertise, coaching peers through complex opportunities, contributing scalable sales practices and resources, and continuously applying feedback and industry learnings.

What Success Looks Like:

  • Your territory consistently generates a healthy pipeline and delivers against revenue targets.

  • Complex, multi-stakeholder opportunities progress with clear strategy, strong internal alignment, and predictable execution.

  • Customers and prospects view you as a trusted advisor who understands their business and connects Solink’s capabilities to measurable outcomes.

  • Your pipeline and forecasts are accurate, disciplined, and provide clear visibility into risks, opportunities, and expected results.

  • Cross-functional partners trust you to bring the right people together, represent customer needs effectively, and drive opportunities forward.

  • Your expertise, market insights, and best practices strengthen how the broader team sells and succeeds internationally.
