Level: P4
Location: Remote | Canada
Department: Finance
Reports To: Urvi Kamleshkumar Shah | Assistant Controller
Type: Permanent | Full-Time
Vacancy Status: This is an active role and we are currently hiring for this position.

About Solink

At Solink, our mission is to safeguard what matters most. We provide businesses with the tools to know sooner and act faster by transforming video security into real-time operational insights.

Our cloud-based platform integrates seamlessly with your existing cameras and systems, turning them into intelligent sensors that detect and interpret key moments. This empowers teams to make data-driven decisions, enhance security, and improve operational efficiency.

Trusted by over 35,000 locations across 60+ countries - including brands like McDonald’s and JYSK - Solink delivers clarity when it counts. Our solutions help businesses reduce shrink, optimize performance, and respond proactively to potential threats.

We're growing rapidly, earning industry recognition, and scaling with purpose. We’ve been recognized by Deloitte’s Fast 50™ and Fast 500™, Business Intelligence Group, and as one of Ottawa’s Best Places to Work. And we’re just getting started!

The Role

We're looking for a Technical Accounting Manager to be our go-to person on technical accounting research, keeping our accounting policies current, and assisting with complex transaction accounting for the company. This role is distinct from the core close/consolidation function — it's focused on getting the judgment calls right: revenue recognition for complex or bundled hardware/software arrangements, new accounting pronouncements, and one-off or non-routine transactions. You'll report to the Assistant Controller and act as the internal technical resource for the rest of the accounting and finance operations team, as well as a key liaison to external auditors on complex matters.

Given our hardware-enabled SaaS model and multi-entity structure reporting under IFRS, this role has real scope for meaningful technical work — multi-element revenue arrangements, lease accounting, share-based payments, and financial instruments, among others.

What You’ll Do

  • Research and document technical accounting positions on complex or non-routine transactions (e.g., multi-element hardware/SaaS bundled arrangements, contract modifications, new product launches).

  • Draft accounting memos supporting judgment areas under IFRS (e.g., IFRS 15 revenue recognition, IFRS 16 leases, IFRS 2 share-based payments, IAS 36 impairment).

  • Monitor new and amended IFRS pronouncements, assess impact on the business, and lead implementation efforts.

  • Partner with Legal, Sales, and Product teams to review new contract structures and advise on accounting implications before deals close.

  • Work with the Assistant Controller to review technical accounting policies and ensure they are documented, current, and consistently applied across all legal entities.

  • Act as the primary point of contact for auditors on technical accounting matters and complex areas of judgment.

  • Support M&A due diligence and purchase accounting, if applicable.

  • Partner with the Assistant Controller on the practical application of technical positions during the close process.

  • Provide training and guidance to the broader accounting team on technical topics.

Role Expectations

This is a P4 level role. At Solink, individuals at this level are established contributors who work independently within their area of expertise while receiving general direction from their manager.

In this role, you'll be expected to:

  • Serves as the go-to resource for IFRS interpretation on complex, non-routine transactions for the accounting team and the entire organization

  • Drafts technical accounting memos and position papers with minimal oversight

  • Evaluates new revenue arrangements, leases, or financial instruments for accounting treatment

  • Own Solink’s accounting policy manual

What success looks like:

  • Solink accounting policy manual is completed and up to date

  • Clean and efficient annual audit process

  • Solink prepared well in advance of any accounting changes impacting financial reporting

What You Bring

Must-Have

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance or related field; CPA or CA required (or in progress).

  • 3-5 years of accounting experience, including public accounting (Big 4 or large regional firm) experience strongly preferred.

  • Deep working knowledge of IFRS, with particular strength in revenue recognition (IFRS 15) and other judgment-heavy areas.

  • Comfortable using AI tools to accelerate research and first-draft memo preparation, with rigorous review and professional judgment applied before finalizing any position.

  • Experience with multi-element or bundled revenue arrangements — hardware/software combined offerings a strong plus.

  • Strong technical writing skills; ability to produce clear, well-supported accounting memos.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-accounting stakeholders (Sales, Legal, Product).

Preferred Experience

  • Exposure to IFRS reporting.

  • Experience working directly with external auditors on complex accounting matters.

  • Experience in a hardware-enabled SaaS or similarly complex revenue environment.

  • Experience with multi-entity, multi-currency reporting structures.

  • Experience leading new accounting standard implementation projects.

Security Requirements

  • Candidates must undergo a criminal records check upon hire;

  • Be a Canadian Citizen (dual citizens included), or eligible to work in Canada;

  • Be willing to comply with Solink’s own security policies and standards.

Our Values

We do things the Solink way:

  • Act with URGENCY – Our customers move fast, so we do too.

  • Deliver with QUALITY – We sweat the details and hold a high bar.

  • Win with TEAM – No egos. Just outcomes, built together.

  • Lead with TRUST – We earn it through clarity, consistency, and care.

These aren’t just words—they shape how we hire, lead, and grow.

Why Solink?

We’re not just building tech - we’re building a place where great people do great work.

  • Clarity and trust: Where the role allows, we support flexibility in how and where work gets done - and we’re upfront about what’s required.

  • Meaningful equity: Every full-time, permanent employee has a stake in our growth.

  • Comprehensive benefits: Fully paid health & dental (no waiting period) + $500 health spending account.

  • Wellness support: Monthly reimbursement for fitness, wellness, or mental health programs.

  • Growth through merit: Advancement is based on contribution, initiative, and the ability to raise the bar - together.

  • Candid culture: Clear expectations, honest feedback, and no politics.

  • Social connection: From So-learns to Solink-o and So-lunches, we stay connected in ways that actually feel fun.

What to Expect from the Hiring Process

We respect your time and value transparency. Here’s a general idea of what to expect:

  1. Introductory Call With Our Talent Team

  2. Interview With the Hiring Manager

  3. Role-Relevant Task or Case Study (if applicable)

  4. Final Interviews With Cross-Functional Team Members

  5. Reference Checks

  6. Offer & Onboarding 🎉

Please note: this is subject to change at any point in the recruitment process based on the needs of the business.

How to Apply

Submit your resume and a short cover letter via our Careers Page. Let us know what excites you about this role, and how you’d help move Solink forward.

NOTICE: Solink uses artificial intelligence (AI) to screen, assess, and/or select candidates for this position.

Solink is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. If you require accommodation during the selection process, please let us know.

AI Enablement Lead

Level: P4 | High Proficient
Location: Remote | Canada
Reports To: Grace Barbosa-Chin, Senior Director, P&C
Type: Permanent | Full-Time

About Solink

At Solink, our mission is to safeguard what matters most. We provide businesses with the tools to know sooner and act faster by transforming video security into real-time operational insights.

Our cloud-based platform integrates seamlessly with your existing cameras and systems, turning them into intelligent sensors that detect and interpret key moments. This empowers teams to make data-driven decisions, enhance security, and improve operational efficiency.

Trusted by over 35,000 locations across 60+ countries - including brands like McDonald’s and JYSK - Solink delivers clarity when it counts. Our solutions help businesses reduce shrink, optimize performance, and respond proactively to potential threats.

We're growing rapidly, earning industry recognition, and scaling with purpose. We’ve been recognized by Deloitte’s Fast 50™ and Fast 500™, Business Intelligence Group, and as one of Ottawa’s Best Places to Work. And we’re just getting started!

The Role

We are looking for an AI Enablement Lead to help build and scale how our organization works with AI. This role sits within People & Culture because our opportunity with AI is fundamentally about people, capability, and how work gets done. The AI Enablement Lead will be responsible for building the skills, habits, systems, and community that enable employees to use AI effectively, responsibly, and consistently across the company.

This is not an AI engineering role. Instead, this person will operate at the intersection of AI, learning, organizational change, and business transformation. A core part of the role will be building and leading our AI Superteam: a cross-functional network of AI experts and champions embedded within each department. These individuals will maintain their existing functional reporting lines while having a dotted-line relationship to the AI Enablement Lead. Together, this network will identify opportunities, test new ways of working, share best practices, and scale high-impact AI use cases across the organization.

The ideal candidate is both AI-fluent and highly people-oriented. They do not need to be the deepest technical AI expert in the company. They need to understand what AI can enable, translate that into practical changes in how people work, and bring people together to make those changes stick.

What You’ll Do

AI Enablement Strategy

  • Develop and execute a company-wide strategy for AI capability, adoption, and enablement in partnership with leadership, Technology, Security, Legal, and business teams.

  • Identify the skills, behaviours, and ways of working employees will need as AI becomes increasingly embedded in our work.

  • Build a practical roadmap for moving the organization from AI awareness to meaningful adoption and measurable impact.

AI Superteam

  • Build, coordinate, and lead a cross-functional AI Superteam made up of designated AI experts from across the organization.

  • Establish a clear operating model, expectations, priorities, and cadence for the Superteam.

  • Create a forum where teams can share experiments, successful use cases, challenges, and emerging AI practices.

  • Partner with department AI experts to identify high-value opportunities and help move promising experiments from individual use cases into scalable organizational practices.

  • Create mechanisms for knowledge-sharing so that an AI innovation in one function can be discovered and adapted by others.

Learning & Capability Building

  • Design and deliver role-based AI learning experiences for employees, managers, and leaders.

  • Build practical resources such as playbooks, use-case libraries, prompt frameworks, guides, workshops, and office hours.

  • Help employees develop the judgment required to evaluate AI-generated work for accuracy, quality, usefulness, completeness, and appropriate human review.

  • Develop AI learning pathways that evolve as tools and organizational needs change.

Adoption & Change Management

  • Drive adoption of AI tools and new AI-enabled ways of working across the organization.

  • Partner with leaders and teams to identify where AI can meaningfully improve productivity, quality, decision-making, or employee experience.

  • Help teams move beyond experimentation toward sustainable changes in workflows and operating practices.

  • Identify and address barriers to adoption, including capability gaps, confidence, behaviour, process friction, and unclear expectations.

Measurement & Continuous Improvement

  • Define and track meaningful measures of AI adoption, capability, and impact.

  • Assess where employees and teams are making effective use of AI and where additional enablement is required.

  • Gather feedback and insights from the AI Superteam and broader employee population to continuously improve our AI strategy and programs.

  • Share progress, learnings, and recommendations with senior leadership.

What This Role Does, and Does Not, Own

The AI Enablement Lead owns organizational AI capability and adoption.

This includes:

  • AI learning and enablement

  • AI adoption and change management

  • AI community and the AI Superteam

  • Cross-functional knowledge sharing

  • Role-based AI capability development

  • Measurement of AI readiness, adoption, and impact

  • Identification and scaling of proven AI practices

This role does not independently own:

  • AI product or software engineering

  • Enterprise AI architecture

  • Cybersecurity or data security controls

  • Legal or privacy policy

  • Technical procurement or infrastructure

The AI Enablement Lead will partner closely with the teams responsible for these areas to ensure that employee enablement and technical governance evolve together.

How the AI Superteam Works

Each major function will designate an AI Expert / AI Champion who remains embedded within their department while maintaining a dotted-line relationship to the AI Enablement Lead.

These departmental AI experts will:

  • Identify AI opportunities within their function

  • Experiment with new tools and workflows

  • Help colleagues adopt effective AI practices

  • Bring functional challenges and learnings to the Superteam

  • Share successful use cases across the organization

  • Partner on cross-functional AI initiatives

  • Help identify emerging skills and capability needs within their function

Together, the AI Enablement Lead and AI Superteam will create a united model of AI innovation and enablement: close enough to the business to understand real needs, but connected enough to scale what works.

What Success Looks Like

In the first 12–24 months, success could include:

  • A functioning AI Superteam with strong participation across key functions

  • Clear AI capability expectations and learning pathways for employees

  • Meaningful growth in employee confidence and effective AI usage

  • A growing library of validated, high-impact AI use cases

  • AI practices successfully scaling across multiple departments

  • Managers increasingly incorporating AI into how work is designed and delegated

  • Evidence that AI is improving productivity, quality, speed, or employee experience

  • A clear understanding of the skills and capabilities our workforce will need as AI continues to evolve

The Profile We Are Looking For

  • You are someone who gets excited about what AI makes possible for people.

  • You are comfortable experimenting with new technology, but you are equally interested in the organizational challenge of helping hundreds of people adopt it effectively.

  • You are a connector: you naturally bring together people, ideas, and teams.

  • You don't need to have all the answers yourself. You know how to find the people who do, create the right environment for experimentation, identify what works, and turn individual innovation into organizational capability.

  • Most importantly, you believe that the biggest AI opportunity is not simply giving people better tools, it is helping people work differently and better because those tools exist.

A little bit about you

  • You’re naturally curious and a self-starter, always exploring what’s possible, experimenting with new ideas, and turning what you learn into action without waiting for direction.

  • 4+ years of experience in learning & development, organizational development, enablement, change management, transformation, or a related field

  • Demonstrated experience designing and scaling organizational learning or capability programs

  • Experience driving adoption of new technologies, processes, or ways of working

  • Experience working cross-functionally with senior stakeholders and distributed teams

  • Experience building communities of practice, champion networks, or similar grassroots enablement models is highly valued

  • Strong practical understanding of generative AI and modern AI tools

  • Hands-on experience using AI to improve real-world knowledge work

  • Ability to distinguish between interesting AI experimentation and genuinely valuable business applications

  • Strong understanding of responsible AI use, including human oversight, data considerations, quality, and appropriate judgment

  • Curiosity and comfort operating in a rapidly changing technology landscape

  • Exceptional facilitator and communicator

  • Strong change-management instincts and a bias toward experimentation and learning

Security Requirements

  • Candidates must undergo a criminal records check upon hire;

  • Be a Canadian Citizen (dual citizens included), or eligible to work in Canada;

  • Be willing to comply with Solink’s own security policies and standards.

Our Values

We do things the Solink way:

  • Act with URGENCY – Our customers move fast, so we do too.

  • Deliver with QUALITY – We sweat the details and hold a high bar.

  • Win with TEAM – No egos. Just outcomes, built together.

  • Lead with TRUST – We earn it through clarity, consistency, and care.

Our Company Competencies

  • Customer Focus - We are putting customer impact at the center of our decisions, using insights, data, and feedback to deliver consistent value today while shaping long-term trust, loyalty, and sustainable growth.

  • Systems Thinking - We are designing and evolving processes, tools, and operating models so reliable outcomes can occur without individual intervention.

  • AI Amplified Execution - We are thoughtfully integrating AI into how work gets done, not just to move faster, but to solve better problems, redesign workflows, and create scalable advantage.

  • Outcome Ownership - We take full accountability for the results we create, including the decisions, compromises, successes, and failures, and using those outcomes to improve future performance.

NOTICE: Solink uses artificial intelligence (AI) to screen, assess, and/or select candidates for this position.

Solink is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. If you require accommodation during the selection process, please let us know.

The AI Enablement Lead will partner closely with the teams responsible for these areas to ensure that employee enablement and technical governance evolve together.




HOW THE AI SUPERTEAM WORKS

Each major function will designate an AI Expert / AI Champion who remains embedded within their department while maintaining a dotted-line relationship to the AI Enablement Lead.

These departmental AI experts will:

 - Identify AI opportunities within their function

 - Experiment with new tools and workflows

 - Help colleagues adopt effective AI practices

 - Bring functional challenges and learnings to the Superteam

 - Share successful use cases across the organization

 - Partner on cross-functional AI initiatives

 - Help identify emerging skills and capability needs within their function

Together, the AI Enablement Lead and AI Superteam will create a united model of AI innovation and enablement: close enough to the business to understand real needs, but connected enough to scale what works.




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

In the first 12–24 months, success could include:

 - A functioning AI Superteam with strong participation across key functions

 - Clear AI capability expectations and learning pathways for employees

 - Meaningful growth in employee confidence and effective AI usage

 - A growing library of validated, high-impact AI use cases

 - AI practices successfully scaling across multiple departments

 - Managers increasingly incorporating AI into how work is designed and delegated

 - Evidence that AI is improving productivity, quality, speed, or employee experience

 - A clear understanding of the skills and capabilities our workforce will need as AI continues to evolve




THE PROFILE WE ARE LOOKING FOR

 - You are someone who gets excited about what AI makes possible for people.

 - You are comfortable experimenting with new technology, but you are equally interested in the organizational challenge of helping hundreds of people adopt it effectively.

 - You are a connector: you naturally bring together people, ideas, and teams.

 - You don't need to have all the answers yourself. You know how to find the people who do, create the right environment for experimentation, identify what works, and turn individual innovation into organizational capability.

 - Most importantly, you believe that the biggest AI opportunity is not simply giving people better tools, it is helping people work differently and better because those tools exist.




A LITTLE BIT ABOUT YOU

 - You’re naturally curious and a self-starter, always exploring what’s possible, experimenting with new ideas, and turning what you learn into action without waiting for direction.

 - 4+ years of experience in learning & development, organizational development, enablement, change management, transformation, or a related field

 - Demonstrated experience designing and scaling organizational learning or capability programs

 - Experience driving adoption of new technologies, processes, or ways of working

 - Experience working cross-functionally with senior stakeholders and distributed teams

 - Experience building communities of practice, champion networks, or similar grassroots enablement models is highly valued

 - Strong practical understanding of generative AI and modern AI tools

 - Hands-on experience using AI to improve real-world knowledge work

 - Ability to distinguish between interesting AI experimentation and genuinely valuable business applications

 - Strong understanding of responsible AI use, including human oversight, data considerations, quality, and appropriate judgment

 - Curiosity and comfort operating in a rapidly changing technology landscape

 - Exceptional facilitator and communicator

 - Strong change-management instincts and a bias toward experimentation and learning




SECURITY REQUIREMENTS

 - Candidates must undergo a criminal records check upon hire;

 - Be a Canadian Citizen (dual citizens included), or eligible to work in Canada;

 - Be willing to comply with Solink’s own security policies and standards.




OUR VALUES

We do things the Solink way:

 - Act with URGENCY – Our customers move fast, so we do too.

 - Deliver with QUALITY – We sweat the details and hold a high bar.

 - Win with TEAM – No egos. Just outcomes, built together.

 - Lead with TRUST – We earn it through clarity, consistency, and care.




OUR COMPANY COMPETENCIES

 - Customer Focus - We are putting customer impact at the center of our decisions, using insights, data, and feedback to deliver consistent value today while shaping long-term trust, loyalty, and sustainable growth.

 - Systems Thinking - We are designing and evolving processes, tools, and operating models so reliable outcomes can occur without individual intervention.

 - AI Amplified Execution - We are thoughtfully integrating AI into how work gets done, not just to move faster, but to solve better problems, redesign workflows, and create scalable advantage.

 - Outcome Ownership - We take full accountability for the results we create, including the decisions, compromises, successes, and failures, and using those outcomes to improve future performance.


NOTICE: SOLINK USES ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE (AI) TO SCREEN, ASSESS, AND/OR SELECT CANDIDATES FOR THIS POSITION.

Department: SMB Sales | Regulated Industries
Reports To: Cal McDonald | Manager of Sales, Regulated Industries
Type: Permanent | Full-Time
Vacancy Status: This is an active, approved role and we are currently hiring for this position.

About Solink

At Solink, our mission is to safeguard what matters most. We provide businesses with the tools to know sooner and act faster by transforming video security into real-time operational insights.

Our cloud-based platform integrates seamlessly with your existing cameras and systems, turning them into intelligent sensors that detect and interpret key moments. This empowers teams to make data-driven decisions, enhance security, and improve operational efficiency.

Trusted by over 36,000 locations across 60+ countries - including brands like McDonald’s and JYSK - Solink delivers clarity when it counts. Our solutions help businesses reduce shrink, optimize performance, and respond proactively to potential threats.

We're growing rapidly, earning industry recognition, and scaling with purpose. We’ve been recognized by Deloitte’s Fast 50™ and Fast 500™, Business Intelligence Group, and as one of Ottawa’s Best Places to Work. And we’re just getting started!

The Role

We’re looking for curious, driven, and high-energy sales talent to join our fast-growing team and make an impact with some of the most recognizable brands across retail, hospitality, and regulated industries. If you thrive on prospecting, love building pipeline, and have experience selling SaaS as an Account Executive, this is your moment.

In this role, you’ll take the lead selling Solink to licensed cannabis retailers and operators, helping them stay compliant, reduce loss, and gain real-time operational visibility in a fast-moving, highly regulated space.

Are you a self-starter who loves momentum and isn’t afraid to take initiative? Do you get excited about building relationships, running compelling demos, and closing meaningful deals? Do you thrive in a collaborative, high-energy team environment where wins are celebrated and growth is constant?... Then this opportunity is for YOU!

What You’ll Do

  • Prospect with Purpose: Identify and reach out to brands you admire and customers who would benefit from Solink—using a smart, targeted, and proactive approach.

  • Own the Full Sales Cycle: From discovery and demos to pricing, negotiation, and close—you’ll lead every step with confidence and precision.

  • Deliver High-Impact Demos: Present Solink’s platform in a compelling way that speaks to each customer’s unique challenges and goals.

  • Hit (and Exceed) Your Targets: Consistently meet or exceed quota, while staying focused on quality conversations, qualified pipeline, and long-term customer value.

  • Have Fun Doing It: Celebrate wins, bring energy, and enjoy the journey—because culture matters just as much as closing.

What You Bring

Must-Have:

  • Team Player with Individual Hustle: You love celebrating wins with a supportive team—but you also hold yourself to a high standard and consistently push to exceed your own goals.

  • Value-Driven Communicator: You can clearly connect the dots between a customer’s pain points and Solink’s value. You’re equally fluent in big-picture impact and detailed product differentiation.

  • Relationship Builder: Whether it’s with teammates or prospects, you build trust naturally and quickly. You understand people, meet them where they are, and connect with empathy.

  • Growth-Oriented: You’re a sponge for feedback and personal development. You invest in your own growth and actively share learnings with your team.

  • Goal Crusher: Quotas aren’t ceilings—they’re starting points. You set the bar high and love surpassing it.

  • Customer-Centric Listener: You’re naturally curious and know that listening—not pitching—is the foundation of great discovery and great deals.

  • Creative Problem Solver: Challenges energize you. You think on your feet and approach obstacles with creativity and a solution-first mindset.

Nice-to-Have:

  • Regulated Industry Experience: Selling into licensed cannabis retailers or operators, alcohol retailers, especially multi-store or enterprise groups.

  • Regulatory Awareness: Familiarity with cannabis/alcohol compliance, loss prevention, and audit-driven environments.

  • Cannabis Retail Background: Previous work experience in a cannabis retail or licensed operator setting.

Security Requirements

  • Candidates must undergo a criminal records check upon hire;

  • Be a Canadian Citizen (dual citizens included), or eligible to work in Canada;

  • Be willing to comply with Solink’s own security policies and standards.

Our Values

We do things the Solink way:

  • Act with URGENCY – Our customers move fast, so we do too.

  • Deliver with QUALITY – We sweat the details and hold a high bar.

  • Win with TEAM – No egos. Just outcomes, built together.

  • Lead with TRUST – We earn it through clarity, consistency, and care.

These aren’t just words—they shape how we hire, lead, and grow.

Why Solink?

We’re not just building tech - we’re building a place where great people do great work.

  • Clarity and trust: Where the role allows, we support flexibility in how and where work gets done - and we’re upfront about what’s required.

  • Meaningful equity: Every full-time, permanent employee has a stake in our growth.

  • Comprehensive benefits: Fully paid health & dental (no waiting period) + $500 health spending account.

  • Wellness support: Monthly reimbursement for fitness, wellness, or mental health programs.

  • Growth through merit: Advancement is based on contribution, initiative, and the ability to raise the bar - together.

  • Candid culture: Clear expectations, honest feedback, and no politics.

  • Social connection: From So-learns to Solink-o and So-lunches, we stay connected in ways that actually feel fun.

What to Expect from the Hiring Process

We respect your time and value transparency. Here’s a general idea of what to expect:

  1. Intro call with our Talent Team

  2. Interview with the Hiring Manager

  3. Final interviews with cross-functional team members

  4. Reference Checks

  5. Offer & onboarding 🎉

Please note: this is subject to change at any point in the recruitment process based on the needs of the business.

NOTICE: Solink uses artificial intelligence (AI) to screen, assess, and/or select candidates for this position.

Solink is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. If you require accommodation during the selection process, please let us know.

raw.title: Channel Account Manager
raw.description:
Channel Account Manager

Location: Canada | Remote
Department: Partner Alliance
Reports To: Doug Sutter
Type: Permanent | Full-Time

About Solink

At Solink, our mission is to safeguard what matters most. We provide businesses with the tools to know sooner and act faster by transforming video security into real-time operational insights.

Our cloud-based platform integrates seamlessly with your existing cameras and systems, turning them into intelligent sensors that detect and interpret key moments. This empowers teams to make data-driven decisions, enhance security, and improve operational efficiency.

Trusted by over 35,000 locations across 60+ countries - including brands like McDonald’s and JYSK - Solink delivers clarity when it counts. Our solutions help businesses reduce shrink, optimize performance, and respond proactively to potential threats.

We're growing rapidly, earning industry recognition, and scaling with purpose. We’ve been recognized by Deloitte’s Fast 50™ and Fast 500™, Business Intelligence Group, and as one of Ottawa’s Best Places to Work. And we’re just getting started!

The Role

We’re expanding our Channel team and hiring a Channel Account Manager (CAM) to own and grow Solink’s strategic partnership with Comcast. This is a quota-carrying, pipeline-generation role responsible for activating Comcast sellers, driving deal registration, running a disciplined co-sell motion with Solink Account Executives and Brand Specialists, and progressing opportunities from initial engagement through pilot and multi-site rollout.

You’ll act as the bridge between Solink and Comcast, building relationships across divisions, regions, and levels of the organization to earn seller mindshare and make Solink easy to sell. You’ll be close to where the selling happens—enabling sellers, coaching live opportunities, coordinating the right Solink resources, and removing friction before it stalls a deal.

Your success will be measured by the partner-sourced pipeline and bookings generated through Comcast, the volume and quality of registered opportunities, and the co-sell revenue you help drive alongside Solink’s sales organization.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Activate Comcast Sellers at Scale: Build seller engagement across Comcast divisions through training, targeted 1:1 enablement, and live opportunity coaching. Help sellers recognize when Solink is a strong fit and confidently introduce the solution to their customers.

  • Drive Partner-Sourced Pipeline & Bookings: Create the cadence, accountability, and joint activity required to consistently generate qualified Comcast-sourced opportunities and convert them into revenue.

  • Own the Deal Registration Motion: Manage deal registration end-to-end, including validating opportunities and site counts, coordinating pricing and approvals, protecting partner opportunities, and removing friction so deals progress efficiently.

  • Run a Disciplined Co-Sell Motion: Partner with Solink Account Executives and Brand Specialists to map Comcast’s install base against target accounts, coordinate joint outreach, clarify ownership throughout the sales process, and keep opportunities moving.

  • Progress Pilots into Rollouts: Coordinate the right resources across Sales Engineering, Customer Success, and other Solink teams to support successful pilots and help Comcast build compelling cases for broader customer expansion.

  • Build Repeatable Brand Plays: Leverage Solink’s approved-vendor relationships and standard pricing within major restaurant brands to develop repeatable franchise plays, penetration strategies, introductions, and joint outreach with Comcast.

  • Deliver World-Class Partner Enablement: Maintain a consistent enablement cadence covering Solink’s platform, vertical positioning, competitive plays, technical fundamentals, sales tools, and escalation paths that keep Comcast sellers confident and unblocked.

  • Forecast, Track & Report Performance: Run structured pipeline reviews with Comcast leadership, maintain accurate CRM and PRM data, and provide clear forecasts and performance updates to Channel and Sales leadership.

  • Deepen Executive Relationships: Lead Quarterly Business Reviews, facilitate executive-sponsor relationships, and drive joint planning that strengthens the partnership and turns strategic alignment into measurable go-to-market execution.

Role Expectations

This is a P4 level role. At Solink, individuals at this level are experienced contributors who operate with a high degree of autonomy within their area of expertise. They lead complex initiatives, influence cross-functional outcomes, and use their expertise to raise the effectiveness of those around them.

In this role, you’ll be expected to:

  • Strategically own the Comcast partnership end-to-end, identifying where to focus across divisions, sellers, accounts, and opportunities to maximize partner-sourced pipeline, bookings, and long-term growth.

  • Lead complex co-sell and partner initiatives across Comcast and Solink, proactively anticipating blockers, aligning stakeholders, and providing direction to keep opportunities and joint priorities moving forward.

  • Build trusted relationships from frontline sellers through executive sponsors, influencing Comcast to prioritize Solink and creating strong alignment and accountability around shared goals.

  • Develop repeatable enablement, account-mapping, brand, and go-to-market plays that improve seller activation, create pipeline, and scale what works across the Comcast organization.

  • Represent the partnership across Solink, bringing forward partner, customer, and market insights to influence Sales, Channel, Marketing, Product, and other cross-functional priorities.

  • Raise the effectiveness of the broader team by sharing channel expertise, coaching others through complex partner opportunities, and continuously improving the frameworks and practices used to execute the Comcast partnership.

 
 

What success looks like:

  • The Comcast partnership consistently delivers against partner-sourced pipeline, bookings, and co-sell revenue goals while building a strong foundation for continued growth.

  • Comcast sellers actively identify, register, and progress Solink opportunities, with successful approaches becoming repeatable across divisions and regions.

  • Complex co-sell opportunities and pilots progress effectively because risks are anticipated, ownership is clear, and the right Comcast and Solink stakeholders are engaged at the right time.

  • Solink has strong relationships across Comcast—from frontline sellers to executive sponsors—and is viewed as a strategic partner rather than simply another product in the portfolio.

  • Joint go-to-market, enablement, and brand plays create measurable results and can be scaled across the Comcast organization rather than relying on one-off execution.

  • Solink leaders and cross-functional teams trust you to represent the Comcast partnership, provide meaningful market insight, and help shape decisions that strengthen the long-term relationship.

 

What You Bring

  • Experienced Channel Professional: You bring 3–5+ years of experience in channel sales, partner management, or alliances, ideally within physical security, SaaS, networking, or a related technology environment. You’ve carried a number and successfully grown partner-sourced business.

  • Experienced in Large Partner Organizations: You’ve worked within or alongside a telco, ISP, carrier, national integrator, or large MSP and understand how to navigate divisions, regions, and multiple layers of leadership to earn seller attention and engagement.

  • Enablement-Driven Coach: You know how to build training that changes seller behaviour and are comfortable coaching sellers in the moment, including during live customer opportunities.

  • Fluent in Partner Mechanics: Deal registration, co-selling, referral and resale models, MDF and incentives, joint go-to-market planning, and QBRs are familiar territory.

  • Strategic Thinker, Tactical Executor: You can develop a joint partner plan and then execute the hands-on work required to make it successful—from pipeline reviews and deal support to seller activation and follow-through.

  • Comfortable in a Technical Sale: You don’t need to be an engineer, but you can confidently navigate conversations involving cameras, bandwidth, network topology, and integrations—and know when to bring in Sales Engineering.

  • Relationship Builder & Influencer: You can build credibility from frontline sellers through executive sponsors and motivate a large partner organization to prioritize Solink alongside competing solutions.

  • Strong Communicator & Presenter: Whether you’re training a group of sellers, running a QBR, or working through a complex opportunity, you communicate clearly, persuasively, and with the audience in mind.

  • Data-Driven & Process-Oriented: You use CRM and PRM data across pipeline, conversion, forecast, and activity to identify gaps early and determine where action is required.

 

Security Requirements

  • Candidates must undergo a criminal records check upon hire;

  • Be a Canadian Citizen (dual citizens included), or eligible to work in Canada;

  • Be willing to comply with Solink’s own security policies and standards.

Compensation

The salary range for this role is $240,000-270,000 CAD.

We determine compensation based on the experience, skills, and impact you bring to the role.

Candidates hired closer to the top of the range will typically demonstrate developing capability throughout the interview process. This means they already have the knowledge, skills, and competencies needed to perform successfully in the role, can ramp up quickly, and are expected to become fully proficient in the position within a short period of time.

 

Our Values

Location: Canada | Remote
Department: Partner Alliance

Type: Permanent | Full-Time

About Solink

At Solink, our mission is to safeguard what matters most. We provide businesses with the tools to know sooner and act faster by transforming video security into real-time operational insights.

Our cloud-based platform integrates seamlessly with your existing cameras and systems, turning them into intelligent sensors that detect and interpret key moments. This empowers teams to make data-driven decisions, enhance security, and improve operational efficiency.

Trusted by over 35,000 locations across 60+ countries - including brands like McDonald’s and JYSK - Solink delivers clarity when it counts. Our solutions help businesses reduce shrink, optimize performance, and respond proactively to potential threats.

We're growing rapidly, earning industry recognition, and scaling with purpose. We’ve been recognized by Deloitte’s Fast 50™ and Fast 500™, Business Intelligence Group, and as one of Ottawa’s Best Places to Work. And we’re just getting started!

The Role

We’re expanding our Channel team and hiring a Channel Account Manager (CAM) to own and grow Solink’s strategic partnership with Comcast. This is a quota-carrying, pipeline-generation role responsible for activating Comcast sellers, driving deal registration, running a disciplined co-sell motion with Solink Account Executives and Brand Specialists, and progressing opportunities from initial engagement through pilot and multi-site rollout.

You’ll act as the bridge between Solink and Comcast, building relationships across divisions, regions, and levels of the organization to earn seller mindshare and make Solink easy to sell. You’ll be close to where the selling happens—enabling sellers, coaching live opportunities, coordinating the right Solink resources, and removing friction before it stalls a deal.

Your success will be measured by the partner-sourced pipeline and bookings generated through Comcast, the volume and quality of registered opportunities, and the co-sell revenue you help drive alongside Solink’s sales organization.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Activate Comcast Sellers at Scale: Build seller engagement across Comcast divisions through training, targeted 1:1 enablement, and live opportunity coaching. Help sellers recognize when Solink is a strong fit and confidently introduce the solution to their customers.

  • Drive Partner-Sourced Pipeline & Bookings: Create the cadence, accountability, and joint activity required to consistently generate qualified Comcast-sourced opportunities and convert them into revenue.

  • Own the Deal Registration Motion: Manage deal registration end-to-end, including validating opportunities and site counts, coordinating pricing and approvals, protecting partner opportunities, and removing friction so deals progress efficiently.

  • Run a Disciplined Co-Sell Motion: Partner with Solink Account Executives and Brand Specialists to map Comcast’s install base against target accounts, coordinate joint outreach, clarify ownership throughout the sales process, and keep opportunities moving.

  • Progress Pilots into Rollouts: Coordinate the right resources across Sales Engineering, Customer Success, and other Solink teams to support successful pilots and help Comcast build compelling cases for broader customer expansion.

  • Build Repeatable Brand Plays: Leverage Solink’s approved-vendor relationships and standard pricing within major restaurant brands to develop repeatable franchise plays, penetration strategies, introductions, and joint outreach with Comcast.

  • Deliver World-Class Partner Enablement: Maintain a consistent enablement cadence covering Solink’s platform, vertical positioning, competitive plays, technical fundamentals, sales tools, and escalation paths that keep Comcast sellers confident and unblocked.

  • Forecast, Track & Report Performance: Run structured pipeline reviews with Comcast leadership, maintain accurate CRM and PRM data, and provide clear forecasts and performance updates to Channel and Sales leadership.

  • Deepen Executive Relationships: Lead Quarterly Business Reviews, facilitate executive-sponsor relationships, and drive joint planning that strengthens the partnership and turns strategic alignment into measurable go-to-market execution.

Role Expectations

This is a P4 level role. At Solink, individuals at this level are experienced contributors who operate with a high degree of autonomy within their area of expertise. They lead complex initiatives, influence cross-functional outcomes, and use their expertise to raise the effectiveness of those around them.

In this role, you’ll be expected to:

  • Strategically own the Comcast partnership end-to-end, identifying where to focus across divisions, sellers, accounts, and opportunities to maximize partner-sourced pipeline, bookings, and long-term growth.

  • Lead complex co-sell and partner initiatives across Comcast and Solink, proactively anticipating blockers, aligning stakeholders, and providing direction to keep opportunities and joint priorities moving forward.

  • Build trusted relationships from frontline sellers through executive sponsors, influencing Comcast to prioritize Solink and creating strong alignment and accountability around shared goals.

  • Develop repeatable enablement, account-mapping, brand, and go-to-market plays that improve seller activation, create pipeline, and scale what works across the Comcast organization.

  • Represent the partnership across Solink, bringing forward partner, customer, and market insights to influence Sales, Channel, Marketing, Product, and other cross-functional priorities.

  • Raise the effectiveness of the broader team by sharing channel expertise, coaching others through complex partner opportunities, and continuously improving the frameworks and practices used to execute the Comcast partnership.

 
 

What success looks like:

  • The Comcast partnership consistently delivers against partner-sourced pipeline, bookings, and co-sell revenue goals while building a strong foundation for continued growth.

  • Comcast sellers actively identify, register, and progress Solink opportunities, with successful approaches becoming repeatable across divisions and regions.

  • Complex co-sell opportunities and pilots progress effectively because risks are anticipated, ownership is clear, and the right Comcast and Solink stakeholders are engaged at the right time.

  • Solink has strong relationships across Comcast—from frontline sellers to executive sponsors—and is viewed as a strategic partner rather than simply another product in the portfolio.

  • Joint go-to-market, enablement, and brand plays create measurable results and can be scaled across the Comcast organization rather than relying on one-off execution.

  • Solink leaders and cross-functional teams trust you to represent the Comcast partnership, provide meaningful market insight, and help shape decisions that strengthen the long-term relationship.

 

What You Bring

  • Experienced Channel Professional: You bring 3–5+ years of experience in channel sales, partner management, or alliances, ideally within physical security, SaaS, networking, or a related technology environment. You’ve carried a number and successfully grown partner-sourced business.

  • Experienced in Large Partner Organizations: You’ve worked within or alongside a telco, ISP, carrier, national integrator, or large MSP and understand how to navigate divisions, regions, and multiple layers of leadership to earn seller attention and engagement.

  • Enablement-Driven Coach: You know how to build training that changes seller behaviour and are comfortable coaching sellers in the moment, including during live customer opportunities.

  • Fluent in Partner Mechanics: Deal registration, co-selling, referral and resale models, MDF and incentives, joint go-to-market planning, and QBRs are familiar territory.

  • Strategic Thinker, Tactical Executor: You can develop a joint partner plan and then execute the hands-on work required to make it successful—from pipeline reviews and deal support to seller activation and follow-through.

  • Comfortable in a Technical Sale: You don’t need to be an engineer, but you can confidently navigate conversations involving cameras, bandwidth, network topology, and integrations—and know when to bring in Sales Engineering.

  • Relationship Builder & Influencer: You can build credibility from frontline sellers through executive sponsors and motivate a large partner organization to prioritize Solink alongside competing solutions.

  • Strong Communicator & Presenter: Whether you’re training a group of sellers, running a QBR, or working through a complex opportunity, you communicate clearly, persuasively, and with the audience in mind.

  • Data-Driven & Process-Oriented: You use CRM and PRM data across pipeline, conversion, forecast, and activity to identify gaps early and determine where action is required.

 

Security Requirements

  • Candidates must undergo a criminal records check upon hire;

  • Be a Canadian Citizen (dual citizens included), or eligible to work in Canada;

  • Be willing to comply with Solink’s own security policies and standards.

Compensation

The salary range for this role is $240,000-270,000 CAD.

We determine compensation based on the experience, skills, and impact you bring to the role.

Candidates hired closer to the top of the range will typically demonstrate developing capability throughout the interview process. This means they already have the knowledge, skills, and competencies needed to perform successfully in the role, can ramp up quickly, and are expected to become fully proficient in the position within a short period of time.

  • Experience with CI/CD, staging and production environments, gradual rollouts, and canary releases.

  • Experience diagnosing complex, intermittent, or cross-service production issues.

  • Experience with audio and video codecs and audio analysis or processing (e.g. DSP).

  • Experience with Serverless, or at least Kubernetes.

  • Experience with TypeScript or Rust.

  • Experience working with GCP or Azure.

Senior Manager, Financial Operations

Level: M3
Location: Remote | Canada
Reports To: Jason Hunt | Director, Accounting
Type: Permanent | Full-Time

About Solink

At Solink, our mission is to safeguard what matters most. We provide businesses with the tools to know sooner and act faster by transforming video security into real-time operational insights.

Our cloud-based platform integrates seamlessly with your existing cameras and systems, turning them into intelligent sensors that detect and interpret key moments. This empowers teams to make data-driven decisions, enhance security, and improve operational efficiency.

Trusted by over 35,000 locations across 60+ countries - including brands like McDonald’s and JYSK - Solink delivers clarity when it counts. Our solutions help businesses reduce shrink, optimize performance, and respond proactively to potential threats.

We're growing rapidly, earning industry recognition, and scaling with purpose. We’ve been recognized by Deloitte’s Fast 50™ and Fast 500™, Business Intelligence Group, and as one of Ottawa’s Best Places to Work. And we’re just getting started!

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Manager, Financial Operations to lead our Procure-to-Pay (P2P) and Order-to-Cash (O2C) functions. This role owns the end-to-end processes of vendor payments, employee expense management, customer invoicing, and collections — critical functions given our hardware-enabled SaaS model, where hardware fulfillment, inventory-related vendor payments, and recurring SaaS billing all intersect. You'll report to the Director of Accounting and manage a team responsible for these processes across our global organization.

What You’ll Do

Procure-to-Pay

  • Oversee the full P2P cycle: purchase orders, vendor invoice processing, approvals, and payment runs.

  • Manage vendor relationships and resolve escalated payment or billing disputes.

  • Ensure proper controls and approval workflows are in place and followed across all entities.

  • Oversee employee expense reimbursement processes and policy compliance.

  • Partner with FP&A and Accounting on accrual accuracy for open POs and unbilled receipts.

Order-to-Cash

  • Oversee the full O2C cycle: customer invoicing, collections, cash application, and dispute resolution.

  • Monitor AR aging and drive collections efforts to minimize DSO (days sales outstanding).

  • Help drive invoice process improvements through automations.

  • Ensure invoicing accuracy for both hardware shipments and recurring SaaS subscription billing.

  • Partner with Sales and Legal on contract terms that impact billing and collections.

  • Support customer credit risk assessment.

Leadership & Cross-Functional

  • Manage, coach, and develop the P2P and O2C team members.

  • Partner with the Tax & Treasury Specialist to provide accurate, timely inputs (AP/AR timing) for short-term cash flow forecasting.

  • Partner with Accounting on month-end close activities related to AP/AR, ensuring accurate cutoff.

  • Identify and lead process improvement and automation initiatives across P2P and O2C workflows.

  • Maintain and enforce internal controls across both functions.

  • Report on key operational metrics (DSO, DPO, aging, exception rates) to finance leadership.

What You Bring

Must-Have

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or Business.

  • 5-8 years of experience in accounting or finance operations, including at least 1-2 years in a supervisory capacity.

  • Strong understanding of P2P and O2C processes and controls.

  • Experience managing AP and AR functions.

  • Experience leading systems or process automation projects in AP/AR.

  • Strong ERP experience (e.g., NetSuite).

  • Proven ability to manage, coach, and develop a team.

About the Role

Solink is looking for a Tax & Treasury Specialist to join our Finance organization. This role starts from a foundation in tax compliance and planning, with the opportunity to grow into treasury responsibilities, including short-term cash forecasting and cash flow management. We're less focused on someone who already has deep treasury experience, and more focused on finding someone with solid core tax fundamentals who is curious, adaptable, and excited to expand into treasury over time.

You'll work closely with the Director of Accounting and cross-functionally with the Accounting, FP&A and Finance Operations teams, as well as our external advisors. Our company reports under IFRS and operates globally, so this role touches multi-jurisdictional tax considerations where you will need to proactively identify tax risks, interpret evolving legislation, and build repeatable processes that minimize risk while supporting business growth.

What You’ll Do

Tax Compliance & Planning

  • Prepare and/or support federal, state/provincial, and local tax filings across all legal entities, coordinating with external tax advisors as needed.

  • Support sales/use tax, GST/HST, and VAT compliance across jurisdictions, including monitoring nexus as the business scales — hardware shipments introduce physical nexus considerations beyond typical SaaS.

  • Assist with quarterly and annual tax provision calculations under IFRS, working with the accounting team and external advisors.

  • Use AI tools to accelerate tax law research, first-draft technical memos, and summarize regulatory updates.Research and document tax positions on new products, contract structures, and cross-border transactions between entities.

  • Support tax planning opportunities as they arise (e.g., R&D tax credits, intercompany transfer pricing considerations, jurisdictional structuring).

  • Maintain the tax compliance calendar across all jurisdictions to ensure timely, accurate filings.

  • Help respond to tax notices and support tax audits.

  • Monitor changes in tax law across jurisdictions relevant to the business.

Business Partnership

  • Act as a first point of contact for Sales, Procurement, and Operations on routine tax questions.

  • Review customer and vendor contracts to ensure appropriate tax treatment.

  • Support new market expansion by evaluating tax registration and compliance requirements.

  • Translate complex tax regulations into practical guidance for business stakeholders.

Treasury & Cash Management

  • Learn and eventually own the short-term (13-week) cash flow forecast, incorporating inputs from AR, AP, payroll, and capital expenditures.

  • Support monitoring of daily cash positions across bank accounts and currencies.

  • Gain exposure to banking relationships, account structures, and treasury tools/platforms.

  • Assist with intercompany funding tracking and foreign currency exposure considerations.

  • Support annual treasury planning and working capital analysis as skills develop.

  • Explore opportunities to use AI tools to speed up variance analysis on the cash forecast (e.g., flagging unusual AR/AP timing) and to automate recurring reconciliation or reporting tasks.

What You Bring

Must-Have

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field.

  • CPA/CA in progress or completed.

  • 2-4 years of tax compliance experience; multi-jurisdictional exposure a plus but not required.

  • No prior treasury experience required — we're looking for genuine interest in learning cash forecasting and treasury operations.

  • Comfortable with ambiguity and picking up new processes; adaptable and curious by nature.

  • Comfortable using AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) to support research, drafting, and analysis — no specific AI experience required, but genuine interest in using these tools to work more efficiently is a plus.

  • Strong Excel skills; exposure to tax software (e.g., Avalara) or ERP systems is a plus.

  • Strong communication skills and comfort working cross-functionally with Accounting, FP&A, and Operations.

  • Detail-oriented and organized, able to manage multiple deadlines.

Preferred Experience

  • Exposure to IFRS reporting.

  • Experience in a SaaS, hardware, or hybrid hardware/software business.

  • Exposure to multi-entity or multi-currency environments.

  • Experience supporting external audits (financial statement and/or tax).

  • Experience supporting international tax compliance beyond Canada and the United States.

  • Global tax experience, including VAT and other indirect/direct taxes in international jurisdictions such as the EU.

Security Requirements

  • Candidates must undergo a criminal records check upon hire;

  • Be a Canadian Citizen (dual citizens included), or eligible to work in Canada;

  • Be willing to comply with Solink’s own security policies and standards.

Compensation

The salary range for this role is $100,000 - $120,000CAD.

We determine compensation based on the experience, skills, and impact you bring to the role.

Candidates in this range will demonstrate P4 profieciencies.

  • Act with URGENCY – Our customers move fast, so we do too.

Type: Permanent | Full-Time




ABOUT SOLINK

At Solink, our mission is to safeguard what matters most. We provide businesses with the tools to know sooner and act faster by transforming video security into real-time operational insights.

Our cloud-based platform integrates seamlessly with your existing cameras and systems, turning them into intelligent sensors that detect and interpret key moments. This empowers teams to make data-driven decisions, enhance security, and improve operational efficiency.

Trusted by over 35,000 locations across 60+ countries - including brands like McDonald’s and JYSK - Solink delivers clarity when it counts. Our solutions help businesses reduce shrink, optimize performance, and respond proactively to potential threats.

We're growing rapidly, earning industry recognition, and scaling with purpose. We’ve been recognized by Deloitte’s Fast 50™ and Fast 500™, Business Intelligence Group, and as one of Ottawa’s Best Places to Work. And we’re just getting started!




ABOUT THE ROLE

Solink is looking for a Tax & Treasury Specialist to join our Finance organization. This role starts from a foundation in tax compliance and planning, with the opportunity to grow into treasury responsibilities, including short-term cash forecasting and cash flow management. We're less focused on someone who already has deep treasury experience, and more focused on finding someone with solid core tax fundamentals who is curious, adaptable, and excited to expand into treasury over time.



You'll work closely with the Director of Accounting and cross-functionally with the Accounting, FP&A and Finance Operations teams, as well as our external advisors. Our company reports under IFRS and operates globally, so this role touches multi-jurisdictional tax considerations where you will need to proactively identify tax risks, interpret evolving legislation, and build repeatable processes that minimize risk while supporting business growth.




WHAT YOU’LL DO


TAX COMPLIANCE & PLANNING

 - Prepare and/or support federal, state/provincial, and local tax filings across all legal entities, coordinating with external tax advisors as needed.

 - Support sales/use tax, GST/HST, and VAT compliance across jurisdictions, including monitoring nexus as the business scales — hardware shipments introduce physical nexus considerations beyond typical SaaS.

 - Assist with quarterly and annual tax provision calculations under IFRS, working with the accounting team and external advisors.

 - Use AI tools to accelerate tax law research, first-draft technical memos, and summarize regulatory updates.Research and document tax positions on new products, contract structures, and cross-border transactions between entities.

 - Support tax planning opportunities as they arise (e.g., R&D tax credits, intercompany transfer pricing considerations, jurisdictional structuring).

 - Maintain the tax compliance calendar across all jurisdictions to ensure timely, accurate filings.

 - Help respond to tax notices and support tax audits.

 - Monitor changes in tax law across jurisdictions relevant to the business.


BUSINESS PARTNERSHIP

 - Act as a first point of contact for Sales, Procurement, and Operations on routine tax questions.

 - Review customer and vendor contracts to ensure appropriate tax treatment.

 - Support new market expansion by evaluating tax registration and compliance requirements.

 - Translate complex tax regulations into practical guidance for business stakeholders.


TREASURY & CASH MANAGEMENT

 - Learn and eventually own the short-term (13-week) cash flow forecast, incorporating inputs from AR, AP, payroll, and capital expenditures.

 - Support monitoring of daily cash positions across bank accounts and currencies.

 - Gain exposure to banking relationships, account structures, and treasury tools/platforms.

 - Assist with intercompany funding tracking and foreign currency exposure considerations.

 - Support annual treasury planning and working capital analysis as skills develop.

 - Explore opportunities to use AI tools to speed up variance analysis on the cash forecast (e.g., flagging unusual AR/AP timing) and to automate recurring reconciliation or reporting tasks.




WHAT YOU BRING


MUST-HAVE

 - Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field.

 - CPA/CA in progress or completed.

 - 2-4 years of tax compliance experience; multi-jurisdictional exposure a plus but not required.

 - No prior treasury experience required — we're looking for genuine interest in learning cash forecasting and treasury operations.

 - Comfortable with ambiguity and picking up new processes; adaptable and curious by nature.

 - Comfortable using AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) to support research, drafting, and analysis — no specific AI experience required, but genuine interest in using these tools to work more efficiently is a plus.

 - Strong Excel skills; exposure to tax software (e.g., Avalara) or ERP systems is a plus.

 - Strong communication skills and comfort working cross-functionally with Accounting, FP&A, and Operations.

 - Detail-oriented and organized, able to manage multiple deadlines.


PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

 - Exposure to IFRS reporting.

 - Experience in a SaaS, hardware, or hybrid hardware/software business.

 - Exposure to multi-entity or multi-currency environments.

 - Experience supporting external audits (financial statement and/or tax).

 - Experience supporting international tax compliance beyond Canada and the United States.

 - Global tax experience, including VAT and other indirect/direct taxes in international jurisdictions such as the EU.




SECURITY REQUIREMENTS

 - Candidates must undergo a criminal records check upon hire;

 - Be a Canadian Citizen (dual citizens included), or eligible to work in Canada;

 - Be willing to comply with Solink’s own security policies and standards.




COMPENSATION

The salary range for this role is $100,000 - $120,000CAD.

We determine compensation based on the experience, skills, and impact you bring to the role.

Candidates in this range will demonstrate P4 profieciencies.




OUR VALUES

We do things the Solink way:

 - Act with URGENCY – Our customers move fast, so we do too.

 - Deliver with QUALITY – We sweat the details and hold a high bar.

 - Win with TEAM – No egos. Just outcomes, built together.

 - Lead with TRUST – We earn it through clarity, consistency, and care.
   

These aren’t just words—they shape how we hire, lead, and grow.




WHY SOLINK?

We’re not just building tech - we’re building a place where great people do great work.

 - Clarity and trust: Where the role allows, we support flexibility in how and where work gets done - and we’re upfront about what’s required.

 - Meaningful equity: Every full-time, permanent employee has a stake in our growth.

 - Comprehensive benefits: Fully paid health & dental (no waiting period) + $500 health spending account.

 - Wellness support: Monthly reimbursement for fitness, wellness, or mental health programs.

 - Growth through merit: Advancement is based on contribution, initiative, and the ability to raise the bar - together.

 - Candid culture: Clear expectations, honest feedback, and no politics.

 - Social connection: From So-learns to Solink-o and So-lunches, we stay connected in ways that actually feel fun.




WHAT TO EXPECT FROM THE HIRING PROCESS

We respect your time and value transparency. Here’s a general idea of what to expect:

 1. Intro call with our Talent Team 

 2. Interview with the Hiring Manager

 3. Role-relevant task or case (if applicable)

 4. Final interviews with cross-functional team members

 5. Reference Checks

 6. Offer & onboarding 🎉


PLEASE NOTE: THIS IS SUBJECT TO CHANGE AT ANY POINT IN THE RECRUITMENT PROCESS BASED ON THE NEEDS OF THE BUSINESS.




HOW TO APPLY

Submit your resume and a short cover letter via our [Careers Page https://solink.com/careers/]. Let us know what excites you about this role, and how you’d help move Solink forward.


NOTICE: SOLINK USES ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE (AI) TO SCREEN, ASSESS, AND/OR SELECT CANDIDATES FOR THIS POSITION.




SOLINK IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER. WE’RE COMMITTED TO BUILDING A DIVERSE AND INCLUSIVE WORKPLACE. IF YOU REQUIRE ACCOMMODATION DURING THE SELECTION PROCESS, PLEASE LET US KNOW.

raw.description:
Deployment Specialist

Location: Ottawa, ON
Department Leader: Victoria Wnek, VP, Operations
Type: Permanent | Full-Time | Existing Vacancy

 

About Solink

At Solink, our mission is to safeguard what matters most. We provide businesses with the tools to know sooner and act faster by transforming video security into real-time operational insights.

Our cloud-based platform integrates seamlessly with your existing cameras and systems, turning them into intelligent sensors that detect and interpret key moments. This empowers teams to make data-driven decisions, enhance security, and improve operational efficiency.

Trusted by over 36,000 locations across 60+ countries - including brands like McDonald’s and JYSK - Solink delivers clarity when it counts. Our solutions help businesses reduce shrink, optimize performance, and respond proactively to potential threats.

We're growing rapidly, earning industry recognition, and scaling with purpose. We’ve been recognized by Deloitte’s Fast 50™ and Fast 500™, Business Intelligence Group, and as one of Ottawa’s Best Places to Work. And we’re just getting started!

 

The Role

As a key member of our operations project management team, you will manage relationships with our customers, vendors, partners and internal teams to ensure Solink is deployed to all sites in a timely fashion. You will build trust-based relationships with customers, vendors, and subcontractors, keeping everyone aligned and informed throughout a deployment, and use the right project management tools and structure to scope, execute, and track deployments from kickoff to completion.

We’re searching for a person who can think on their feet, a person who enjoys finding and fitting missing pieces together to solve a puzzle - someone who is always looking for ways to challenge the status quo. This is a customer-facing role, so we're looking for employees who have a strong command of the English language both written and verbal that deliver excellence with a smile.

Passion, positivity, and curiosity with the ability to organize, manage, and run multiple projects on-the-go while thinking outside-the-box, will be key characteristics to thrive in this role.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Communicate with customers on the details of integrating our product into their business.

  • Work with our Sales teams to ensure customers' needs are understood and met.

  • Build trust-based working relationships with customers, vendors, and subcontractors, keeping them engaged and informed throughout a deployment.

  • Coordinate the installation of Solink with our subcontractors and integrators across different regions globally.

  • Validate/verify installations are completed as per Solink standards - notify customers when installations are completed and act as a trusted advisor for customer escalations.

  • Coordinate and schedule installation workloads for the internal Deployment Support team.

  • Successfully scope and plan deployments of typical size and complexity, landing them on time and within expectations.

  • Maintain accurate project/deployment reporting and KPI tracking; utilize project management tracking tools and internal systems to manage deployments and provide updates to internal and external stakeholders.

  • Act as the intermediary between internal and external parties of interest for each customer and/or project.

  • Lead daily, weekly and monthly stand up and status update meetings.

  • Contribute to quarterly business review calls with key customer groups.

  • Apply Solink’s standard deployment processes reliably, and know when a situation calls for a second opinion rather than forcing it to fit.

  • Be solutions-minded and collaborate with internal teams to address obstacles.

  • Drive new process improvements that will assist in achieving Solink’s growth targets.
