Senior Manager, Content & Brand

 Level: M3 |
Location: CAN/USA | Remote
Reports To: Michael Scott, Chief Marketing Officer (CMO)

Type: Permanent | Full-Time

The Role

At Solink, our mission is to safeguard what matters most. We provide businesses with the tools to know sooner and act faster by transforming video into real-time operational insights. Our cloud-based platform integrates seamlessly with existing cameras and systems, turning them into intelligent sensors that detect and interpret key moments — empowering teams to make data-driven decisions, enhance security, and improve operational efficiency. Trusted by over 30,000 locations across 32+ countries, including brands like McDonald's and JYSK, Solink delivers clarity when it counts.

Solink is looking for a Senior Manager, Content & Brand to build the narrative and content engine that establishes Solink as the leader of our category — and to arm our Sales and Marketing teams with the content assets that drive demand. You'll own our category point of view, our educational thought-leadership content, and our speaker & influencer program, turning Solink's expertise into content the market seeks out.

This is a player-coach role for someone who can set a brand narrative, build a content program around it, and lead a team (plus a network of freelancers/agencies) to ship on a consistent cadence.

What You'll Be Doing

Category & Brand Narrative

  • Define and maintain Solink's category narrative and brand point of view, in partnership with Product Marketing and executive stakeholders.

  • Commission or produce original research and data-driven thought leadership (e.g., industry benchmark reports, trend studies) that positions Solink as the category authority.

Content Strategy & Editorial Calendar

  • Build and manage an editorial calendar covering owned channels (blog, LinkedIn, newsletter),, and owned executive channels (speaking, podcasts).

  • Set the quality bar and editorial standards across the content program.

Speaker & Influencer Program

  • Run the trade-focused speaker and influencer program end-to-end: prospecting and vetting speakers/influencers, securing speaking slots and partnerships, briefing spokespeople, and measuring reach and pipeline impact.

  • Manage Solink executives, customers, and external partners/analysts as speakers, panelists, and content collaborators at relevant trade events.

Sales & Marketing Enablement

  • Partner with Sales and Demand Gen to turn thought-leadership content into enablement assets — battlecards, social proof points, webinar content, and campaign copy.

  • Convert content into usable assets (talk tracks, one-pagers, social content, sales decks) that reps and campaigns can deploy directly.

Team & Vendor Management

  • Manage a content team and/or a network of freelance writers, designers, and agencies.

  • Manage budget for content production, speaker fees/sponsorships, and influencer partnerships.

Measurement & Reporting

  • Own content performance measurement (engagement, share of voice, pipeline influence) and report against goals to marketing leadership.

A Little Bit About You

  • 7+ years in content marketing, brand marketing, or content strategy roles, including B2B SaaS or a comparable technical category.

  • 2+ years of direct people management or managing a mixed team of employees, freelancers, and agencies.

  • Demonstrated ownership of a brand or category narrative, and experience turning it into a sustained content program (not a single campaign).

  • Experience building or running a speaker, analyst, or influencer program (conferences, paid podcasts, partner co-marketing).

  • Strong editorial judgment and hands-on writing/editing ability; comfortable both setting strategy and producing content directly when needed.

  • Track record partnering closely with Sales and/or Demand Gen to convert content into pipeline-supporting assets.

Role Expectations

This is an M3 level role — Solink's Senior Manager archetype. At Solink, individuals at this level are key leaders within their department: they effectively manage their team, provide strategic guidance on organizational initiatives and priorities, set direction independently, and execute at a high level.

In this role, you'll be expected to:

  • Lead large-scale projects and initiatives that have an impact on the organization, while keeping Solink's strategy and goals top of mind.

  • Operate with very little supervision and a high level of autonomy.

  • Lend a strong voice in developing the strategic goals of Marketing and the broader organization.

  • Drive, manage, and make decisions on overall content and brand prioritization and execution within the agreed strategy.

  • Develop and mentor your team members (and manage freelancers/agencies) to achieve team and career goals.

  • Manage the work of leads and/or senior contributors across multiple stakeholders — Sales, Demand Gen, Product Marketing, and executive spokespeople.

  • Identify goals and scope the team's work, and hold the team accountable for its output.

  • Proactively resolve cross-team dependencies and conflicts, and champion adoption of new content and brand processes.

What success looks like:

  • Content & Brand is recognized as a strategic partner to Sales and Demand Gen, not an on-demand content shop.

  • The narrative, editorial calendar (e.g., blogs, assets), and speaker/influencer program you build operate on a predictable cadence and outlast any single campaign.

  • Your team — direct reports, freelancers, and agencies — is developing toward the next level, with clear ownership and accountability.

Key Outcomes:

  • A published, cross-functionally adopted category narrative and messaging framework.

  • A running content engine (editorial calendar, production pipeline) shipping on a consistent cadence.

  • A launched speaker & influencer program with a defined roster and a first cohort of secured placements.

  • Documented lift in share of voice/category association and in Sales-reported use of content assets in deals.

Nice-to-Have:

  • Experience in physical security, loss prevention, retail operations, or another category with a strong operations/data angle.

  • Experience commissioning or producing original research/data studies as thought-leadership content.

  • Familiarity with content and social analytics tooling, and comfort reporting content performance in business terms (pipeline, share of voice) rather than vanity metrics.

Security Requirements

  • Candidates must undergo a criminal records check upon hire;

  • Be a Canadian or American Citizen, or eligible to work in Canada or the United States.

  • Be willing to comply with Solink’s own security policies and standards.

Our Values

We do things the Solink way:

  • Act with URGENCY – Our customers move fast, so we do too.

  • Deliver with QUALITY – We sweat the details and hold a high bar.

  • Win with TEAM – No egos. Just outcomes, built together.

  • Lead with TRUST – We earn it through clarity, consistency, and care.

These aren’t just words—they shape how we hire, lead, and grow.

Why Solink?

We’re not just building tech - we’re building a place where great people do great work.

  • Clarity and trust: Where the role allows, we support flexibility in how and where work gets done - and we’re upfront about what’s required.

  • Meaningful equity: Every full-time, permanent employee has a stake in our growth.

  • Comprehensive benefits: A stellar benefits package, ensuring you're fully supported with anything you need.

  • Wellness support: Monthly reimbursement for fitness, wellness, or mental health programs.

  • Growth through merit: Advancement is based on contribution, initiative, and the ability to raise the bar - together.

  • Candid culture: Clear expectations, honest feedback, and no politics.

  • Social connection: From So-learns to Solink-o and So-lunches, we stay connected in ways that actually feel fun.

What to Expect from the Hiring Process

We respect your time and value transparency. Here’s a general idea of what to expect:

  1. Intro call with our Talent Team

  2. Interview with the Hiring Manager

  3. Role-relevant task or case (if applicable)

  4. Final interviews with cross-functional team members

  5. Reference Checks

  6. Offer & onboarding 🎉

Director, Deployment Operations

Level: M4 | Proficient
Location: Ottawa, ON | Hybrid
Reports To: Victoria Wnek, VP, Operations
Type: Permanent | Full-Time

About Solink

At Solink, our mission is to safeguard what matters most. We provide businesses with the tools to know sooner and act faster by transforming video security into real-time operational insights.

Our cloud-based platform integrates seamlessly with your existing cameras and systems, turning them into intelligent sensors that detect and interpret key moments. This empowers teams to make data-driven decisions, enhance security, and improve operational efficiency.

Trusted by over 35,000 locations across 60+ countries - including brands like McDonald’s and JYSK - Solink delivers clarity when it counts. Our solutions help businesses reduce shrink, optimize performance, and respond proactively to potential threats.

We're growing rapidly, earning industry recognition, and scaling with purpose. We’ve been recognized by Deloitte’s Fast 50™ and Fast 500™, Business Intelligence Group, and as one of Ottawa’s Best Places to Work. And we’re just getting started!

The Role

As Director, Deployment Operations, you'll own Solink's end-to-end sales-to-deployment operating model, from the moment a deal closes to the point a customer is live, supported and generating recurring revenue. Our Deployment function has grown in scale, complexity and strategic importance, and this role exists to lead it into its next chapter.

You'll lead a team across three focus areas: Deployment Execution, Optimization & Automation, and Operations Enablement. You'll be accountable for the overall function and driving major automation and process-improvement initiatives and partnering with senior leaders across the organization to improve planning, quality, scalability and accountability.

This is an opportunity for an operations leader who's energized by building systems that scale, raising the bar on execution and connecting operational performance directly to ARR growth.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the sales-to-deployment operating model: Define and continuously improve how work flows from Sales through Deployment to Support, including handoffs, planning, capacity, quality standards and accountability at every stage.

  • Lead and develop a high-performing leadership team: Lead Managers across Deployment Execution, Optimization & Automation, and Enablement & Cross-Functional. Set clear goals, coach for growth and build a leadership bench that can scale with the business.

  • Drive operational transformation: Lead major automation, tooling and process-improvement initiatives that increase throughput, reduce cycle time and improve the customer deployment experience.

  • Deliver on ARR: Ensure deployments are executed on time and at quality so that contracted revenue converts to recurring revenue predictably. Own the metrics, forecasting and reporting that connect operations to financial outcomes.

  • Partner across the organization: Work closely with senior leaders in Sales, Customer Success, Support, Product and Finance to align on planning, resolve cross-functional friction and make Deployment a strategic lever for the business.

  • Establish governance and operational rigour: Set the standards, SOPs, KPIs and reporting cadence that give leadership clear visibility into deployment health, capacity and risk.

  • Oversee partner and field strategy: Guide how Solink works with installation partners and field resources, including partner enablement, performance management and relationship health.

  • Serve as the senior escalation point: Own resolution of high-impact customer and operational escalations, and turn recurring issues into systemic fixes.

Role Expectations

This is an M4 level role. At Solink, individuals at this level serve as a strategic advisor within a department, who is confident acting as their executive leader’s right hand within their functional area and is able to set cross-functional direction in collaboration with departments within the organization.

In this role, you'll be expected to:

  • Set the vision and multi-quarter roadmap for the Deployment function and translate it into clear priorities for your managers.

  • Operate with a high degree of autonomy, making decisions that shape how the function runs and how it interacts with the rest of the business.

  • Influence senior stakeholders across functions, building alignment on shared goals, processes and trade-offs.

  • Balance near-term delivery with long-term investment in automation, tooling and scalability.

  • Build a culture of ownership, quality and continuous improvement across the Deployment team.

What success looks like:

  • Deployment cycle times, on-time delivery and quality metrics improve measurably, and ARR from new deals is realized faster and more predictably.

  • Key automation and process-improvement initiatives are delivered, reducing manual effort and allowing the function to scale without proportional headcount growth.

  • Sales, Deployment, Support and other partners operate from a shared planning model with clear handoffs, visible accountability and fewer escalations.

What You Bring

Must-Have:

  • 8+ years in operations, deployment, implementation or professional services, including 3+ years leading managers or multi-team functions.

  • A proven track record of designing and scaling an end-to-end operating model in a high-growth B2B technology, SaaS or hardware-enabled services environment.

  • Demonstrated success leading process-improvement and automation initiatives with measurable impact on efficiency, quality or revenue.

  • Strong analytical and business acumen, with experience owning KPIs, capacity planning and operational reporting tied to financial outcomes such as ARR.

  • Excellent cross-functional leadership and communication skills, with the credibility to influence senior leaders and drive alignment.

Nice-to-Have:

  • Experience in physical security, video surveillance, IoT or other field-deployed technology.

  • Experience managing installation partner or channel networks across multiple regions.

  • Familiarity with operations tooling and automation platforms (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot, NetSuite, Asana, Jira, n8n or similar).

  • Background in Lean, Six Sigma or other formal continuous-improvement methodologies.

Security Requirements

  • Candidates must undergo a criminal records check upon hire;

  • Be a Canadian Citizen (dual citizens included), or eligible to work in Canada;

  • Be willing to comply with Solink’s own security policies and standards.

Compensation

The compensation range for this role is $156,696-195,870 CAD and includes a base salary plus a performance-based variable component.

We determine compensation based on the experience, skills, and impact you bring to the role.

For this position, we are hiring within the Proficient range. Candidates in this range will demonstrate the ability to serve as a strategic advisor within their department, confidently acting as the senior leader's right hand within their functional area and setting cross-functional direction in collaboration with other departments across the organization.

Our Values

We do things the Solink way:

  • Act with URGENCY – Our customers move fast, so we do too.

  • Deliver with QUALITY – We sweat the details and hold a high bar.

  • Win with TEAM – No egos. Just outcomes, built together.

  • Lead with TRUST – We earn it through clarity, consistency, and care.

These aren’t just words—they shape how we hire, lead, and grow.

Why Solink?

We’re not just building tech - we’re building a place where great people do great work.

  • Clarity and trust: Where the role allows, we support flexibility in how and where work gets done - and we’re upfront about what’s required.

  • Meaningful equity: Every full-time, permanent employee has a stake in our growth.

  • Comprehensive benefits: Fully paid health & dental (no waiting period) + $500 health spending account.

  • Wellness support: Monthly reimbursement for fitness, wellness, or mental health programs.

  • Growth through merit: Advancement is based on contribution, initiative, and the ability to raise the bar - together.

  • Candid culture: Clear expectations, honest feedback, and no politics.

  • Social connection: From So-learns to Solink-o and So-lunches, we stay connected in ways that actually feel fun.

What to Expect from the Hiring Process

We respect your time and value transparency. Here’s a general idea of what to expect:

  1. Intro call with our Talent Team

  2. Behavioural interview with a member of People & Culture

  3. Hiring Manager interview with this role's manager

  4. Cross-functional panel interview

  5. Reference Checks

  6. Offer & onboarding 🎉

Please note: this is subject to change at any point in the recruitment process based on the needs of the business.

How to Apply

Submit your resume and a short cover letter via our [Careers Page]. Let us know what excites you about this role, and how you’d help move Solink forward.

You'll be accountable for the overall function and driving major automation and process-improvement initiatives and partnering with senior leaders across the organization to improve planning, quality, scalability and accountability.

This is an opportunity for an operations leader who's energized by building systems that scale, raising the bar on execution and connecting operational performance directly to ARR growth.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own the sales-to-deployment operating model: Define and continuously improve how work flows from Sales through Deployment to Support, including handoffs, planning, capacity, quality standards and accountability at every stage.

 - Lead and develop a high-performing leadership team: Lead Managers across Deployment Execution, Optimization & Automation, and Enablement & Cross-Functional. Set clear goals, coach for growth and build a leadership bench that can scale with the business.

 - Drive operational transformation: Lead major automation, tooling and process-improvement initiatives that increase throughput, reduce cycle time and improve the customer deployment experience.

 - Deliver on ARR: Ensure deployments are executed on time and at quality so that contracted revenue converts to recurring revenue predictably. Own the metrics, forecasting and reporting that connect operations to financial outcomes.

 - Partner across the organization: Work closely with senior leaders in Sales, Customer Success, Support, Product and Finance to align on planning, resolve cross-functional friction and make Deployment a strategic lever for the business.

 - Establish governance and operational rigour: Set the standards, SOPs, KPIs and reporting cadence that give leadership clear visibility into deployment health, capacity and risk.

 - Oversee partner and field strategy: Guide how Solink works with installation partners and field resources, including partner enablement, performance management and relationship health.

 - Serve as the senior escalation point: Own resolution of high-impact customer and operational escalations, and turn recurring issues into systemic fixes.




ROLE EXPECTATIONS

This is an M4 level role. At Solink, individuals at this level serve as a strategic advisor within a department, who is confident acting as their executive leader’s right hand within their functional area and is able to set cross-functional direction in collaboration with departments within the organization.



In this role, you'll be expected to:

 - Set the vision and multi-quarter roadmap for the Deployment function and translate it into clear priorities for your managers.

 - Operate with a high degree of autonomy, making decisions that shape how the function runs and how it interacts with the rest of the business.

 - Influence senior stakeholders across functions, building alignment on shared goals, processes and trade-offs.

 - Balance near-term delivery with long-term investment in automation, tooling and scalability.

 - Build a culture of ownership, quality and continuous improvement across the Deployment team.

What success looks like:

 - Deployment cycle times, on-time delivery and quality metrics improve measurably, and ARR from new deals is realized faster and more predictably.

 - Key automation and process-improvement initiatives are delivered, reducing manual effort and allowing the function to scale without proportional headcount growth.

 - Sales, Deployment, Support and other partners operate from a shared planning model with clear handoffs, visible accountability and fewer escalations.


WHAT YOU BRING

Must-Have:

 - 8+ years in operations, deployment, implementation or professional services, including 3+ years leading managers or multi-team functions.

 - A proven track record of designing and scaling an end-to-end operating model in a high-growth B2B technology, SaaS or hardware-enabled services environment.

 - Demonstrated success leading process-improvement and automation initiatives with measurable impact on efficiency, quality or revenue.

 - Strong analytical and business acumen, with experience owning KPIs, capacity planning and operational reporting tied to financial outcomes such as ARR.

 - Excellent cross-functional leadership and communication skills, with the credibility to influence senior leaders and drive alignment.

Nice-to-Have:

 - Experience in physical security, video surveillance, IoT or other field-deployed technology.

 - Experience managing installation partner or channel networks across multiple regions.

 - Familiarity with operations tooling and automation platforms (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot, NetSuite, Asana, Jira, n8n or similar).

 - Background in Lean, Six Sigma or other formal continuous-improvement methodologies.




SECURITY REQUIREMENTS

 - Candidates must undergo a criminal records check upon hire;

 - Be a Canadian Citizen (dual citizens included), or eligible to work in Canada;

 - Be willing to comply with Solink’s own security policies and standards.


COMPENSATION

The compensation range for this role is $156,696-195,870 CAD and includes a base salary plus a performance-based variable component.

We determine compensation based on the experience, skills, and impact you bring to the role.

For this position, we are hiring within the Proficient range. Candidates in this range will demonstrate the ability to serve as a strategic advisor within their department, confidently acting as the senior leader's right hand within their functional area and setting cross-functional direction in collaboration with other departments across the organization.




OUR VALUES

We do things the Solink way:

 - Act with URGENCY – Our customers move fast, so we do too.

 - Deliver with QUALITY – We sweat the details and hold a high bar.

 - Win with TEAM – No egos. Just outcomes, built together.

 - Lead with TRUST – We earn it through clarity, consistency, and care.
   

These aren’t just words—they shape how we hire, lead, and grow.




WHY SOLINK?

We’re not just building tech - we’re building a place where great people do great work.

 - Clarity and trust: Where the role allows, we support flexibility in how and where work gets done - and we’re upfront about what’s required.

 - Meaningful equity: Every full-time, permanent employee has a stake in our growth.

 - Comprehensive benefits: Fully paid health & dental (no waiting period) + $500 health spending account.

 - Wellness support: Monthly reimbursement for fitness, wellness, or mental health programs.

 - Growth through merit: Advancement is based on contribution, initiative, and the ability to raise the bar - together.

 - Candid culture: Clear expectations, honest feedback, and no politics.

 - Social connection: From So-learns to Solink-o and So-lunches, we stay connected in ways that actually feel fun.




WHAT TO EXPECT FROM THE HIRING PROCESS

We respect your time and value transparency. Here’s a general idea of what to expect:

 1. Intro call with our Talent Team

 2. Behavioural interview with a member of People & Culture

 3. Hiring Manager interview with this role's manager

 4. Cross-functional panel interview

 5. Reference Checks

 6. Offer & onboarding 🎉


PLEASE NOTE: THIS IS SUBJECT TO CHANGE AT ANY POINT IN THE RECRUITMENT PROCESS BASED ON THE NEEDS OF THE BUSINESS.




HOW TO APPLY

Submit your resume and a short cover letter via our [Careers Page https://solink.com/careers/]. Let us know what excites you about this role, and how you’d help move Solink forward.


NOTICE: SOLINK USES ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE (AI) TO SCREEN, ASSESS, AND/OR SELECT CANDIDATES FOR THIS POSITION.

Level: Management, M3
Location: Canada (Remote)
Department: Revenue Operations
Reports To: Faye Campbell | Senior Director of Revenue Operations
Type: Permanent | Full-Time
Vacancy Status: This is an active, approved role and we are currently hiring for this position.


About Solink

At Solink, our mission is to safeguard what matters most. We provide businesses with the tools to know sooner and act faster by transforming video security into real-time operational insights.

Our cloud-based platform integrates seamlessly with your existing cameras and systems, turning them into intelligent sensors that detect and interpret key moments. This empowers teams to make data-driven decisions, enhance security, and improve operational efficiency.

Trusted by over 30,000 locations across 32+ countries - including brands like McDonald’s and JYSK - Solink delivers clarity when it counts. Our solutions help businesses reduce shrink, optimize performance, and respond proactively to potential threats.

We're growing rapidly, earning industry recognition, and scaling with purpose. We’ve been recognized by Deloitte’s Fast 50™ and Fast 500™, Business Intelligence Group, and as one of Ottawa’s Best Places to Work. And we’re just getting started!


The Role

Revenue Operations at Solink owns the data, systems, and processes that power our go-to-market engine, from first touch through renewal and expansion. As a Revenue Operations Manager, you will be a key strategic partner to GTM leadership and will bring the experience and technical expertise required to support a broad and varied enterprise sales motion.

We require an experienced Sales Operations professional who can bring structure and discipline to a complex, land-and-expand deal landscape where growth comes through a high volume of interconnected pilots, rollouts, and expansions rather than a handful of long, linear deals. Success here requires a holistic understanding of the complexity of the sales journey and the technical data skills to knit the revenue narrative together.

You will steward the integrity of our GTM data in Salesforce, working closely with our CRM platform team and shaping recommendations on design, automation, and process. You have strong opinions about what good looks like, can develop a roadmap to get us there, and can be a hands-on contributor to building it out.

As an analyst, you will partner closely with GTM leadership to provide forecasts, insights, and develop hypotheses about how the business grows. You will develop the data foundations required to advance our reporting beyond observational weather reporting to strategically impactful forecasting, scenario planning, and whitespace analysis.

What You’ll Do

  • Act as a deeply embedded strategic partner to GTM leadership, with a strong focus on sales operations

  • Design and maintain the capacity and territory model, headcount planning, and collaborate closely with partners on the commission model

  • Design and evolve end-to-end revenue processes, from lead qualification through close, deployment, expansion and retention

  • Maintain deep familiarity with the full revenue funnel, from acquisition to expansion, with strong cross-functional alignment across Marketing, Customer Success, Operations, and Finance

  • Build and maintain complex, cross-object reports and dashboards giving leadership a clear, real-time view of pipeline health, forecast accuracy, and operational performance

  • Proactively identify and resolve data integrity issues, automation gaps, and process bottlenecks

  • Navigate a complex, multi-stakeholder landscape, aligning Sales, Marketing, CS, Operations, and Finance leaders

Role Expectations

This is an M3 level role. At Solink, leaders at this level operate with a high degree of autonomy, lead complex initiatives with organization-wide impact, and help shape the strategic direction of their function. They lead through others, develop strong teams, and are accountable for translating company strategy into clear priorities, execution, and measurable outcomes.

In this role, you’ll be expected to:

  • Help shape the strategic direction and priorities of Revenue Operations, translating company and GTM goals into clear roadmaps, initiatives, and operating priorities for the team.

  • Lead complex, cross-functional initiatives end-to-end with a high degree of autonomy, making decisions on prioritization and execution while proactively resolving dependencies and conflicts across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, and Operations.

  • Define clear goals and scope for your team, creating accountability for high-quality execution while ensuring resources and priorities remain focused on the work with the greatest business impact.

  • Lead and develop a high-performing team, coaching team members and leaders, providing clear feedback, and building development and succession plans that strengthen the long-term capabilities of Revenue Operations.

  • Act as a trusted strategic partner to GTM leaders, using data, operational expertise, and a strong understanding of the revenue engine to challenge assumptions, influence decisions, and bring forward thoughtful recommendations.

  • Champion change across the GTM organization, ensuring new processes, systems, and ways of working are supported by thoughtful change management, stakeholder alignment, enablement, and adoption.

What Success Looks Like

  • GTM leaders view Revenue Operations as a strategic partner that provides clear insights, thoughtful recommendations, and the operational infrastructure required to make better business decisions.

  • Revenue processes, systems, and data provide a connected view of the customer journey from acquisition through expansion and enable the business to operate effectively as complexity and scale increase.

  • Leadership has reliable visibility into pipeline, forecasting, capacity, territories, and operational performance, with insights increasingly supporting scenario planning and forward-looking decisions rather than simply reporting historical activity.

  • Large cross-functional initiatives are delivered with clear ownership, strong stakeholder alignment, proactive management of dependencies, and successful adoption across impacted teams.

  • Your team operates with clear priorities and accountability, independently owns its areas of responsibility, and continues to develop the technical, analytical, and business capabilities required to support the organization.

  • Revenue Operations has the right structure, capabilities, and succession plans to support current business needs while preparing the function for future growth.

What You Bring

Must-Have:

  • 7+ years in Revenue Operations or Sales Operations, with hands-on Salesforce administration: workflows, automation, data architecture, and complex reporting

  • Experience supporting an enterprise sales organization with complex deal structures and deep integration with quoting, billing, contracting and order management

  • Experience with lead management for ABM and large-scale expansions

  • Experience designing and executing new sales processes from 0-to-1, with a consideration for scalability

  • Strong technical fluency: proficient in Excel, BI platforms (eg. Tableau), and/or SQL for extraction and analysis

  • Demonstrated ability navigate cross-functional stakeholders in a large, complex organization during periods of transition

  • Excellent project management skills, having led a project end-to-end from requirements gathering through scoping, build, and rollout

  • Exceptional communicator, comfortable in a high-context, remote environment. Strong technical writing skills and an aptitude for asynchronous coordination

  • Strong aptitude for change management, enablement and communication. You develop rapport with your stakeholder teams and centre the seller experience in your process design

  • Experience deploying AI as a part of revenue systems, improving operational efficiency, data accuracy, and analysis

  • Experience in a hardware-enabled business is a strong asset

Security Requirements

  • Candidates must undergo a criminal records check upon hire;

  • Be a Canadian Citizen (dual citizens included), or eligible to work in Canada;

  • Be willing to comply with Solink’s own security policies and standards.

Our Values

We do things the Solink way:

  • Act with URGENCY – Our customers move fast, so we do too.

  • Deliver with QUALITY – We sweat the details and hold a high bar.

  • Win with TEAM – No egos. Just outcomes, built together.

  • Lead with TRUST – We earn it through clarity, consistency, and care.

These aren’t just words—they shape how we hire, lead, and grow.

Why Solink?

We’re not just building tech - we’re building a place where great people do great work.

  • Clarity and trust: Where the role allows, we support flexibility in how and where work gets done - and we’re upfront about what’s required.

  • Meaningful equity: Every full-time, permanent employee has a stake in our growth.

  • Comprehensive benefits: Fully paid health & dental (no waiting period) + $500 health spending account.

  • Wellness support: Monthly reimbursement for fitness, wellness, or mental health programs.

  • Growth through merit: Advancement is based on contribution, initiative, and the ability to raise the bar - together.

  • Candid culture: Clear expectations, honest feedback, and no politics.

  • Social connection: From So-learns to Solink-o and So-lunches, we stay connected in ways that actually feel fun.

Compensation

The salary range for this role is $152,000 - $180,000 CAD On-Target Earnings (OTE) .

We determine compensation based on the experience, skills, and impact you bring to the role.

Candidates hired closer to the top of the range will typically demonstrate proficient capability throughout the interview process. This means they already have the knowledge, skills, and leadership capabilities needed to perform successfully in the role, can ramp up quickly, and are expected to become fully proficient in the position within a short period of time.

  • Comprehensive benefits: Fully paid health & dental (no waiting period) + $500 health spending account.

  • Wellness support: Monthly reimbursement for fitness, wellness, or mental health programs.

  • Growth through merit: Advancement is based on contribution, initiative, and the ability to raise the bar - together.

  • Candid culture: Clear expectations, honest feedback, and no politics.

What to Expect from the Hiring Process

We respect your time and value transparency. Here’s a general idea of what to expect:

  1. Intro call with our Talent Team

  2. Interview with the Hiring Manager

  3. Role-relevant task or case (if applicable)

  4. Final interviews with cross-functional team members

  5. Reference Checks

  6. Offer & onboarding 🎉

Please note: this is subject to change at any point in the recruitment process based on the needs of the business.

How to Apply

Submit your resume and a short cover letter via our [Careers Page]. Let us know what excites you about this role, and how you’d help move Solink forward.

 - Lead complex, cross-functional initiatives end-to-end with a high degree of autonomy, making decisions on prioritization and execution while proactively resolving dependencies and conflicts across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, and Operations.

 - Define clear goals and scope for your team, creating accountability for high-quality execution while ensuring resources and priorities remain focused on the work with the greatest business impact.

 - Lead and develop a high-performing team, coaching team members and leaders, providing clear feedback, and building development and succession plans that strengthen the long-term capabilities of Revenue Operations.

 - Act as a trusted strategic partner to GTM leaders, using data, operational expertise, and a strong understanding of the revenue engine to challenge assumptions, influence decisions, and bring forward thoughtful recommendations.

 - GTM leaders view Revenue Operations as a strategic partner that provides clear insights, thoughtful recommendations, and the operational infrastructure required to make better business decisions.

 - Leadership has reliable visibility into pipeline, forecasting, capacity, territories, and operational performance, with insights increasingly supporting scenario planning and forward-looking decisions rather than simply reporting historical activity.

 - Large cross-functional initiatives are delivered with clear ownership, strong stakeholder alignment, proactive management of dependencies, and successful adoption across impacted teams.

 - Your team operates with clear priorities and accountability, independently owns its areas of responsibility, and continues to develop the technical, analytical, and business capabilities required to support the organization.

 - Revenue Operations has the right structure, capabilities, and succession plans to support current business needs while preparing the function for future growth.




WHAT YOU BRING

 - 7+ years in Revenue Operations or Sales Operations, with hands-on Salesforce administration: workflows, automation, data architecture, and complex reporting

 - Experience supporting an enterprise sales organization with complex deal structures and deep integration with quoting, billing, contracting and order management

 - Experience with lead management for ABM and large-scale expansions

 - Experience designing and executing new sales processes from 0-to-1, with a consideration for scalability

 - Strong technical fluency: proficient in Excel, BI platforms (eg. Tableau), and/or SQL for extraction and analysis

 - Demonstrated ability navigate cross-functional stakeholders in a large, complex organization during periods of transition

 - Excellent project management skills, having led a project end-to-end from requirements gathering through scoping, build, and rollout

 - Exceptional communicator, comfortable in a high-context, remote environment. Strong technical writing skills and an aptitude for asynchronous coordination

 - Strong aptitude for change management, enablement and communication. You develop rapport with your stakeholder teams and centre the seller experience in your process design

 - Experience deploying AI as a part of revenue systems, improving operational efficiency, data accuracy, and analysis

 - Experience in a hardware-enabled business is a strong asset
